5.148.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
kelīśvarī ca yā devī śrūyate sūtanaṃdana ..
māhātmyaṃ vada nastasyā utpattiṃ ca suvistarāt .. 1 ..
5.148.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
केलीश्वरी च या देवी श्रूयते सूतनंदन ..
माहात्म्यं वद नस्तस्या उत्पत्तिं च सुविस्तरात् .. 1 ..
5.148.m: The seers said: / Regarding the goddess Kelīśvarī who is heard of, O son of Sūta, / tell us her māhātmya and her origin in full detail.

5.148.s:
kasminkāle samutpannā kimarthaṃ ca sureśvarī ...
kiṃ tasyā jāyate śreyaḥ pūjayā namanena ca .. 2 ..
5.148.d:
कस्मिन्काले समुत्पन्ना किमर्थं च सुरेश्वरी ...
किं तस्या जायते श्रेयः पूजया नमनेन च .. 2 ..
5.148.m: At what time was the ruler of gods born, and for what purpose? / What welfare arises through worshipping and bowing to her? (2)

5.148.s:
tvayā kātyāyanī proktā cāmuṇḍā ca sureśvarī ..
śrīmātā ca samutpannā kimarthaṃ ca sureśvarī .. .. 3 ..
5.148.d:
त्वया कात्यायनी प्रोक्ता चामुण्डा च सुरेश्वरी ..
श्रीमाता च समुत्पन्ना किमर्थं च सुरेश्वरी .. .. 3 ..
5.148.m: You spoke of Kātyāyanī and of Cāmuṇḍā, the ruler of gods; / and Śrīmātā was born—for what purpose, O ruler of gods? (3)

5.148.s:
śrīmātā ca tathā tārā devī śatruvināśinī ..
kelīśvarī na saṃproktā tasmāttāṃ vada sāṃpratam .. 4 ..
5.148.d:
श्रीमाता च तथा तारा देवी शत्रुविनाशिनी ..
केलीश्वरी न संप्रोक्ता तस्मात्तां वद सांप्रतम् .. 4 ..
5.148.m: And Śrīmātā, as well as the goddess Tārā, the destroyer of foes; / but Kelīśvarī was not described, so speak of her now. (4)

5.148.s: kautukaṃ naḥ samutpannamatrārthe sūtanaṃdana .. 5 ..
5.148.d: कौतुकं नः समुत्पन्नमत्रार्थे सूतनंदन .. 5 ..
5.148.m: Curiosity has arisen in us regarding this matter, O son of Sūta. (5)

5.148.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
ādyaikā devatā loke bahurūpā vyavasthitā ..
devatānāṃ hitārthāya daityapakṣakṣayāya ca .. 6 ..
5.148.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
आद्यैका देवता लोके बहुरूपा व्यवस्थिता ..
देवतानां हितार्थाय दैत्यपक्षक्षयाय च .. 6 ..
5.148.m: Sūta said: / In the beginning, one single deity remained in the world in manifold forms / for the welfare of the deities and for the destruction of the Daityas' faction. (6)

5.148.s:
yadāyadātra devānāṃ vyasanaṃ jāyate kvacit ..
tadātadā parā śaktiryā sā vyāpya vyavasthitā .. 7 ..
5.148.d:
यदायदात्र देवानां व्यसनं जायते क्वचित् ..
तदातदा परा शक्तिर्या सा व्याप्य व्यवस्थिता .. 7 ..
5.148.m: Whenever any affliction arises here for the gods, / then that supreme Śakti, having pervaded [all], remains. (7)

5.148.s:
sarvametajjagaddhātrī janma cakre dharātale ..
mahiṣāsuranāśāya sā ca kātyāyanī bhuvi .. 8 ..
5.148.d:
सर्वमेतज्जगद्धात्री जन्म चक्रे धरातले ..
महिषासुरनाशाय सा च कात्यायनी भुवि .. 8 ..
5.148.m: The supporter of this whole universe took birth on the surface of the earth; / she became Kātyāyanī on earth for the destruction of the demon Mahiṣa. (8)

5.148.s:
avatīrṇā parā mūrtirgatāsminbhuvanatraye ..
yadā śuṃbhanikṣaṃbhau ca dānavau baladarpitau .. 9 ..
5.148.d:
अवतीर्णा परा मूर्तिर्गतास्मिन्भुवनत्रये ..
यदा शुंभनिक्षंभौ च दानवौ बलदर्पितौ .. 9 ..
5.148.m: Her supreme form descended and moved within these three worlds. / When Śumbha and Niśumbha, the two Dānavas arrogant with power, [arose], (9)

5.148.s:
avatīrṇā tadā saiva cāmuṃḍā rūpamāśritā ..
prodgate kālayavane sarvadevabhayāvahe .. 6.149.10 ..
5.148.d:
अवतीर्णा तदा सैव चामुंडा रूपमाश्रिता ..
प्रोद्गते कालयवने सर्वदेवभयावहे .. 6.149.10 ..
5.148.m: then she descended, having assumed the form of Cāmuṇḍā. / When Kālayavana arose, bringing fear to all the gods, (10)

5.148.s:
śrīmātārūpiṇī devī saiva jātā mahītale ..
aṃdhāsuravadhārthāya śaṃbhunā''krāṃtacetasā ..
sṛṣṭā kelīvarī devī yayā vyāptamidaṃ jagat .. 11 ..
5.148.d:
श्रीमातारूपिणी देवी सैव जाता महीतले ..
अंधासुरवधार्थाय शंभुना'ऽक्रांतचेतसा ..
सृष्टा केलीवरी देवी यया व्याप्तमिदं जगत् .. 11 ..
5.148.m: she was born on the earth's surface in the form of the goddess Śrīmātā. / For the slaying of the demon Andhaka, Śambhu, his mind deeply affected, / brought forth the goddess Kelīśvarī, by whom this universe was pervaded. (11)

5.148.s:
tatastasyāḥ prabhāvena hatvā daityānaśeṣataḥ ..
andhako nihataḥ paścāttrailokyavyasanapradaḥ .. .. 12 ..
5.148.d:
ततस्तस्याः प्रभावेन हत्वा दैत्यानशेषतः ..
अन्धको निहतः पश्चात्त्रैलोक्यव्यसनप्रदः .. .. 12 ..
5.148.m: Then, through her power, having slain the Daityas without remainder, / Andhaka was subsequently killed, who had caused affliction to the three worlds. (12)

5.148.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
andhakaḥ kasya putro'yaṃ kiṃprabhāvaḥ kathaṃ hataḥ ..
kasmāddhatastu saṃgrāme sarvaṃ vistarato vada .. .. 13 ..
5.148.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
अन्धकः कस्य पुत्रोऽयं किंप्रभावः कथं हतः ..
कस्माद्धतस्तु संग्रामे सर्वं विस्तरतो वद .. .. 13 ..
5.148.m: The seers said: / Whose son was this Andhaka, what was his prowess, and how was he slain? / Why was he killed in battle? Tell everything in detail. (13)

5.148.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
dakṣasya duhitā nāmnā ditiḥ sarvaguṇālayā ..
hiraṇyakaśipurnāma tasyāḥ putro babhūva ha .. 14 ..
5.148.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
दक्षस्य दुहिता नाम्ना दितिः सर्वगुणालया ..
हिरण्यकशिपुर्नाम तस्याः पुत्रो बभूव ह .. 14 ..
5.148.m: Sūta said: / Dakṣa had a daughter named Diti, an abode of all virtues; / she had a son named Hiraṇyakaśipu. (14)

5.148.s:
yena śakrādayo devā jitāḥ sarve raṇājire ..
svarge rājyaṃ kṛtaṃ bhūri svayameva mahātmanā .. 15 .. yadbhayātsakalairdevairnānāśastrāṇyanekaśaḥ ..
5.148.d:
येन शक्रादयो देवा जिताः सर्वे रणाजिरे ..
स्वर्गे राज्यं कृतं भूरि स्वयमेव महात्मना .. 15 .. यद्भयात्सकलैर्देवैर्नानाशस्त्राण्यनेकशः ..
5.148.m: By him all the gods, Indra and the others, were conquered on the battleground; / a great sovereignty was established by that high-souled one in heaven itself. / Through fear of him, all the gods in many ways [fashioned] various weapons, (15)

5.148.s: nirmitānyatimukhyāni varmacarmayutāni ca .. 16 ..
5.148.d: निर्मितान्यतिमुख्यानि वर्मचर्मयुतानि च .. 16 ..
5.148.m: fashioned most foremost [arms] furnished with armor and shields. (16)

5.148.s:
svayaṃ vidārito yaśca viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā ..
karajairjānuni pṛṣṭhe vinidhāya prakopataḥ .. 107 ..
tasya putradvayaṃ jajña vīryaudāryaguṇānvitam ..
jyeṣṭhaḥ prahlāda ityukto dvitīyaścāṃdhakastathā .. 18 ..
hiraṇyakaśipau prāpte mṛtyulokaṃ suhṛdgaṇaiḥ ..
amātyaiśca tataḥ proktaḥ prahlādo vinayānvitaiḥ .. 19 ..
pitṛpaitāmahaṃ rājyametadācara sāṃpratam ..
dhuraṃ vahasva rājyotthāṃ devānyuddhe nipātaya ..6.149.2...
.. prahrāda uvāca .. ..
nāhaṃ rājyaṃ kariṣyāmi kathaṃcidapi bhūtale ..
yatastato nibodhadhvaṃ vacanaṃ mama sāṃpratam ..21..
daityarājyaṃ na vāṃchaṃti devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ ..
teṣāṃ rakṣākaro nityaṃ viṣṇuḥ sa bhagavānsvayam ..22..
apyahaṃ santyaje prāṇānsarvasvaṃ vā na saṃśayaḥ ..
hariṇā saha saṃgrāmaṃ nāhaṃ kartumaho kṣamaḥ.. 23 ..
5.148.d:
स्वयं विदारितो यश्च विष्णुना प्रभविष्णुना ..
करजैर्जानुनि पृष्ठे विनिधाय प्रकोपतः .. 107 ..
तस्य पुत्रद्वयं जज्ञ वीर्यौदार्यगुणान्वितम् ..
ज्येष्ठः प्रह्लाद इत्युक्तो द्वितीयश्चांधकस्तथा .. 18 ..
हिरण्यकशिपौ प्राप्ते मृत्युलोकं सुहृद्गणैः ..
अमात्यैश्च ततः प्रोक्तः प्रह्लादो विनयान्वितैः .. 19 ..
पितृपैतामहं राज्यमेतदाचर सांप्रतम् ..
धुरं वहस्व राज्योत्थां देवान्युद्धे निपातय ..6.149.2...
.. प्रह्राद उवाच .. ..
नाहं राज्यं करिष्यामि कथंचिदपि भूतले ..
यतस्ततो निबोधध्वं वचनं मम सांप्रतम् ..21..
दैत्यराज्यं न वांछंति देवाः शक्रपुरोगमाः ..
तेषां रक्षाकरो नित्यं विष्णुः स भगवान्स्वयम् ..22..
अप्यहं सन्त्यजे प्राणान्सर्वस्वं वा न संशयः ..
हरिणा सह संग्रामं नाहं कर्तुमहो क्षमः.. 23 ..
5.148.m:
He himself was torn open in great rage by the all-powerful Viṣṇu / with his claws, having placed him upon his knees and on his back. (17)
To him two sons were born, endowed with the qualities of heroism and nobility; / the elder was called Prahlāda, and the second was Andhaka. (18)
When Hiraṇyakaśipu had gone to the mortal realm, / Prahlāda was then addressed by his companions and ministers endowed with modesty: (19)
"Rule this kingdom of your father and forefathers now; / bear the yoke arising from sovereignty, [and] strike down the gods in battle!" (20)
Prahrāda said: / "I shall not govern the kingdom in any manner whatsoever on the earth's surface; / therefore, understand my word right now. (21)
The gods led by Indra do not desire the dominion of the Daityas; / the lord Viṣṇu himself is ever their protector. (22)
I might abandon my life-breaths or my entire property, there is no doubt; / [yet] oh, I am not capable of waging war against Hari. (23)

5.148.s:
yo mayā'bhyarcito nityaṃ praṇataśca sureśvaraḥ ..
na tena sahito yuddhaṃ kariṣyāmi kathañcana .. 24 .. ..
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
prahlādena ca saṃtyakte rājye pitṛsamudbhave ..
andhakaḥ sthāpitastatra saṃmaṃtrya sacivairmithaḥ .. 25 ..
hiraṇyakaśipoḥ putro devadānavadarpahā ..
so'pi rājyamamātyebhyo nidhāya tadanantaram .. 26 ..
tapaścakre ciraṃ kālaṃ dhyāyamānaḥ pitāmaham ..
tyaktvā kāmaṃ tathā krodhaṃ daṃbhaṃ matsarameva ca .. 27 ..
jiteṃdriyaḥ suśāṃtātmā samaḥ sarveṣu jantuṣu ..
vṛkṣamūlāśrayaḥ śāṃtaḥ saṃtuṣṭenāṃtarātmanā .. 28 ..
yāvadvarṣasahasrāṃtaṃ phalāhāro babhūva ha ..
śīrṇaparṇāśanāhāro yāvadvarṣasahasrakam .. 29 ..
dhyāyamāno divānaktaṃ devadevaṃ pitāmaham ..
vāyubhakṣastato jajñe tāvatkālaṃ dvijottamāḥ .. 6.149.30 ..
5.148.d:
यो मयाऽभ्यर्चितो नित्यं प्रणतश्च सुरेश्वरः ..
न तेन सहितो युद्धं करिष्यामि कथञ्चन .. 24 .. ..
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
प्रह्लादेन च संत्यक्ते राज्ये पितृसमुद्भवे ..
अन्धकः स्थापितस्तत्र संमंत्र्य सचिवैर्मिथः .. 25 ..
हिरण्यकशिपोः पुत्रो देवदानवदर्पहा ..
सोऽपि राज्यममात्येभ्यो निधाय तदनन्तरम् .. 26 ..
तपश्चक्रे चिरं कालं ध्यायमानः पितामहम् ..
त्यक्त्वा कामं तथा क्रोधं दंभं मत्सरमेव च .. 27 ..
जितेंद्रियः सुशांतात्मा समः सर्वेषु जन्तुषु ..
वृक्षमूलाश्रयः शांतः संतुष्टेनांतरात्मना .. 28 ..
यावद्वर्षसहस्रांतं फलाहारो बभूव ह ..
शीर्णपर्णाशनाहारो यावद्वर्षसहस्रकम् .. 29 ..
ध्यायमानो दिवानक्तं देवदेवं पितामहम् ..
वायुभक्षस्ततो जज्ञे तावत्कालं द्विजोत्तमाः .. 6.149.30 ..
5.148.m:
The lord of gods who is worshipped daily and bowed to by me— / with him I shall not wage battle in any manner." (24)
Sūta said: / When the kingdom inherited from his father was abandoned by Prahlāda, / Andhaka was installed there after the ministers took counsel together. (25)
He was the son of Hiraṇyakaśipu, the crusher of the pride of gods and Dānavas. / He, too, having entrusted the kingdom to the ministers thereafter, (26)
performed austerity for a long time, meditating upon the Grandfather [Brahmā], / having abandoned desire as well as anger, hypocrisy, and envy, (27)
with senses subdued, exceedingly tranquil in mind, impartial toward all creatures, / dwelling at the roots of trees, peaceful, with a contented inner self. (28)
For a period of up to a thousand years he subsisted on fruits; / and for a thousand years he subsisted on withered leaves as food. (29)
Day and night he meditated upon the god of gods, the Grandfather [Brahmā]; / then for that much time he became a feeder on wind, O best of the twice-born. (30)

5.148.s:
tato varṣasahasrāṃte caturthe samupasthite ..
tamuvāca svayaṃ brahmā svayamabhyetya harṣitaḥ .. 31 ..
.. brahmovāca .. ..
parituṣṭo'smi te vatsa varaṃ varaya suvrata ..
tuṣṭo'haṃ te pradāsyāmi yadyapi syātsudurlabham ..
.. andhaka uvāca .. ..
yadi yacchasi me brahmanvaraṃ manasi vāṃchitam ..
jarāmaraṇanāśāya dīyatāṃ surasattama .. 33 ..
.. śrībrahmovāca .. ..
na kaścicca jarāhīno vidyate'tra dharātale ..
maraṇena vinā naiva yasya janma bhavetkṣitau .. 34 ..
tathāpi tava dāsyāmi bahudharmaratasya ca ..
tasmātkuru mahābhāga rājyaṃ gatvā nijaṃ gṛham .. 35 ..
bhavedbahuphalaṃ rājyaṃ śmaśānaṃ bhavanaṃ yathā ..
bahukaṇṭakasaṃkīrṇaṃ krūrakarmabhirāvṛtam .. 36 ..
5.148.d:
ततो वर्षसहस्रांते चतुर्थे समुपस्थिते ..
तमुवाच स्वयं ब्रह्मा स्वयमभ्येत्य हर्षितः .. 31 ..
.. ब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
परितुष्टोऽस्मि ते वत्स वरं वरय सुव्रत ..
तुष्टोऽहं ते प्रदास्यामि यद्यपि स्यात्सुदुर्लभम् ..
.. अन्धक उवाच .. ..
यदि यच्छसि मे ब्रह्मन्वरं मनसि वांछितम् ..
जरामरणनाशाय दीयतां सुरसत्तम .. 33 ..
.. श्रीब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
न कश्चिच्च जराहीनो विद्यतेऽत्र धरातले ..
मरणेन विना नैव यस्य जन्म भवेत्क्षितौ .. 34 ..
तथापि तव दास्यामि बहुधर्मरतस्य च ..
तस्मात्कुरु महाभाग राज्यं गत्वा निजं गृहम् .. 35 ..
भवेद्बहुफलं राज्यं श्मशानं भवनं यथा ..
बहुकण्टकसंकीर्णं क्रूरकर्मभिरावृतम् .. 36 ..
5.148.m:
Then, when the fourth thousand of years arrived, / Brahmā himself, having approached him, delighted, spoke to him: (31)
Brahmā said: / "I am fully pleased with you, child; choose a boon, O one of noble vows! / Pleased, I shall grant it to you, even if it be very hard to obtain." / Andhaka said: / "If you grant me the boon desired in my heart, O Brahmā, / let it be given for the cessation of old age and death, O best of gods!" (33)
The venerable Brahmā said: / "No one exists free of old age here on the surface of the earth; / nor indeed does anyone whose birth on earth takes place exist without death. (34)
Nevertheless, I shall grant [a boon] to you who are devoted to many virtues; / therefore, go to your own home, O illustrious one, and govern the kingdom. (35)
Let the kingdom yield great fruit, like a cremation-ground [becomes] a palace; / [though] strewn with many thorns and surrounded by cruel deeds." (36)

5.148.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evamuktvā caturvaktrastataścādarśanaṃ gataḥ ..
kasyacittvatha kālasya preritaḥ kāladharmaṇā ..
provāca sacivānso'tha piturvairamanusmaran .. 37 ..
.. andhaka uvāca .. ..
pitāsmākaṃ hato devaiḥ pitṛvyaśca mahābalaḥ ..
kapaṭena na śauryeṇa tasmāttānsūdayāmyaham .. 38 ..
ko'rthaḥ putreṇa jātena yo na kṛtyaiḥ suśaṃsitaiḥ ..
prākaṭyaṃ yāti sarvatra vaṃśasyāgre dhvajo yathā.. 39..
.. maṃtriṇa ūcuḥ .. ..
yuktametanmahābhāga yattvayā vyāhṛtaṃ vacaḥ ..
vadhyāḥsyurvibudhāḥ sarve ye'smākaṃ paripaṃthinaḥ .. ..6.149.4...
asmākaṃ khalvime lokāḥ ke devāḥ ke dvijātayaḥ ..
yajñabhāgānhariṣyāmo hatvā śakramukhānsurān ..41..
evaṃ te samayaṃ kṛtvā sainyena mahatānvitāḥ ..
prajagmustvaritāstatra yatra śakro vyavasthitaḥ ..42..
5.148.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवमुक्त्वा चतुर्वक्त्रस्ततश्चादर्शनं गतः ..

5.148.m:
Sūta said: / Having spoken thus, the four-faced one vanished from sight. / Then, after some time, impelled by the law of time, / he spoke to his ministers, remembering the enmity of his father: (37)
Andhaka said: / "Our father was slain by the gods, and our uncle of great strength, / by deceit, not by valor; therefore, I shall destroy them. (38)
What purpose is served by a son who is born, if he does not attain prominence / everywhere by well-praised deeds, like a banner before a lineage?" (39)
The ministers said: / "This word which you have spoken, O illustrious one, is proper; / all the gods who are our adversaries deserve to be slain. (40)
Indeed, these worlds are ours; who are the gods, who are the twice-born? / Having slain the gods led by Indra, we shall seize their shares of the sacrifices." (41)
Having thus made an agreement, accompanied by a vast army, / they went swiftly to the place where Indra resided. (42)

5.148.m:
Indra too, seeing the army of Dānavas that had arrived suddenly, / mounted his elephant Airāvata and set forth then for battle. (43)
along with all the host of gods headed by the Vasus, Rudras, and Ādityas. / Meanwhile, Śakra [hurled] the thunderbolt, which was exceedingly terrible,
aiming it at Andhaka, he, the slayer of enemy heroes, released [it]. / Struck by that thunderbolt, that best of Danavas laughed
and, greatly exhilarated, spoke to Śakra with a loud roar in the battle: / “The strength of your arms, O Śakra, has today been seen by me after a long time.
Now behold ours as well, O slayer of Bala!”
Sūta said: / Having spoken thus, he whirled and hurled a heavy mace / that made a great din with a hundred bells, fashioned by Viśvakarman,
made entirely of iron, heavy, like a second tongue of Yama, / a hundred cubits in measure, striking terror into living beings.
Struck by it, Śakra, his senses confounded by fainting, / leaned against his flagstaff and sank down on the elephant's head.

5.148.m:
Then, seeing Śakra unconscious, Skanda was enraged; / he then released his own spear, unfailing and resembling the thunderbolt.
Seeing it approach, the mighty Dānava with sharp arrows / turned it back in play alone.
Then Skanda, too, taking up his bow, loosed against him / arrows resembling venomous serpents, displaying his lightness of weapon.
Meanwhile, all the gods with showers of weapons / covered the army of the Dānavas on every side.
Then all the Dānavas afflicted the army of the gods / with blows, and the heaven-dwellers fled.
Then, seeing the gods broken, he whose mount is the bull, accompanied by his gaṇas, / revealed himself, as if reassuring the gods:
“Fear not, all you deities! Watch my deeds!” / Having spoken thus, the Lord Śambhu, then, by means of Ātharvaṇa mantras,
summoned the supreme, unexcelled Śakti, ruler of the universe. / Being summoned, the supreme Śakti went into Hara's presence.

5.148.m:
Seeing her arrived before him, accompanied by all the gods, / he bowed and praised [her] with devotion through this hymn:
The Lord said: / “Salutations to you, O ruler of the gods of gods! Salutations to you who love devotion! / O omnipresent, all-giving goddess, salutations to you, the bearer of the universe!
Salutations to you who, in the form of Śakti, bring about creation and dissolution! / Salutations to you who are endowed with radiance, whose earrings flare like lightning!
You are Svāhā, you are Svadhā, O goddess, you are creation, you are purity and fortitude; / you are Arundhatī as well as Indrāṇī; you are Lakṣmī, and you are Pārvatī.
Whatever female form exists in all the three worlds, / all that is your own form: such is the determination in the scriptures.”
The goddess said: / “For what purpose have I been summoned by you, O you whose mount is the bull, / by means of terrible Ātharvaṇa mantras? Proclaim all that to me,
so that I may accomplish your entire task as spoken.”

5.148.m:
The Lord said: / “All these gods, Śakra and the others, have been driven from heaven / by Andhaka, O highly fortunate one, the overlord of the Daityas.
Therefore, listen to me as I go forth for his destruction: / render me aid quickly, and I shall destroy him on the field of battle.
All these hosts of mothers have now been given by me to you; / wasted by hunger, they shall destroy the Dānavas who stand before [us].
Because, assuming a form of play in a thousand ways / with many deformed shapes, you were summoned from the midst of the fire,
therefore you shall be known as Kelīśvarī in the three worlds. / Whoever worships you in this very form with devotion
on the eighth and fourteenth [tithis] will have their desire fulfilled. / Moreover, when the time of battle has arrived, whatever king
praises you with this hymn shall attain victory; / even with a small army of his own and few horses in battle,

victory will surely be his by your grace, without doubt.” / Thus addressed by the God of gods at that time, Kelīśvarī
set forth joyfully in front of the army of Bhava, / along with all the hosts of mothers, with fierce, terrifying roars,
intent on eagerness for battle, terrible, striking with various weapons. / Then, seeing that female army arrived,

feeling ashamed even when being struck, steadfast in their manly code. / Meanwhile, the best of sages, Nārada, arrived.

eṣā kelīśvarīnāma vahnikuṇḍādvinirgatā ..
etābhiḥ saha raudrābhiḥ strībhirmaṃtrabalāśrayāt .. 81 ..
svaraktena kṛte home devadevena śambhunā ..
sa eṣa bhagavānkruddhaḥ svayamabhyeti teṃ'tikam .. 82 ..
yuddhāya nijaharmye tānsthāpayitvā surottamān ....
pratijñāya vadhaṃ tubhyaṃ purataḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ .. 83 ..
etajjñātvā mahābhāga yadyuktaṃ tatsamācara .. 84 ..
.. andhaka uvāca .. ..
nāhaṃ bibhemi rudrasya tathānyasyāpi kasyacit ..
na strīṇāṃ prahariṣyāmi pālayanpuruṣavratam .. 85 ..
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evaṃ pravadatastasya dānavasya mahātmanaḥ ..
ākraṃdaḥ sumahāñjajñe tasmindeśe samaṃtataḥ .. 86 ..
5.148.d:
एषा कृत्या वधार्थाय तव रुद्रेण निर्मिता ..
यैषा सिंहसमारूढा चक्रांकितकरा स्थिता .. 6.149.80 ..
एषा केलीश्वरीनाम वह्निकुण्डाद्विनिर्गता ..
एताभिः सह रौद्राभिः स्त्रीभिर्मंत्रबलाश्रयात् .. 81 ..
स्वरक्तेन कृते होमे देवदेवेन शम्भुना ..
स एष भगवान्क्रुद्धः स्वयमभ्येति तेंऽतिकम् .. 82 ..
युद्धाय निजहर्म्ये तान्स्थापयित्वा सुरोत्तमान् ....
प्रतिज्ञाय वधं तुभ्यं पुरतः परमेष्ठिनः .. 83 ..
एतज्ज्ञात्वा महाभाग यद्युक्तं तत्समाचर .. 84 ..
.. अन्धक उवाच .. ..
नाहं बिभेमि रुद्रस्य तथान्यस्यापि कस्यचित् ..
न स्त्रीणां प्रहरिष्यामि पालयन्पुरुषव्रतम् .. 85 ..
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवं प्रवदतस्तस्य दानवस्य महात्मनः ..
आक्रंदः सुमहाञ्जज्ञे तस्मिन्देशे समंततः .. 86 ..
5.148.m:
This is a destructive spirit fashioned by Rudra for your slaying. / She who stands mounted upon a lion, her hands marked with discuses,
is named Kelīśvarī, emerged from the fire-pit / together with these terrible women through the power of mantras,
when a fire-offering was performed by the God of gods, Śambhu, with his own blood. / That enraged Lord is himself approaching your presence
for battle, having stationed those best of gods in his own palace, / and having vowed your destruction before the Supreme Lord.
Knowing this, O highly fortunate one, do whatever is fitting.”
Andhaka said: / “I do not fear Rudra, nor anyone else; / I will not strike women, maintaining the vow of a man.”
Sūta said: / As that great-souled Dānava was speaking thus, / an exceedingly great wailing arose all around in that place.

5.148.s:
bhakṣyante dānavāḥ kecidvadhyante tvatha cāpare ..
ardhabhakṣita gātrāśca praṇaśyaṃti tathā pare .. 87 ..
yudhyamānāstathaivānye śaktimaṃto'pi dānavāḥ ..
bhakṣyaṃte mātṛbhistatra sāyudhāśca savāhanāḥ .. 88 ..
tacchrutvā sa mahākraṃdamaṃdhakaḥ krodhamūrchitaḥ..
ādāya khaḍgamuttasthau kimidaṃ kimidaṃ bruvan .. 89 ..
atha paśyati vidhvastāndānavānbaladarpitān ..
bhakṣyamāṇāstathaivānyānpalāyanaparāyaṇān .. 6.149.90 ..
anyeṣāṃ nihatānāṃ ca rudaṃtyo nikaṭasthitāḥ ..
sa paśyati priyā bhāryāḥ pralapaṃtyo'tiduḥkhitāḥ ..91...
atha tatkadanaṃ dṛṣṭvā aṃdhakaḥ krodhamūrchitaḥ ..
bhartsayāmāsa tāḥ sarvā yoginīḥ samarodyatāḥ .. 92 ..
na ca tāstasya daityasya bhayaṃ cakruḥ kathaṃcana ...
kevalaṃ sūdayaṃti sma bhakṣayaṃti ca dānavān ..93..
5.148.d:
भक्ष्यन्ते दानवाः केचिद्वध्यन्ते त्वथ चापरे ..
अर्धभक्षित गात्राश्च प्रणश्यंति तथा परे .. 87 ..
युध्यमानास्तथैवान्ये शक्तिमंतोऽपि दानवाः ..
भक्ष्यंते मातृभिस्तत्र सायुधाश्च सवाहनाः .. 88 ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा स महाक्रंदमंधकः क्रोधमूर्छितः..
आदाय खड्गमुत्तस्थौ किमिदं किमिदं ब्रुवन् .. 89 ..
अथ पश्यति विध्वस्तान्दानवान्बलदर्पितान् ..
भक्ष्यमाणास्तथैवान्यान्पलायनपरायणान् .. 6.149.90 ..
अन्येषां निहतानां च रुदंत्यो निकटस्थिताः ..
स पश्यति प्रिया भार्याः प्रलपंत्योऽतिदुःखिताः ..91...
अथ तत्कदनं दृष्ट्वा अंधकः क्रोधमूर्छितः ..
भर्त्सयामास ताः सर्वा योगिनीः समरोद्यताः .. 92 ..
न च तास्तस्य दैत्यस्य भयं चक्रुः कथंचन ...
केवलं सूदयंति स्म भक्षयंति च दानवान् ..93..
5.148.m:
Some Dānavas were devoured, while others were slain; / and others, their limbs half-eaten, perished.
Likewise, other powerful dānavas who were fighting / were devoured there by the Mothers, along with their weapons and mounts.
Hearing that great outcry, Andhaka, frantic with rage, / took up his sword and rose, saying, “What is this? What is this?”
Then he saw the dānavas, once proud of their might, shattered, / others being devoured, and still others devoted to flight.
And he saw the beloved wives of the slain standing nearby, / weeping and lamenting, utterly distraught.
Then, seeing that slaughter, Andhaka, frantic with rage, / berated all those Yoginīs engaged in battle.
Yet they felt no fear at all of that daitya; / they merely slaughtered and devoured the dānavas.

5.148.s:
tataḥ sa dānavastāsāṃ dṛṣṭvā tacceṣṭitaṃ ruṣā ..
svasya gātrasya rakṣāṃ sa cakāra bhayasaṃkulaḥ .. 94 ....
tamo'straṃ mumuce raudraṃ kṛtvā rāvaṃ sa tatkṣaṇāt ..
etasminnaṃtare kṛtsnaṃ trailokyaṃ tamasā vṛtam .. 95 ..
na kiṃcijjñāyate tatra samaṃ viṣamameva ca ..
kevalaṃ dānavendraśca sarvaṃ paśyati netaraḥ .. 96 ..
tataḥ sa sūdayāmāsa yoginīstāḥ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ ..
yathāyathā parā nāryastādṛgrūpā bhavanti ca ..97..
atha dṛṣṭvā parāṃ vṛddhiṃ yoginīnāṃ sa dānavaḥ ..
saṃhāraṃ tasya cāstrasya cakāra bhayasaṃkulaḥ .. 98 ..
tataḥ śukraṃ samāsādya dīnaḥ prāha kṛtāṃjaliḥ ..
paśya me bhārgavaśreṣṭha strībhiryatkadanaṃ kṛtam ..99..
avadhyābhirmamāstrāṇāṃ maṃtraśaktyā suradviṣaḥ ..
utpannābhiḥ prabhūtābhirhataṃ me sarvato balam..6.149.1....
5.148.d:
ततः स दानवस्तासां दृष्ट्वा तच्चेष्टितं रुषा ..
स्वस्य गात्रस्य रक्षां स चकार भयसंकुलः .. 94 ....
तमोऽस्त्रं मुमुचे रौद्रं कृत्वा रावं स तत्क्षणात् ..
एतस्मिन्नंतरे कृत्स्नं त्रैलोक्यं तमसा वृतम् .. 95 ..
न किंचिज्ज्ञायते तत्र समं विषममेव च ..
केवलं दानवेन्द्रश्च सर्वं पश्यति नेतरः .. 96 ..
ततः स सूदयामास योगिनीस्ताः शितैः शरैः ..
यथायथा परा नार्यस्तादृग्रूपा भवन्ति च ..97..
अथ दृष्ट्वा परां वृद्धिं योगिनीनां स दानवः ..
संहारं तस्य चास्त्रस्य चकार भयसंकुलः .. 98 ..
ततः शुक्रं समासाद्य दीनः प्राह कृतांजलिः ..
पश्य मे भार्गवश्रेष्ठ स्त्रीभिर्यत्कदनं कृतम् ..99..
अवध्याभिर्ममास्त्राणां मंत्रशक्त्या सुरद्विषः ..
उत्पन्नाभिः प्रभूताभिर्हतं मे सर्वतो बलम्..6.149.1....
5.148.m:
Then, seeing their action with fury, that dānava, / overcome with fear, sought to protect his own body.
Emitting a roar, he immediately released the terrible darkness-weapon; / meanwhile, the entire three worlds were enveloped in darkness.
Nothing could be discerned there, neither level nor uneven ground; / only the lord of the dānavas saw everything, no one else.
Then he slaughtered those Yoginīs with sharp arrows; / [yet] the more [they fell], the more other women appeared in the very same form.
Then, seeing that supreme multiplication of the Yoginīs, that dānava, / overcome with fear, withdrew that weapon.
Then, approaching Śukra, miserable and with folded hands, he said: / “Behold, best of the Bhārgavas, the slaughter wrought by women!
Immune to my weapons, produced through the power of mantras, enemy of the gods, / manifold, they have destroyed my army on every side.

5.148.s:
tasmāttvamapi tāṃ vidyāṃ prasādhaya mahāmate ..
yadi me vāṃchasi śreyo nānyathāsti jayo raṇe .. 101 ..
5.148.d:
तस्मात्त्वमपि तां विद्यां प्रसाधय महामते ..
यदि मे वांछसि श्रेयो नान्यथास्ति जयो रणे .. 101 ..
5.148.m: Therefore, O highly wise one, you too must master that lore, / if you desire my welfare; otherwise there is no victory in battle.”

5.148.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye'ndhakāsuravadhavṛttānte śaṃkarakṛtakelīśvarīprādurbhāvavarṇanaṃnāmaikonapaṃcāśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 149 .. .. cha ..
5.148.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्येऽन्धकासुरवधवृत्तान्ते शंकरकृतकेलीश्वरीप्रादुर्भाववर्णनंनामैकोनपंचाशदुत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 149 .. .. छ ..
5.148.m: Thus ends the one hundred and forty-ninth chapter, titled 'The Description of the Manifestation of Kelīśvarī Created by Śaṃkara in the Account of the Slaying of Andhakāsura,' in the Māhātmya of the Hāṭakeśvara Kṣetra in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth section of the holy Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

5.149.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
śukrastasya vacaḥ śrutvā citte kṛtvā dayāṃ tataḥ ..
hāṭakeśvarajaṃ kṣetraṃ gatvā siddhipradāyakam .. .. 1 ..
5.149.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
शुक्रस्तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा चित्ते कृत्वा दयां ततः ..
हाटकेश्वरजं क्षेत्रं गत्वा सिद्धिप्रदायकम् .. .. 1 ..
5.149.m: Sūta said: / Having heard his words and taking pity in his heart, / Śukra then went to the success-granting sacred field born of Hāṭakeśvara.

5.149.s:
cakāra vidhivaddhomaṃ svamāṃsena hutāśane ..
maṃtrairātharvaṇai raudraiḥ kuṇḍaṃ kṛtvā trikoṇakam .. 2 ..
5.149.d:
चकार विधिवद्धोमं स्वमांसेन हुताशने ..
मंत्रैराथर्वणै रौद्रैः कुण्डं कृत्वा त्रिकोणकम् .. 2 ..
5.149.m: He duly performed an oblation into the sacrificial fire with his own flesh, / using fierce Ātharvaṇa mantras, after preparing a triangular pit.

5.149.s:
evaṃ saṃjuhvatastasya tena vai vidhinā tadā ..
yathā rudreṇa saṃtuṣṭā devī kelīśvarī tadā .. 3 ..
5.149.d:
एवं संजुह्वतस्तस्य तेन वै विधिना तदा ..
यथा रुद्रेण संतुष्टा देवी केलीश्वरी तदा .. 3 ..
5.149.m: As he was offering oblations in that manner at that time, / just as goddess Kelīśvarī had been pleased with Rudra then,

5.149.s:
taṃ provāca sametyāśu śukraṃ daityapurohitam ..
mā tvaṃ bhārgavaśārdūla kuru māṃsaparikṣayam .. 4 ..
5.149.d:
तं प्रोवाच समेत्याशु शुक्रं दैत्यपुरोहितम् ..
मा त्वं भार्गवशार्दूल कुरु मांसपरिक्षयम् .. 4 ..
5.149.m: she quickly approached and said to Śukra, the priest of the daityas: / “Tiger among the Bhārgavas, do not destroy your own flesh!

5.149.s: bhāvitā'haṃ trinetreṇa tatkiṃ brūhi karomi te .. 5 ..
5.149.d: भाविताऽहं त्रिनेत्रेण तत्किं ब्रूहि करोमि ते .. 5 ..
5.149.m: I was manifested by the Three-eyed Lord; so tell me, what shall I do for you?”

5.149.s:
.. śukra uvāca .. ..
yathā rudrasya sāhāyyaṃ tvayātra vihitaṃ śubhe ..
aṃdhakasyā'pi kartavyaṃ tathaivaiṣa varo mama .. 6 ..
5.149.d:
.. शुक्र उवाच .. ..
यथा रुद्रस्य साहाय्यं त्वयात्र विहितं शुभे ..
अंधकस्याऽपि कर्तव्यं तथैवैष वरो मम .. 6 ..
5.149.m: Śukra said: / “Just as assistance was given by you here to Rudra, O auspicious one, / so too must it be given to Andhaka: this is my boon.

5.149.s:
ye keciddānavā yuddhe bhakṣitāśca vināśitāḥ ..
asya sainyasya te sarve punarjīvaṃtu satvaram .. 7 ..
5.149.d:
ये केचिद्दानवा युद्धे भक्षिताश्च विनाशिताः ..
अस्य सैन्यस्य ते सर्वे पुनर्जीवंतु सत्वरम् .. 7 ..
5.149.m: Whatever dānavas belonging to this army have been devoured and destroyed in battle, / let all of them quickly come back to life!”

5.149.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
jīvayiṣyāmi tānsarvāndānavānnihatānraṇe ..
navasaṃbhakṣitānvipra praviṣṭānyoginīmukhe .. 8 ..
5.149.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
जीवयिष्यामि तान्सर्वान्दानवान्निहतान्रणे ..
नवसंभक्षितान्विप्र प्रविष्टान्योगिनीमुखे .. 8 ..
5.149.m: The goddess said: / “I shall restore to life all those dānavas slain in battle, / even those newly devoured, O brahmin, who entered the mouths of the Yoginīs.”

5.149.s:
evamuktvā dadau tasmai sā devī harṣitānanā ..
nāmnā'mṛtavatīṃ vidyāṃ yayā jīvaṃti te mṛtāḥ .. 9 ..
5.149.d:
एवमुक्त्वा ददौ तस्मै सा देवी हर्षितानना ..
नाम्नाऽमृतवतीं विद्यां यया जीवंति ते मृताः .. 9 ..
5.149.m: Having spoken thus, that goddess, her face delighted, gave him / the lore named Amṛtavatī, by which the dead revive.

5.149.s:
tataḥ śukraḥ prahṛṣṭātmā gatvāṃdhakamuvāca ha ..
siddhā kelīśvarī devī yathā śambhostathā mama .. 6.150.10 ..
5.149.d:
ततः शुक्रः प्रहृष्टात्मा गत्वांधकमुवाच ह ..
सिद्धा केलीश्वरी देवी यथा शम्भोस्तथा मम .. 6.150.10 ..
5.149.m: Then Śukra, his soul rejoicing, went and said to Andhaka: / “Goddess Kelīśvarī has been propitiated by me, just as by Śambhu.

5.149.s:
tayā dattā śubhā vidyā mama daityā mṛtāśca ye ..
tānsarvāṃstatprabhāvena yojayiṣyāmi jīvite .. 11 ..
5.149.d:
तया दत्ता शुभा विद्या मम दैत्या मृताश्च ये ..
तान्सर्वांस्तत्प्रभावेन योजयिष्यामि जीविते .. 11 ..
5.149.m: She has granted an auspicious lore; and all those daityas of mine who have died / I shall restore to life by its power.

5.149.s:
tvayā'syāḥ satataṃ bhaktiḥ kāryā dānava sattama ..
aṣṭamyāṃ ca viśeṣeṇa caturdaśyāṃ ca sarvadā .. 12 ..
5.149.d:
त्वयाऽस्याः सततं भक्तिः कार्या दानव सत्तम ..
अष्टम्यां च विशेषेण चतुर्दश्यां च सर्वदा .. 12 ..
5.149.m: Devotion to her must constantly be performed by you, O best of the dānavas, / especially on the eighth and fourteenth days, always.

5.149.s:
eṣā sā paramā śaktiryayā vyāptamidaṃ jagat..
kevalaṃ bhaktisādhyā sā na daṇḍena kathaṃcana .. 13 ..
5.149.d:
एषा सा परमा शक्तिर्यया व्याप्तमिदं जगत्..
केवलं भक्तिसाध्या सा न दण्डेन कथंचन .. 13 ..
5.149.m: She is the supreme power by whom this world is pervaded; / she can be won solely through devotion, never by force.”

5.149.s:
evamuktastu śukreṇa sa tadā dānavādhipaḥ ..
tāṃ devīṃ pūjayāmāsa bhāvabhaktisamanvitaḥ .. 14 ..
5.149.d:
एवमुक्तस्तु शुक्रेण स तदा दानवाधिपः ..
तां देवीं पूजयामास भावभक्तिसमन्वितः .. 14 ..
5.149.m: Addressed thus by Śukra, the lord of the dānavas then / worshiped that goddess, endowed with feeling and devotion.

5.149.s:
stutvā ca vividhaiḥ stotraistataḥ provāca sādaram ..
tathānyā mātaraḥ sarvā yathājyeṣṭhaṃ yathākramam .. 15 ..
5.149.d:
स्तुत्वा च विविधैः स्तोत्रैस्ततः प्रोवाच सादरम् ..
तथान्या मातरः सर्वा यथाज्येष्ठं यथाक्रमम् .. 15 ..
5.149.m: And having praised her with various hymns, he then spoke respectfully, / as well as to all the other Mothers according to seniority and proper order:

5.149.s:
ajñānādyanmayā devi kṛtaḥ kopastavopari ..
marṣaṇīyastathā so'dya dīnasya praṇatasya ca .. 16 ..
5.149.d:
अज्ञानाद्यन्मया देवि कृतः कोपस्तवोपरि ..
मर्षणीयस्तथा सोऽद्य दीनस्य प्रणतस्य च .. 16 ..
5.149.m: “Whatever anger I showed toward you out of ignorance, O goddess, / should be forgiven today toward one who is miserable and bowed down.”

5.149.s:
.. śrīdevyuvāca .. ..
parituṣṭā'smi te vatsa prabhāvādbhārgavasya ca ..
varaṃ varaya tasmāttvaṃ na vṛthā darśanaṃ mama .. 17 ..
5.149.d:
.. श्रीदेव्युवाच .. ..
परितुष्टाऽस्मि ते वत्स प्रभावाद्भार्गवस्य च ..
वरं वरय तस्मात्त्वं न वृथा दर्शनं मम .. 17 ..
5.149.m: The holy Goddess said: / “I am well pleased with you, child, and by the power of the Bhārgava; / choose a boon, therefore; darśana of me is never in vain.”

5.149.s:
.. andhaka uvāca .. ..
anenaiva tu rūpeṇa ye tvāṃ dhyāyaṃti dehinaḥ ..
pūjayaṃti ca sadbhaktyā saṃsthāpya pratimāṃ tava ..
teṣāṃ siddhiḥ pradātavyā tvayā hṛdayavāṃchitā .. 18 ..
5.149.d:
.. अन्धक उवाच .. ..
अनेनैव तु रूपेण ये त्वां ध्यायंति देहिनः ..
पूजयंति च सद्भक्त्या संस्थाप्य प्रतिमां तव ..
तेषां सिद्धिः प्रदातव्या त्वया हृदयवांछिता .. 18 ..
5.149.m: Andhaka said: / “Whatever embodied beings meditate on you in this very form / and worship with true devotion after installing an image of you, / to them you must grant their heart’s desired perfection.”

5.149.s:
devyuvāca .. ..
yo māmanena rūpeṇa sthāpayiṣyati mānavaḥ ..
tasya mokṣaṃ pradāsyāmi pāpasyāpi na saṃśayaḥ .. 19 ..
5.149.d:
देव्युवाच .. ..
यो मामनेन रूपेण स्थापयिष्यति मानवः ..
तस्य मोक्षं प्रदास्यामि पापस्यापि न संशयः .. 19 ..
5.149.m: The goddess said: / “Whoever shall install me in this form, / to him I shall grant liberation, even if he is a sinner, without a doubt.

5.149.s:
yo'ṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ mama pūjāṃ kariṣyati ..
tasmai svargaṃ pradāsyāmi pāpasyāpi danūttama .. 6.150.20 ..
5.149.d:
योऽष्टम्यां च चतुर्दश्यां मम पूजां करिष्यति ..
तस्मै स्वर्गं प्रदास्यामि पापस्यापि दनूत्तम .. 6.150.20 ..
5.149.m: Whoever performs my worship on the eighth and fourteenth days, / to him I shall grant heaven, even if he is a sinner, O best of Danu's lineage.

5.149.s:
kevalaṃ darśanaṃ yaśca dhyānaṃ vā me kariṣyati ..
tasya rājyaṃ pradāsyāmi bhogānmānuṣasaṃbhavān . 21 ..
5.149.d:
केवलं दर्शनं यश्च ध्यानं वा मे करिष्यति ..
तस्य राज्यं प्रदास्यामि भोगान्मानुषसंभवान् . 21 ..
5.149.m: And whoever merely has darśana of me or meditates on me, / to him I shall grant sovereignty and pleasures born of human birth.”

5.149.s:
evamuktvā'tha sā devī tataścādarśanaṃ gatā ..
taiśca mātṛgaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ paśyatastasya tatkṣaṇāt . 22 ..
5.149.d:
एवमुक्त्वाऽथ सा देवी ततश्चादर्शनं गता ..
तैश्च मातृगणैः सार्धं पश्यतस्तस्य तत्क्षणात् . 22 ..
5.149.m: Having spoken thus, that goddess then vanished from sight / along with the hosts of Mothers, before his eyes, in an instant.

5.149.s:
śakro'pi dānavānsarvāṃstayā saṃsiddhayā tataḥ ..
mṛtānsaṃjīvayāmāsa daiteyānnavabhakṣitān .. 23 ..
5.149.d:
शक्रोऽपि दानवान्सर्वांस्तया संसिद्धया ततः ..
मृतान्संजीवयामास दैतेयान्नवभक्षितान् .. 23 ..
5.149.m: Then Śukra also, through that [lore] successfully accomplished by her, / revived all those dead dānavas, the daityas newly devoured.

5.149.s:
taiḥ sametya sa daityendraḥ prahṛṣṭenāṃtarātmanā ..
tāṃ purīṃ prāpya śakrasya rājyaṃ cakre divāniśam .. 24 ..
5.149.d:
तैः समेत्य स दैत्येन्द्रः प्रहृष्टेनांतरात्मना ..
तां पुरीं प्राप्य शक्रस्य राज्यं चक्रे दिवानिशम् .. 24 ..
5.149.m: Reunited with them, that lord of daityas, with a delighted inner soul, / reached that city of Śakra and ruled day and night,

5.149.s:
tāṃ devīṃ dhyāyamānastu pūjayāno divāniśam ..
aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ viśeṣeṇa mahābalaḥ .. 25
5.149.d:
तां देवीं ध्यायमानस्तु पूजयानो दिवानिशम् ..
अष्टम्यां च चतुर्दश्यां विशेषेण महाबलः .. 25
5.149.m: meditating on that goddess and worshiping her day and night, / especially on the eighth and fourteenth days, endowed with great power.

5.149.s:
atha tasyāḥ prabhāvaṃ taṃ jñātvā vyāsasamudbhavaḥ ..
sthāne'tra sthāpayāmāsa saṃsiddhiṃ pa parāṃ gataḥ .. 26 ..
5.149.d:
अथ तस्याः प्रभावं तं ज्ञात्वा व्याससमुद्भवः ..
स्थानेऽत्र स्थापयामास संसिद्धिं प परां गतः .. 26 ..
5.149.m: Then, knowing that power of hers, he who was born of Vyāsa / installed [her] in this place and attained supreme perfection.

5.149.s:
.. sūta uvāca . ..
evaṃ kelīśvara devī saṃjātā parameśvarī ..
tasmātsthāpyā ca pūjyā ca dhyeyā caiva viśeṣataḥ .. 27 ..
5.149.d:
.. सूत उवाच . ..
एवं केलीश्वर देवी संजाता परमेश्वरी ..
तस्मात्स्थाप्या च पूज्या च ध्येया चैव विशेषतः .. 27 ..
5.149.m: Sūta said: / Thus the Supreme Goddess Kelīśvarī came into being; / therefore she should especially be installed, worshipped, and meditated upon. // 27

5.149.s:
evaṃ devyā naro yaśca paṭhate vā śṛṇoti vā ..
vācyamānaṃ sa mucyeta vyasanena garīyasā .. 28 ..
5.149.d:
एवं देव्या नरो यश्च पठते वा शृणोति वा ..
वाच्यमानं स मुच्येत व्यसनेन गरीयसा .. 28 ..
5.149.m: Whatever man reads or hears [this] concerning the Goddess, / or has it recited, is delivered from grave distress. // 28

5.149.s:
bhraṣṭarājyo'thavā rājā yaḥ śṛṇotyaṣṭamīdine ..
sa rājyaṃ labhate bhūyo nikhilaṃ hatakaṃṭakam .. 29 ..
5.149.d:
भ्रष्टराज्योऽथवा राजा यः शृणोत्यष्टमीदिने ..
स राज्यं लभते भूयो निखिलं हतकंटकम् .. 29 ..
5.149.m: Or if a king deprived of his kingdom listens to it on the eighth day, / he gains his entire realm back, free of all thorns [of opposition]. // 29

5.149.s:
yuddhakāle ca saṃprāpte yaścaitacchṛṇuyānnaraḥ ..
sa hatvā śatrusaṃghātaṃ vijayaṃ ca samāpnuyāt .. 6.150.30 .. iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye kelīśvarīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcāśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 150 . .. .
5.149.d:
युद्धकाले च संप्राप्ते यश्चैतच्छृणुयान्नरः ..
स हत्वा शत्रुसंघातं विजयं च समाप्नुयात् .. 6.150.30 .. इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये केलीश्वरीमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम पञ्चाशदुत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 150 . .. .
5.149.m:
And whatever man should hear this when the time of battle arrives, / having slain the host of enemies, he attains victory. // 30
Thus ends the one hundred and fiftieth chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of Kelīśvarī', in the Māhātmya of the Hāṭakeśvara Sacred Field, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] of the auspicious Skandapurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses]. // 150

5.150.s:
.. .. sūta uvāca .. ..
andhako'pi parāṃ vidyāṃ jñātvā śukrārjitāṃ tadā ..
kelīśvaryāḥ prasādaṃ ca bhaktijaṃ balavṛddhidam.. 1 ..
5.150.d:
.. .. सूत उवाच .. ..
अन्धकोऽपि परां विद्यां ज्ञात्वा शुक्रार्जितां तदा ..
केलीश्वर्याः प्रसादं च भक्तिजं बलवृद्धिदम्.. 1 ..
5.150.m: Sūta said: / When Andhaka, too, learned of that supreme lore obtained by Śukra / and the grace of Kelīśvarī, born of devotion and bestowing an increase of strength, // 1

5.150.s:
avadhyatāmātmanaśca pitāmahavarodbhavam ..
maheśvaraṃ samuddiśya kopaṃ cakre tataḥ param .. 2 ..
5.150.d:
अवध्यतामात्मनश्च पितामहवरोद्भवम् ..
महेश्वरं समुद्दिश्य कोपं चक्रे ततः परम् .. 2 ..
5.150.m: and of his own invulnerability born of the boon of the Grandfather [Brahmā], / he then felt anger directed toward Maheśvara. // 2

5.150.s:
dūtaṃ ca preṣayāmāsa kailāsaṃ parvataṃ prati ..
gaccha dūta haraṃ brūhi mama vākyena sāṃpratam .. 3 ..
5.150.d:
दूतं च प्रेषयामास कैलासं पर्वतं प्रति ..
गच्छ दूत हरं ब्रूहि मम वाक्येन सांप्रतम् .. 3 ..
5.150.m: And he sent a messenger to Mount Kailāsa: / 'Go, messenger, and speak now to Hara in my words: // 3

5.150.s:
śakramenaṃ parityajya sukhaṃ tiṣṭhātra parvate ..
no ceddrutaṃ samāgatya sakailāsaṃ sabhāryakam.. 4 ..
5.150.d:
शक्रमेनं परित्यज्य सुखं तिष्ठात्र पर्वते ..
नो चेद्द्रुतं समागत्य सकैलासं सभार्यकम्.. 4 ..
5.150.m: "Abandon this Śakra and dwell happily here on the mountain; / otherwise, having arrived swiftly, along with Kailāsa, along with your wife, // 4

5.150.s:
sagaṇaṃ ca raṇe hatvā sukhī sthāsyāmi naṃdane ..
tvāmahaṃ nāśayiṣyāmi satyenātmānamālabhe .. 5 ..
5.150.d:
सगणं च रणे हत्वा सुखी स्थास्यामि नंदने ..
त्वामहं नाशयिष्यामि सत्येनात्मानमालभे .. 5 ..
5.150.m: and along with your attendants, having slain [you] in battle, I shall dwell happily in the Nandana grove. / I will destroy you; I swear by my own life." // 5

5.150.s:
evamuktaḥ sa daityena dūto gatvā drutaṃ tataḥ ..
provāca śaṃkaraṃ vākyaiḥ paruṣaiḥ sa viśeṣataḥ .. 6 ..
5.150.d:
एवमुक्तः स दैत्येन दूतो गत्वा द्रुतं ततः ..
प्रोवाच शंकरं वाक्यैः परुषैः स विशेषतः .. 6 ..
5.150.m: Thus addressed by the Daitya, the messenger went swiftly from there / and spoke to Śaṃkara in harsh words, in particular. // 6

5.150.s:
tataḥ kopaparītātmā bhagavānvṛṣabhadhvajaḥ ..
gaṇānsaṃpreṣayāmāsa vadhārthaṃ tasya durmateḥ .. 7 ..
5.150.d:
ततः कोपपरीतात्मा भगवान्वृषभध्वजः ..
गणान्संप्रेषयामास वधार्थं तस्य दुर्मतेः .. 7 ..
5.150.m: Then the blessed lord whose banner is the bull, his mind seized by fury, / sent forth his attendants for the slaying of that evil-minded one: // 7

5.150.s:
vīrabhadraṃ mahākālaṃ naṃdiṃ hastimukhaṃ tathā ..
aghoraṃ ghoranādaṃ ca ghoraghaṃṭaṃ mahābalam .. 8 ..
5.150.d:
वीरभद्रं महाकालं नंदिं हस्तिमुखं तथा ..
अघोरं घोरनादं च घोरघंटं महाबलम् .. 8 ..
5.150.m: Vīrabhadra, Mahākāla, Nandi, as well as the Elephant-faced [Gaṇeśa], / Aghora, Ghoranāda, and the exceedingly powerful Ghoraghaṇṭa. // 8

5.150.s:
eteṣāmanugāścānye koṭirekā pṛthakpṛthak..
sarvānsaṃpreṣayāmāsa vadhārthaṃ tasya durmateḥ .. 9 ..
5.150.d:
एतेषामनुगाश्चान्ये कोटिरेका पृथक्पृथक्..
सर्वान्संप्रेषयामास वधार्थं तस्य दुर्मतेः .. 9 ..
5.150.m: And of each of these, other followers numbered ten million; / he sent them all forth for the slaying of that evil-minded one. // 9

5.150.s:
atha saṃpreṣitāstena gaṇāste vikṛtānanāḥ ..
harṣeṇa mahatāviṣṭā garjamānā yathā ghanāḥ .. 6.151.10 ..
5.150.d:
अथ संप्रेषितास्तेन गणास्ते विकृताननाः ..
हर्षेण महताविष्टा गर्जमाना यथा घनाः .. 6.151.10 ..
5.150.m: Then, dispatched by him, those attendants with deformed faces, / filled with great joy, roared like storm clouds. // 10

5.150.s:
dhṛtāyudhā gatāḥ sarve yuddhārthaṃ yatra sā purī ..
śakrasyāsāditā tena dānavena balīyasā .. 11 ..
5.150.d:
धृतायुधा गताः सर्वे युद्धार्थं यत्र सा पुरी ..
शक्रस्यासादिता तेन दानवेन बलीयसा .. 11 ..
5.150.m: Taking up weapons, they all went to fight where that city lay, / the city of Śakra seized by that mighty Dānava. // 11

5.150.s:
atha prāptāngaṇāndṛṣṭvā dānavāste dhṛtāyudhāḥ ..
niścakramurvai sahasā yuddhārthamatigarvitāḥ .. 12 ..
5.150.d:
अथ प्राप्तान्गणान्दृष्ट्वा दानवास्ते धृतायुधाः ..
निश्चक्रमुर्वै सहसा युद्धार्थमतिगर्विताः .. 12 ..
5.150.m: Then, seeing the attendants arrived, those Dānavas took up weapons / and rushed out at once, eager for battle and exceedingly proud. // 12

5.150.s:
tataḥ samabhavadyuddhaṃ gaṇānāṃ dānavaiḥ saha ..
parasparaṃ mahāraudraṃ mṛtyuṃ kṛtvā nivartanam .. 13 ..
5.150.d:
ततः समभवद्युद्धं गणानां दानवैः सह ..
परस्परं महारौद्रं मृत्युं कृत्वा निवर्तनम् .. 13 ..
5.150.m: Then a battle ensued between the attendants and the Dānavas / against one another, terribly fierce, in which death alone was retreat. // 13

5.150.s:
tato haragaṇāḥ sarve dānavaistai raṇājire ..
jitā jagmurdiśo bhītā haravīkṣaṇatatparāḥ .. 14 ..
5.150.d:
ततो हरगणाः सर्वे दानवैस्तै रणाजिरे ..
जिता जग्मुर्दिशो भीता हरवीक्षणतत्पराः .. 14 ..
5.150.m: Then all the attendants of Hara, defeated in the arena of battle by those Dānavas, / fled in fear in all directions, looking only toward Hara. // 14

5.150.s:
haro'pi tāngaṇānbhagnāndṛṣṭvā kopādviniryayau ..
haraṃ dṛṣṭvā tato daityā duddruvuste diśo daśa .. 15 .
5.150.d:
हरोऽपि तान्गणान्भग्नान्दृष्ट्वा कोपाद्विनिर्ययौ ..
हरं दृष्ट्वा ततो दैत्या दुद्द्रुवुस्ते दिशो दश .. 15 .
5.150.m: Hara, too, seeing those attendants routed, marched forth in anger. / Seeing Hara, the Daityas then fled in the ten directions. // 15

5.150.s:
andhako'pi haraṃ dṛṣṭvā yuddhārthaṃ saṃmukho yayau .
tato yuddhaṃ samabhavadaṃdhakasya hareṇa tu ..
vṛtravāsavayoḥ pūrvaṃ yathā yuddhamabhūnmahat .. 16 ..
5.150.d:
अन्धकोऽपि हरं दृष्ट्वा युद्धार्थं संमुखो ययौ .
ततो युद्धं समभवदंधकस्य हरेण तु ..
वृत्रवासवयोः पूर्वं यथा युद्धमभून्महत् .. 16 ..
5.150.m: Andhaka also, seeing Hara, advanced face to face for battle. / Then a fight took place between Andhaka and Hara, / just as there had been of old a great battle between Vṛtra and Vāsava. // 16

5.150.s:
cakranālīkanārācaistomaraiḥ khaḍgamudgaraiḥ..
evaṃ na śakyate haṃtuṃ dānavo vividhāyudhaiḥ .. 17 ..
5.150.d:
चक्रनालीकनाराचैस्तोमरैः खड्गमुद्गरैः..
एवं न शक्यते हंतुं दानवो विविधायुधैः .. 17 ..
5.150.m: With discuses, iron tubes, iron arrows, javelins, swords, and clubs— / in this way the Dānava could not be slain by diverse weapons. // 17

5.150.s:
astrayuddhaṃ parityajya bāhu yuddhamupāgatau ..
karaṃ kareṇa saṃgṛhya muṣṭipraharaṇau tadā..18.
5.150.d:
अस्त्रयुद्धं परित्यज्य बाहु युद्धमुपागतौ ..
करं करेण संगृह्य मुष्टिप्रहरणौ तदा..18.
5.150.m: Abandoning weapon-fighting, they engaged in arm-to-arm combat, / seizing hand with hand, striking with fists at that time. // 18

5.150.s:
dānavenātha deveśo baṃdhenākramya pīḍitaḥ .
niṣpaṃdabhāvamāpannastato mūrcchāmupāgataḥ ..19..
5.150.d:
दानवेनाथ देवेशो बंधेनाक्रम्य पीडितः .
निष्पंदभावमापन्नस्ततो मूर्च्छामुपागतः ..19..
5.150.m: Then the lord of gods, pressed down and afflicted by the hold of the Dānava, / became completely motionless and fell into a swoon. // 19

5.150.s:
mūrchāgataṃ tu tajjñātvā hyandhako niryayau gṛhāt ..
tāvatsthāṇuḥ kṣaṇāllabdhvā cetanāmāttakārmukaḥ .. 6.151.20 ..
5.150.d:
मूर्छागतं तु तज्ज्ञात्वा ह्यन्धको निर्ययौ गृहात् ..
तावत्स्थाणुः क्षणाल्लब्ध्वा चेतनामात्तकार्मुकः .. 6.151.20 ..
5.150.m: Knowing that he had fallen into a swoon, Andhaka went out of the palace; / meanwhile Sthāṇu, regaining consciousness in a moment, took up his bow. // 20

5.150.s:
āyasīṃ lakuṭīṃ gṛhya prabhurbhārasahasi kām ..
dānavendraṃ tataḥ prāpya tāḍayāmāsa mūrdhani .. 21 ..
5.150.d:
आयसीं लकुटीं गृह्य प्रभुर्भारसहसि काम् ..
दानवेन्द्रं ततः प्राप्य ताडयामास मूर्धनि .. 21 ..
5.150.m: Grasping an iron club capable of bearing great weight, the Lord, / having then reached the king of Dānavas, struck him on the head. // 21

5.150.s:
so'pi khaḍgena deveśaṃ tāḍayāmāsa vegataḥ ..
atha devo'pi sasmāra kauberāstraṃ mahāhave .. .. 22..
5.150.d:
सोऽपि खड्गेन देवेशं ताडयामास वेगतः ..
अथ देवोऽपि सस्मार कौबेरास्त्रं महाहवे .. .. 22..
5.150.m: He too struck the lord of gods forcefully with a sword; / then the god also recalled the Kaubera missile in that great battle. // 22

5.150.s:
astreṇa tena hṛdaye tāḍayāmāsa dānavam ..
tataḥ sa tāḍitastena rudhirodgāramudvaman .. 23 ..
5.150.d:
अस्त्रेण तेन हृदये ताडयामास दानवम् ..
ततः स ताडितस्तेन रुधिरोद्गारमुद्वमन् .. 23 ..
5.150.m: With that missile he struck the Dānava in the heart. / Then, struck by it, he vomited out a stream of blood, // 23

5.150.s:
patito'dhomukho bhūtvā tataḥ śūlena bheditaḥ..
śūlāgrasaṃsthitaḥ pāpaścakravadbhramate tataḥ .. 24 ..
5.150.d:
पतितोऽधोमुखो भूत्वा ततः शूलेन भेदितः..
शूलाग्रसंस्थितः पापश्चक्रवद्भ्रमते ततः .. 24 ..
5.150.m: and fell face downwards; then he was pierced by the trident. / Fixed on the tip of the trident, the wicked one then spun like a wheel. // 24

5.150.s:
andhako'pi tadātmānaṃ tathāvasthamavekṣya ca ..
tato vāgbhiḥ supuṣṭābhirastauddevaṃ maheśvaram .. 25 ..
5.150.d:
अन्धकोऽपि तदात्मानं तथावस्थमवेक्ष्य च ..
ततो वाग्भिः सुपुष्टाभिरस्तौद्देवं महेश्वरम् .. 25 ..
5.150.m: Andhaka, seeing himself in such a condition, / then praised the god Maheśvara with fully eloquent words. // 25

5.150.s:
.. .. andhaka uvāca .. ..
namaste jagatāṃ dhātre śarvāya triguṇātmane ..
vṛṣabhāsanasaṃsthāya śaśāṃkakṛtabhūṣaṇa .. 26 ..
5.150.d:
.. .. अन्धक उवाच .. ..
नमस्ते जगतां धात्रे शर्वाय त्रिगुणात्मने ..
वृषभासनसंस्थाय शशांककृतभूषण .. 26 ..
5.150.m: Andhaka said: / 'Homage to you, the creator of the worlds, to Śarva, the embodiment of the three guṇas, / to the one who sits upon the bull, O you adorned with the crescent moon! // 26

5.150.s:
namaḥ khaṭvāṃgahastāya namaḥ śūladharāya ca ..
namo ḍamarukodaṇḍakapālānaladhāriṇe .. 27 ..
5.150.d:
नमः खट्वांगहस्ताय नमः शूलधराय च ..
नमो डमरुकोदण्डकपालानलधारिणे .. 27 ..
5.150.m: Homage to the one who holds the skull-topped staff in hand, and homage to the bearer of the trident; / homage to the holder of the hand-drum, the bow, the skull-bowl, and the fire! // 27

5.150.s:
smaradehavināśāya mūrtyaṣṭakamayātmane ..
namaḥ svarūpadehāya hyarūpabahurū piṇe .. 28 ..
5.150.d:
स्मरदेहविनाशाय मूर्त्यष्टकमयात्मने ..
नमः स्वरूपदेहाय ह्यरूपबहुरू पिणे .. 28 ..
5.150.m: To the destroyer of the body of Smara, to the one whose essence consists of the eightfold form, / homage to the one whose form is his own true nature, who is formless and multiform! // 28

5.150.s:
uttamāṃgavināśāya viriṃceḥ sṛṣṭikāriṇe ..
smaśānavāsine nityaṃ namo bhairavarūpiṇe .. 29 ..
5.150.d:
उत्तमांगविनाशाय विरिंचेः सृष्टिकारिणे ..
स्मशानवासिने नित्यं नमो भैरवरूपिणे .. 29 ..
5.150.m: To the destroyer of the head of Viriñci [Brahmā], to the author of creation, / to the perpetual dweller in cremation grounds, homage to the one whose form is Bhairava! // 29

5.150.s:
sarvagaḥ sarvakartā ca tvaṃ hartā nānya eva hi ..
tvaṃ bhūmistvaṃ rajaścaiva tvaṃ jyotistvaṃ tamastathā .. 6.151.30 ..
5.150.d:
सर्वगः सर्वकर्ता च त्वं हर्ता नान्य एव हि ..
त्वं भूमिस्त्वं रजश्चैव त्वं ज्योतिस्त्वं तमस्तथा .. 6.151.30 ..
5.150.m: You are all-pervading, the maker of all, and indeed the destroyer—none other. / You are the earth, and you are passion; you are light, and likewise darkness. // 30

5.150.s:
tvaṃ vapuḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ jīvabhūto maheśvara ..
astaudevaṃ dānavendro devaśūlāgra saṃsthitaḥ .. 31 ..
5.150.d:
त्वं वपुः सर्वभूतानां जीवभूतो महेश्वर ..
अस्तौदेवं दानवेन्द्रो देवशूलाग्र संस्थितः .. 31 ..
5.150.m: You are the body of all beings; you are the soul [within them], O Maheśvara!' / Thus the king of Dānavas praised him, impaled on the tip of the god's trident. // 31

5.150.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evaṃ tasya stutiṃ śrutvā parituṣṭo maheśvaraḥ ..
tataḥ provāca taṃ harṣācchūlāgrasthaṃ danūttamam .. 32 .. ..
5.150.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवं तस्य स्तुतिं श्रुत्वा परितुष्टो महेश्वरः ..
ततः प्रोवाच तं हर्षाच्छूलाग्रस्थं दनूत्तमम् .. 32 .. ..
5.150.m: Sūta said: / Hearing this hymn of his, Maheśvara was well pleased; / then, in joy, he spoke to that foremost of Danu's sons impaled on the tip of the trident: // 32

5.150.s:
.. śrībhagavānuvāca .. ..
nedaṃ vīravrataṃ daitya yacchatrukarapīḍanāt ..
procyante sāmavākyāni viśeṣāddaityajanmanā .. 33 ..
5.150.d:
.. श्रीभगवानुवाच .. ..
नेदं वीरव्रतं दैत्य यच्छत्रुकरपीडनात् ..
प्रोच्यन्ते सामवाक्यानि विशेषाद्दैत्यजन्मना .. 33 ..
5.150.m: The Blessed Lord said: / 'This is no warrior's vow, O Daitya, that out of oppression by an enemy's hand / words of conciliation are spoken, especially by one of Daitya birth!' // 33

5.150.s:
.. andhaka uvāca .. ..
nirviṇṇo'smi suraśreṣṭha triśūlā'graṃ samāśritaḥ ..
tasmātsūdaya māṃ yena drutaṃ syānme vyathākṣayaḥ .. 34 ..
5.150.d:
.. अन्धक उवाच .. ..
निर्विण्णोऽस्मि सुरश्रेष्ठ त्रिशूलाऽग्रं समाश्रितः ..
तस्मात्सूदय मां येन द्रुतं स्यान्मे व्यथाक्षयः .. 34 ..
5.150.m: Andhaka said: / 'I am despondent, O best of gods, resting upon the tip of your trident; / therefore kill me, so that the end of my agony may come swiftly!' // 34

5.150.s:
.. śrībhagavānuvāca .. ..
na te'sti maraṇaṃ daitya kathaṃcicciṃtitaṃ mayā ..
tenetthaṃ vidhṛtaṃ vyomni bhittvā śūlena vakṣasi .. 35 ..
5.150.d:
.. श्रीभगवानुवाच .. ..
न तेऽस्ति मरणं दैत्य कथंचिच्चिंतितं मया ..
तेनेत्थं विधृतं व्योम्नि भित्त्वा शूलेन वक्षसि .. 35 ..
5.150.m: The Blessed Lord said: / 'There is no death for you, O Daitya; somehow it was considered by me, / and therefore [you are] held thus in the air, having been pierced in the chest with the trident. // 35

5.150.s:
tasmāttvaṃ gaṇatāṃ gaccha sāṃprataṃ pāpavarjitaḥ ..
tyaktvā dānavajaṃ bhāvaṃ śraddhayā parayā yutaḥ .. 36 ..
5.150.d:
तस्मात्त्वं गणतां गच्छ सांप्रतं पापवर्जितः ..
त्यक्त्वा दानवजं भावं श्रद्धया परया युतः .. 36 ..
5.150.m: Therefore, freed from sin now, become one of my attendants, / having abandoned the nature born of Dānavas, endowed with supreme faith!' // 36

5.150.s:
.. andhaka uvāca .. ..
gato me dānavo bhāvaḥ sāṃprataṃ tava kiṃkaraḥ ..
bhaviṣyāmi na sandehaḥ satyenātmānamālabhe .. 37 ..
5.150.d:
.. अन्धक उवाच .. ..
गतो मे दानवो भावः सांप्रतं तव किंकरः ..
भविष्यामि न सन्देहः सत्येनात्मानमालभे .. 37 ..
5.150.m: Andhaka said: / Gone is my demonic nature; now I will be your servant, / there is no doubt. I swear by my own self on truth.

5.150.s:
.. śaṃkara uvāca .. ..
parituṣṭo'smi te vatsa brūhi yatte'bhivāṃchitam ..
prārthayasva prayacchāmi yadyapi syātsudurlabham .. 38 ..
5.150.d:
.. शंकर उवाच .. ..
परितुष्टोऽस्मि ते वत्स ब्रूहि यत्तेऽभिवांछितम् ..
प्रार्थयस्व प्रयच्छामि यद्यपि स्यात्सुदुर्लभम् .. 38 ..
5.150.m: Śaṃkara said: / I am pleased with you, child; speak what you desire! / Ask, and I shall give it, even if it is very difficult to obtain.

5.150.s:
.. andhaka uvāca .. ..
anenaiva tu rūpeṇa śṛlāgrasthitamattanum ..
yo martyorccāṃ prakṛtvā te sthāpayiṣyati bhūtale .. .. 39 ..
5.150.d:
.. अन्धक उवाच .. ..
अनेनैव तु रूपेण शृलाग्रस्थितमत्तनुम् ..
यो मर्त्योर्च्चां प्रकृत्वा ते स्थापयिष्यति भूतले .. .. 39 ..
5.150.m: Andhaka said: / Whichever mortal, having fashioned an image of you in this very form, / with my body pierced on the point of your spear, establishes it upon the earth,

5.150.s:
tasya mokṣastvayā deyo madvākyātsurasattama ..
tathetyuktvā maheśastaṃ śūlāgrātpramumoca ha ..
asthiśeṣaṃ kṛśāṃgaṃ ca cāmuṇḍāsadṛśaṃ dvijāḥ .. 6.151.40 ..
5.150.d:
तस्य मोक्षस्त्वया देयो मद्वाक्यात्सुरसत्तम ..
तथेत्युक्त्वा महेशस्तं शूलाग्रात्प्रमुमोच ह ..
अस्थिशेषं कृशांगं च चामुण्डासदृशं द्विजाः .. 6.151.40 ..
5.150.m: to him liberation must be granted by you at my word, O best of gods! / Saying 'So be it,' the Great Lord released him from the tip of his trident, / reduced to mere bones, with an emaciated body, resembling Cāmuṇḍā, O twice-borns.

5.150.s:
tataḥ sa gaṇatāṃ prāpto gītaṃ cakre manoharam ..
purato devadevasya pārvatyāśca viśeṣataḥ .. 41 ..
5.150.d:
ततः स गणतां प्राप्तो गीतं चक्रे मनोहरम् ..
पुरतो देवदेवस्य पार्वत्याश्च विशेषतः .. 41 ..
5.150.m: Then, having attained the status of an attendant, he produced delightful singing / before the god of gods, and especially before Pārvatī.

5.150.s:
bhṛṃgavadraṭanaṃ yasmāttasya śrotrasukhā vaham ..
bhṛṃgīriṭi iti proktastataḥ sa tripurāriṇā .. 42 ..
5.150.d:
भृंगवद्रटनं यस्मात्तस्य श्रोत्रसुखा वहम् ..
भृंगीरिटि इति प्रोक्तस्ततः स त्रिपुरारिणा .. 42 ..
5.150.m: Because his humming like a bee brought delight to the ear, / he was therefore named Bhṛṅgīriṭi by the enemy of Tripura.

5.150.s:
evaṃ sa gaṇatāṃ prāpto devadevasya śūlinaḥ ..
viśvāsyaḥ sarvakṛtyeṣu tatparaṃ samapadyata .. .. 43 ..
5.150.d:
एवं स गणतां प्राप्तो देवदेवस्य शूलिनः ..
विश्वास्यः सर्वकृत्येषु तत्परं समपद्यत .. .. 43 ..
5.150.m: Having thus attained the status of an attendant of the trident-bearing god of gods, / he became trustworthy in all tasks, entirely devoted to him.

5.150.s:
tataḥprabhṛti loke'tra devadevo maheśvaraḥ ..
tādṛśenaiva rūpeṇa sthāpyate bhūtale janaiḥ .. 44 ..
5.150.d:
ततःप्रभृति लोकेऽत्र देवदेवो महेश्वरः ..
तादृशेनैव रूपेण स्थाप्यते भूतले जनैः .. 44 ..
5.150.m: From that time onwards in this world, the Great Lord, the god of gods, / is established on earth by people in that very form.

5.150.s:
prāpyate'tra parā siddhistatprasādādalau kikī ..
kasyacittvatha kālasya rājyādbhraṣṭo mahīpatiḥ .. 45 ..
5.150.d:
प्राप्यतेऽत्र परा सिद्धिस्तत्प्रसादादलौ किकी ..
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य राज्याद्भ्रष्टो महीपतिः .. 45 ..
5.150.m: Supreme, extraordinary perfection is attained here by his grace. / Now, at a certain time, a king fell from his kingdom,

5.150.s:
surathākhyaḥ prasiddho'tra sūryavaṃśasamudbhavaḥ ..
tato vasiṣṭhamāsādya sa cātmīyaṃ puro hitam ..
provāca praṇato bhūtvā bāṣpavyākulalocanaḥ .. 46 ..
5.150.d:
सुरथाख्यः प्रसिद्धोऽत्र सूर्यवंशसमुद्भवः ..
ततो वसिष्ठमासाद्य स चात्मीयं पुरो हितम् ..
प्रोवाच प्रणतो भूत्वा बाष्पव्याकुललोचनः .. 46 ..
5.150.m: renowned here by the name of Suratha, born of the Solar dynasty. / Then, approaching Vasiṣṭha, his own family priest, / having bowed down, his eyes filled with tears, he said:

5.150.s:
tvayā nāthena me brahmansaṃsthitenā'pi śatrubhiḥ ..
balācca yaddhṛtaṃ rājyaṃ manda bhāgyasya sāṃpratam .. 47 ..
5.150.d:
त्वया नाथेन मे ब्रह्मन्संस्थितेनाऽपि शत्रुभिः ..
बलाच्च यद्धृतं राज्यं मन्द भाग्यस्य सांप्रतम् .. 47 ..
5.150.m: "Though you were present as my protector, O brahmin, / the kingdom of me, an unfortunate one, has now been forcibly seized by enemies.

5.150.s:
tasmātkuru prasādaṃ me yena me rājyasaṃsthitiḥ ..
bhūyo'pi tvatprasādena nānyā me vidyate gatiḥ .. 48 ..
5.150.d:
तस्मात्कुरु प्रसादं मे येन मे राज्यसंस्थितिः ..
भूयोऽपि त्वत्प्रसादेन नान्या मे विद्यते गतिः .. 48 ..
5.150.m: Therefore, grant me your favor so that I may be reinstated in my kingdom / once more by your grace; I have no other refuge."

5.150.s:
.. vasiṣṭha uvāca .. ..
yadyevaṃ te mahārāja madvākyātsatvaraṃ vraja ..
hāṭakeśvarajaṃ kṣetraṃ sarvasiddhipradāyakam .. 49 ..
5.150.d:
.. वसिष्ठ उवाच .. ..
यद्येवं ते महाराज मद्वाक्यात्सत्वरं व्रज ..
हाटकेश्वरजं क्षेत्रं सर्वसिद्धिप्रदायकम् .. 49 ..
5.150.m: Vasiṣṭha said: / "If it is so, O great king, go swiftly at my word / to the sacred field of Hāṭakeśvara, which grants all perfections.

5.150.s:
tatra bhairavarūpeṇa sthāpayitvā maheśvaram ..
bhujodyatograśūlāgraviddhāndhakakalevaram .. 6.151.50 ..
5.150.d:
तत्र भैरवरूपेण स्थापयित्वा महेश्वरम् ..
भुजोद्यतोग्रशूलाग्रविद्धान्धककलेवरम् .. 6.151.50 ..
5.150.m: Having installed the Great Lord there in the form of Bhairava, / with the body of Andhaka pierced on the tip of the fierce spear raised in his arm,

5.150.s:
nārasiṃhena maṃtreṇa tataḥ pūjaya taṃ nṛpa ..
raktapuṣpaistathā dhūpai raktaiścaivānulepanaiḥ .. 51 ..
5.150.d:
नारसिंहेन मंत्रेण ततः पूजय तं नृप ..
रक्तपुष्पैस्तथा धूपै रक्तैश्चैवानुलेपनैः .. 51 ..
5.150.m: then worship him, O king, with the Nārasiṃha mantra, / with red flowers, incense, and red unguents.

5.150.s:
tataḥ sadvīrya māsādya tejovīryasamanvitaḥ ..
haniṣyasyakhilāñchatrūṃstatprasādādasaṃśayam .. 52 ..
5.150.d:
ततः सद्वीर्य मासाद्य तेजोवीर्यसमन्वितः ..
हनिष्यस्यखिलाञ्छत्रूंस्तत्प्रसादादसंशयम् .. 52 ..
5.150.m: Then, having attained true courage, endowed with splendour and valour, / you will undoubtedly slay all your enemies by his grace.

5.150.s:
paraṃ śaucasametena saṃpūjyo bhagavāṃstvayā ..
anyathā prāpsyase vighnānsatyametanmayoditam .. 53 ..
5.150.d:
परं शौचसमेतेन संपूज्यो भगवांस्त्वया ..
अन्यथा प्राप्स्यसे विघ्नान्सत्यमेतन्मयोदितम् .. 53 ..
5.150.m: You must worship the Lord endowed with supreme purity; / otherwise, you will encounter obstacles. This is the truth spoken by me."

5.150.s:
atha tasya vacaḥ śrutvā sa rājā satvaraṃ yayau ..
tatra kṣetre tato devaṃ sthāpayāmāsa bhairavam .. 54 ..
5.150.d:
अथ तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा स राजा सत्वरं ययौ ..
तत्र क्षेत्रे ततो देवं स्थापयामास भैरवम् .. 54 ..
5.150.m: Then, having heard his word, that king went quickly. / There, in that sacred field, he installed the god Bhairava.

5.150.s:
tataḥ saṃpūjayāmāsa nārasiṃhena bhaktitaḥ ..
mantreṇa prayato bhūtvā brahmacaryaparāyaṇaḥ ..55..
5.150.d:
ततः संपूजयामास नारसिंहेन भक्तितः ..
मन्त्रेण प्रयतो भूत्वा ब्रह्मचर्यपरायणः ..55..
5.150.m: Then he worshipped him with devotion using the Nārasiṃha / mantra, restrained and devoted to celibacy.

5.150.s:
tato daśasahasrāṃte tasya maṃtrasya saṃkhyayā ..
bhairavastuṣṭimāpannaḥ provā ca tadanantaram .. 56 ..
5.150.d:
ततो दशसहस्रांते तस्य मंत्रस्य संख्यया ..
भैरवस्तुष्टिमापन्नः प्रोवा च तदनन्तरम् .. 56 ..
5.150.m: Then, at the conclusion of ten thousand [recitations] of that mantra, / Bhairava was pleased and spoke immediately afterwards.

5.150.s:
.. śrībhairava uvāca .. ..
parituṣṭo'smi te rājanmaṃtreṇānena pūjitaḥ ..
tasmātprārthaya yacceṣṭaṃ yena sarvaṃ dadāmyaham .. 57 .. ..
5.150.d:
.. श्रीभैरव उवाच .. ..
परितुष्टोऽस्मि ते राजन्मंत्रेणानेन पूजितः ..
तस्मात्प्रार्थय यच्चेष्टं येन सर्वं ददाम्यहम् .. 57 .. ..
5.150.m: The venerable Bhairava said: / "I am pleased with you, O king, worshipped with this mantra; / therefore, ask whatever is desired, so that I may grant it all."

5.150.s:
.. suratha uvāca .. ..
śatrubhirme hṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tvatprasādātsureśvara ..
tanme bhavatu bhūyo'pi śatrubhiḥ parivarjjitam .. 58 ..
5.150.d:
.. सुरथ उवाच .. ..
शत्रुभिर्मे हृतं राज्यं त्वत्प्रसादात्सुरेश्वर ..
तन्मे भवतु भूयोऽपि शत्रुभिः परिवर्ज्जितम् .. 58 ..
5.150.m: Suratha said: / "My kingdom was seized by enemies; by your grace, O lord of gods, / let it become mine once again, free from enemies!

5.150.s:
anyo'pi yaḥ pumānitthaṃ tvāmihāgatya pūjayet ..
anenaiva tu maṃtreṇa tasya siddhistvayā vibho ..59..
5.150.d:
अन्योऽपि यः पुमानित्थं त्वामिहागत्य पूजयेत् ..
अनेनैव तु मंत्रेण तस्य सिद्धिस्त्वया विभो ..59..
5.150.m: And whatever other man coming here should worship you in this manner / with this very mantra, to him perfection should be granted by you, O lord,

5.150.s:
deyā deva sahasrāṃte yathā mama sureśvara ..
tatheti taṃ pratijñāya gataścādarśanaṃ haraḥ .. 6.151.60 ..
5.150.d:
देया देव सहस्रांते यथा मम सुरेश्वर ..
तथेति तं प्रतिज्ञाय गतश्चादर्शनं हरः .. 6.151.60 ..
5.150.m: at the end of a thousand [recitations], O god, just as to me, O lord of gods!" / Promising him "So be it," Hara vanished from sight.

5.150.s: suratho'pi nijaṃ rājyaṃ prāpa hatvā raṇe ripūn..61..
5.150.d: सुरथोऽपि निजं राज्यं प्राप हत्वा रणे रिपून्..61..
5.150.m: Suratha too regained his own kingdom, having slain his enemies in battle.

5.150.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭake śvarakṣetramāhātmye bhairavakṣetramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikapañcāśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 151 ..cha..
5.150.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटके श्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये भैरवक्षेत्रमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकपञ्चाशदुत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 151 ..छ..
5.150.m: Thus ends the hundred and fifty-first chapter, entitled 'Description of the Māhātmya of the Sacred Field of Bhairava', in the Māhātmya of the Sacred Field of Hāṭakeśvara in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [section] of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, in the compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

5.151.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
asaṃkhyātāni tīrthāni tvayoktā nyatra sūtaja ..
devamānuṣajātāni devatāyatanāni ca ..
tathā vānarajātāni rākṣasasthāpitāni ca ..1..
5.151.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
असंख्यातानि तीर्थानि त्वयोक्ता न्यत्र सूतज ..
देवमानुषजातानि देवतायतनानि च ..
तथा वानरजातानि राक्षसस्थापितानि च ..1..
5.151.m: The seers said: / Innumerable sacred fords have been described by you here, O son of Sūta, / both those produced by gods and men, and abodes of the deities, / as well as those produced by monkeys and installed by rākṣasas.

5.151.s:
sūtaputra vadāsmākaṃ yairdṛṣṭaiḥ sparśitairapi ..
sarveṣāṃ labhyate pūrṇaṃ phalaṃ cepsitamatra ca .. 2 ..
5.151.d:
सूतपुत्र वदास्माकं यैर्दृष्टैः स्पर्शितैरपि ..
सर्वेषां लभ्यते पूर्णं फलं चेप्सितमत्र च .. 2 ..
5.151.m: Tell us, O son of Sūta, by seeing and touching which [deities or sacred fords] / the complete and desired fruit of all of them is obtained here?

5.151.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
satyametanmahābhāgāstatra saṃkhyā na vidyate ..
tīrthānāṃ caiva liṃgānāmāśra māṇāṃ tathaiva ca .. 3 ..
5.151.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
सत्यमेतन्महाभागास्तत्र संख्या न विद्यते ..
तीर्थानां चैव लिंगानामाश्र माणां तथैव च .. 3 ..
5.151.m: Sūta said: / This is true, O venerable ones; there is no counting / of the sacred fords, the liṅgas, and the hermitages there.

5.151.s:
tatra yaḥ kurute snānaṃ śaṃkhatīrthe samāhitaḥ ..
ekādaśyāṃ viśeṣeṇa sarveṣāṃ labhate phalam .. 4 ..
5.151.d:
तत्र यः कुरुते स्नानं शंखतीर्थे समाहितः ..
एकादश्यां विशेषेण सर्वेषां लभते फलम् .. 4 ..
5.151.m: Whoever, with composed mind, takes a ritual ablution there in the Śaṅkhatīrtha, / particularly on the eleventh day, obtains the fruit of all of them.

5.151.s:
yaḥ paśyati naro bhaktyā tatraikādaśarudrakam ..
siddheśvarasamaṃ tena dṛṣṭāḥ sarve maheśvarāḥ .. 5 ..
5.151.d:
यः पश्यति नरो भक्त्या तत्रैकादशरुद्रकम् ..
सिद्धेश्वरसमं तेन दृष्टाः सर्वे महेश्वराः .. 5 ..
5.151.m: The man who with devotion beholds the eleven Rudras there, / has beheld all the great lords equal to Siddheśvara.

5.151.s:
yaḥ paśyati vaṭādityaṃ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ caitre viśeṣataḥ ..
bhāskarākṛtsnaśo dṛṣṭāstena tatrahi saṃsthitāḥ .. 6 ..
5.151.d:
यः पश्यति वटादित्यं षष्ठ्यां चैत्रे विशेषतः ..
भास्कराकृत्स्नशो दृष्टास्तेन तत्रहि संस्थिताः .. 6 ..
5.151.m: He who beholds Vaṭāditya, especially on the sixth day in the month of Caitra, / has beheld all the sun-gods residing there.

5.151.s:
māhitthāṃ paśyati tathā ye devīṃ śraddhayāvitāḥ ..
tena durgāḥ samastāstā vīkṣitā nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 7 ..
5.151.d:
माहित्थां पश्यति तथा ये देवीं श्रद्धयाविताः ..
तेन दुर्गाः समस्तास्ता वीक्षिता नात्र संशयः .. 7 ..
5.151.m: Likewise, whoever, endowed with faith, beholds the goddess Māhitthā, / by him all those Durgās are seen; there is no doubt about this.

5.151.s:
yaḥ paśyati gaṇeśaṃ ca svargadvārapradaṃ nṛṇām ..
sarve vināyakāstena dṛṣṭāḥ syurnātra saṃśayaḥ .. 8 ..
5.151.d:
यः पश्यति गणेशं च स्वर्गद्वारप्रदं नृणाम् ..
सर्वे विनायकास्तेन दृष्टाः स्युर्नात्र संशयः .. 8 ..
5.151.m: And he who beholds Gaṇeśa, the bestower of heaven's gateway to men, / by him all Vināyakas have been seen; there is no doubt about this.

5.151.s:
śarmiṣṭhāsthāpitāṃ gaurīṃ yo jyeṣṭhāṃ tatra paśyati ..
tena gauryaḥ samastāstā vīkṣitā dvijasattamāḥ .. 9 ..
5.151.d:
शर्मिष्ठास्थापितां गौरीं यो ज्येष्ठां तत्र पश्यति ..
तेन गौर्यः समस्तास्ता वीक्षिता द्विजसत्तमाः .. 9 ..
5.151.m: Whoever beholds the elder Gaurī installed there by Śarmiṣṭhā, / by him all those Gaurīs are seen, O best of the twice-born.

5.151.s:
cakrapāṇiṃ ca yaḥ paśyetprātarutthāya mānavaḥ ..
vāsudevā samastāśca tena tatra nirīkṣitāḥ .. 6.152.10 .. ..
5.151.d:
चक्रपाणिं च यः पश्येत्प्रातरुत्थाय मानवः ..
वासुदेवा समस्ताश्च तेन तत्र निरीक्षिताः .. 6.152.10 .. ..
5.151.m: And whichever man, having risen in the morning, beholds Cakrapāṇi, / by him all the Vāsudevas there are beheld.

5.151.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
tvayāsūta tathā'smākaṃ cakrapāṇiśca yaḥ sthitaḥ ..
nākhyātaḥ sa kathaṃ tatra vismṛtaḥ kiṃ vadasva naḥ ..
kasminkāle viśeṣeṇa sa draṣṭavyo manīṣibhiḥ .. 11 ..
5.151.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
त्वयासूत तथाऽस्माकं चक्रपाणिश्च यः स्थितः ..
नाख्यातः स कथं तत्र विस्मृतः किं वदस्व नः ..
कस्मिन्काले विशेषेण स द्रष्टव्यो मनीषिभिः .. 11 ..
5.151.m: The seers said: / O Sūta, you have not described to us in that manner / Cakrapāṇi who is situated there. How is that? Was he forgotten? Tell us! / At what time especially is he to be beheld by the wise?

5.151.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
arjunenaiṣa viprendrāḥ kṣetre'traiva pratiṣṭhitaḥ ..
śayane bodhane caiva prātarutthāya mānavaḥ .. 12 ..
5.151.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
अर्जुनेनैष विप्रेन्द्राः क्षेत्रेऽत्रैव प्रतिष्ठितः ..
शयने बोधने चैव प्रातरुत्थाय मानवः .. 12 ..
5.151.m: Sūta said: / He was installed in this very sacred field by Arjuna, O eminent vipras. / On the sleeping day and the awakening day, having risen in the morning,

5.151.s:
snānaṃ kṛtvā subhaktyā ca yaḥ paśyeccakrapāṇinam ..
brahmahatyādipāpāni tasya naśyaṃti tatkṣaṇāt .. 13 ..
5.151.d:
स्नानं कृत्वा सुभक्त्या च यः पश्येच्चक्रपाणिनम् ..
ब्रह्महत्यादिपापानि तस्य नश्यंति तत्क्षणात् .. 13 ..
5.151.m: whoever, having taken a ritual ablution, beholds Cakrapāṇi with true devotion, / his sins, such as the killing of a brahmin, perish at that very moment.

5.151.s:
bhūbhārottāraṇārthāya dharmasaṃsthāpanāya ca ..
brahmaṇāvatāritau viprā naranārāyaṇāvubhau .. 14 ..
5.151.d:
भूभारोत्तारणार्थाय धर्मसंस्थापनाय च ..
ब्रह्मणावतारितौ विप्रा नरनारायणावुभौ .. 14 ..
5.151.m: To remove the earth's burden and to establish righteousness, O brahmins, / both Nara and Nārāyaṇa were made to descend by Brahmā.

5.151.s:
kṛṣṇārjunau tadā martye dvāparāṃte dvijottamāḥ ..
avatīrṇo dharāpṛṣṭhe mithaḥ snehānugau tadā ..
naranārāyaṇāvetau svayameva vyavasthitau .. 15 ..
5.151.d:
कृष्णार्जुनौ तदा मर्त्ये द्वापरांते द्विजोत्तमाः ..
अवतीर्णो धरापृष्ठे मिथः स्नेहानुगौ तदा ..
नरनारायणावेतौ स्वयमेव व्यवस्थितौ .. 15 ..
5.151.m: At that time, at the end of the Dvāpara age, O best of the twice-born, Kṛṣṇa and Arjuna / descended onto the surface of the earth, united by mutual affection; / these two, Nara and Nārāyaṇa, were stationed there in person.

5.151.s:
yathā rakṣovināśāya rāmo daśarathātmajaḥ ..
avatīrṇo dharāpṛṣṭhe tadvatkṛṣṇo'pi cāparaḥ .. 16 ..
5.151.d:
यथा रक्षोविनाशाय रामो दशरथात्मजः ..
अवतीर्णो धरापृष्ठे तद्वत्कृष्णोऽपि चापरः .. 16 ..
5.151.m: Just as Rāma, the son of Daśaratha, descended onto the surface of the earth / to destroy the rākṣasas, so too did the other, Kṛṣṇa.

5.151.s:
yadā pārthaḥ samāyātastīrthayātrāṃ prati dvijāḥ ..
yudhiṣṭhirasamādeśācchakraprasthātpurottamāt .. 17
5.151.d:
यदा पार्थः समायातस्तीर्थयात्रां प्रति द्विजाः ..
युधिष्ठिरसमादेशाच्छक्रप्रस्थात्पुरोत्तमात् .. 17
5.151.m: When Pārtha set out on his pilgrimage to sacred fords, O twice-born, / by the order of Yudhiṣṭhira, from the foremost city of Śakraprastha,

5.151.s:
draupadyā sahitaṃ dṛṣṭvā rahasi bhrātaraṃ dvijam ..
provāca praṇato bhūtvā vinayāvanato'rjunaḥ .. 19 ..
.. arjuna uvāca .. ..
āyudhārthamahaṃ prāptaḥ sāṃprataṃ pārthivottama ..
dvijadhenuvimokṣāya mamājñāṃ dehi pārthiva .. 19 ..
5.151.d:
द्रौपद्या सहितं दृष्ट्वा रहसि भ्रातरं द्विजम् ..
प्रोवाच प्रणतो भूत्वा विनयावनतोऽर्जुनः .. 19 ..
.. अर्जुन उवाच .. ..
आयुधार्थमहं प्राप्तः सांप्रतं पार्थिवोत्तम ..
द्विजधेनुविमोक्षाय ममाज्ञां देहि पार्थिव .. 19 ..
5.151.m:
having seen his twice-born brother in secret together with Draupadī, / Arjuna bowed down and, bent in modesty, spoke:
Arjuna said: / 'I have come right now for my weapons, O best of kings. / Give me your command, O king, to rescue the brahmin's cows.'

5.151.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
gacchārjuna drutaṃ tatra nīyante yatra taskaraiḥ ..
dhenavo dvijavaryasya tā mokṣaya dhanaṃjaya .. 6.152.20 ..
5.151.d:
.. युधिष्ठिर उवाच .. ..
गच्छार्जुन द्रुतं तत्र नीयन्ते यत्र तस्करैः ..
धेनवो द्विजवर्यस्य ता मोक्षय धनंजय .. 6.152.20 ..
5.151.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / 'Go quickly, Arjuna, to where the cows of the excellent brahmin / are being led away by thieves; rescue them, O Dhanaṃjaya!

5.151.s:
tīrthayātrāṃ tato gaccha yāvaddvādaśavatsarān ..
tataḥ pāpavinirmuktaḥ sameṣyasi mamāṃtikam.. 21 ..
5.151.d:
तीर्थयात्रां ततो गच्छ यावद्द्वादशवत्सरान् ..
ततः पापविनिर्मुक्तः समेष्यसि ममांतिकम्.. 21 ..
5.151.m: Then depart on a pilgrimage to sacred fords for twelve years; / then, freed from sin, you will return to my presence.

5.151.s:
yaḥ sadāraṃ naraṃ paśyedekāṃtasthaṃ tu buddhimān ..
api cātyaṃtapāpaḥ syātkiṃ punarnijabāṃdhavam .. 22 ..
5.151.d:
यः सदारं नरं पश्येदेकांतस्थं तु बुद्धिमान् ..
अपि चात्यंतपापः स्यात्किं पुनर्निजबांधवम् .. 22 ..
5.151.m: A wise man who looks upon any man together with his wife in private / would become exceedingly sinful; how much more so upon his own kinsman?

5.151.s:
tasmānna vīkṣayetkañcidekāṃtasthaṃ sabhāryakam ..
bāṃdhavaṃ ca viśeṣeṇa ya icchecchubhamātmanaḥ .. 23 ..
5.151.d:
तस्मान्न वीक्षयेत्कञ्चिदेकांतस्थं सभार्यकम् ..
बांधवं च विशेषेण य इच्छेच्छुभमात्मनः .. 23 ..
5.151.m: Therefore, one who desires good for himself should never gaze upon anyone / who is in private with his wife, and especially not upon a kinsman.'

5.151.s:
sa tatheti pratijñāya rathamāruhya satvaram ..
dhanurādāya bāṇāṃśca jagāma tadanantaram .. 24 ..
5.151.d:
स तथेति प्रतिज्ञाय रथमारुह्य सत्वरम् ..
धनुरादाय बाणांश्च जगाम तदनन्तरम् .. 24 ..
5.151.m: He promised, 'So be it,' swiftly mounted his chariot, / took his bow and arrows, and immediately set out

5.151.s:
yena mārgeṇa tā gāvo nīyante taskarairbalāt ..
tiraskṛtya dvijānsarvāñchitaśastradharairdvijāḥ .. 25 ..
5.151.d:
येन मार्गेण ता गावो नीयन्ते तस्करैर्बलात् ..
तिरस्कृत्य द्विजान्सर्वाञ्छितशस्त्रधरैर्द्विजाः .. 25 ..
5.151.m: along the path by which those cows were being led away by force by thieves / who had insulted all the brahmins, bearing sharp weapons, O twice-born.

5.151.s:
atha hatvā kṣaṇāccaurāngāḥ sarvāḥ svayamāhṛtāḥ ..
svāḥ svā nivedayāmāsa brāhmaṇānāṃ mahātmanām .. 26 ..
5.151.d:
अथ हत्वा क्षणाच्चौरान्गाः सर्वाः स्वयमाहृताः ..
स्वाः स्वा निवेदयामास ब्राह्मणानां महात्मनाम् .. 26 ..
5.151.m: Then, having slain the thieves in an instant, he brought back all the cows himself / and restored them, each to their own, to the noble brahmins.

5.151.s:
tatastīrthānyanekāni sa dṛṣṭvāyatanāni ca ..
kṣetre'traiva samāyātaḥ snānārthaṃ pāṃḍunandanaḥ .. 27 ..
5.151.d:
ततस्तीर्थान्यनेकानि स दृष्ट्वायतनानि च ..
क्षेत्रेऽत्रैव समायातः स्नानार्थं पांडुनन्दनः .. 27 ..
5.151.m: Then, having seen many sacred fords and temples, / the son of Pāṇḍu arrived at this very sacred field to perform his ritual ablution.

5.151.s:
tena pūrvamapi prāyastatkṣetramavalokitam ..
duryodhanasamāyukto yadā tatra samāgataḥ .. 28 ..
5.151.d:
तेन पूर्वमपि प्रायस्तत्क्षेत्रमवलोकितम् ..
दुर्योधनसमायुक्तो यदा तत्र समागतः .. 28 ..
5.151.m: That sacred field had already been seen by him previously, / when he had come there accompanied by Duryodhana.

5.151.s:
atha saṃpūjayāmāsa yalliṃgaṃ sthāpitaṃ purā ..
arjuneśvara saṃjñaṃ tu puṣpadhūpānulepanaiḥ .. 29 ..
5.151.d:
अथ संपूजयामास यल्लिंगं स्थापितं पुरा ..
अर्जुनेश्वर संज्ञं तु पुष्पधूपानुलेपनैः .. 29 ..
5.151.m: Then he worshipped with flowers, incense, and ointments the liṅga / that had been established earlier, called Arjuneśvara,

5.151.s: anyeṣāṃ kauravendrāṇāṃ pāṃḍavānāṃ viśeṣataḥ .. 6.152.30 ..
5.151.m: [as well as those] of the other lordly Kauravas, and especially of the Pāṇḍavas.

5.151.s:
atha saṃciṃtayāmāsa manasā pāṃḍunaṃdanaḥ ..
ahaṃ naraḥ svayaṃ sākṣātkṛṣṇo nārāyaṇaḥ svayam.. 31 ..
5.151.d:
अथ संचिंतयामास मनसा पांडुनंदनः ..
अहं नरः स्वयं साक्षात्कृष्णो नारायणः स्वयम्.. 31 ..
5.151.m: Then the son of Pāṇḍu reflected in his mind: / 'I am Nara directly in person, and Kṛṣṇa is Nārāyaṇa himself.

5.151.s:
tasmādatra kariṣyāmi cakrapāṇiṃ sureśvaram ..
prāsādo mānavaścaiva yādṛṅnāsti dharātale .. 32 ..
5.151.d:
तस्मादत्र करिष्यामि चक्रपाणिं सुरेश्वरम् ..
प्रासादो मानवश्चैव यादृङ्नास्ति धरातले .. 32 ..
5.151.m: Therefore, I will establish here [an image of] the Discus-Armed Lord, the ruler of the gods, / and a human temple such as does not exist on the surface of the earth.

5.151.s:
kalpāṃte'pi na nāśaḥ syādasya kṣetrasya karhicit ..
prāsādo'pi tathāpyevamatra kṣetre bhaviṣyati 33 ..
5.151.d:
कल्पांतेऽपि न नाशः स्यादस्य क्षेत्रस्य कर्हिचित् ..
प्रासादोऽपि तथाप्येवमत्र क्षेत्रे भविष्यति 33 ..
5.151.m: Even at the end of a kalpa, there would never be destruction of this sacred field; / so too shall the temple remain in this sacred field.'

5.151.s:
evaṃ sa niścayaṃ kṛtvā svacitte pāṃḍavānujaḥ ..
prāsādaṃ nirmame paścādvaiṣṇavaṃ dvijasattamāḥ .. 34 ..
5.151.d:
एवं स निश्चयं कृत्वा स्वचित्ते पांडवानुजः ..
प्रासादं निर्ममे पश्चाद्वैष्णवं द्विजसत्तमाः .. 34 ..
5.151.m: Having made such a resolution in his own mind, the younger brother of the Pāṇḍava / then built a temple to Viṣṇu, O best of the twice-born.

5.151.s:
tato viprānsamāhūya camatkārapurodbhavān..
pratiṣṭhāṃ kārayāmāsa mataṃ teṣāṃ samāśritaḥ .. 35 ..
5.151.d:
ततो विप्रान्समाहूय चमत्कारपुरोद्भवान्..
प्रतिष्ठां कारयामास मतं तेषां समाश्रितः .. 35 ..
5.151.m: Then, having summoned the brahmins born in Camatkārapura, / relying on their judgment, he caused the consecration to be performed,

5.151.s:
dattvā dānānyanekāni śāsanāni bahūni ca ..
anyacca pradadau paścātsa teṣāṃ tuṣṭidāyakam .. 36 ..
5.151.d:
दत्त्वा दानान्यनेकानि शासनानि बहूनि च ..
अन्यच्च प्रददौ पश्चात्स तेषां तुष्टिदायकम् .. 36 ..
5.151.m: giving many gifts and numerous title-deeds; / and afterwards he gave other things that brought them satisfaction.

5.151.s:
tataḥ provāca tānsarvānkṛtāṃjalipuṭaḥ sthitaḥ..
naro'haṃ brāhmaṇājjātaḥ pāṇḍorbhūmiṃ prapedivān ..37 ..
5.151.d:
ततः प्रोवाच तान्सर्वान्कृतांजलिपुटः स्थितः..
नरोऽहं ब्राह्मणाज्जातः पाण्डोर्भूमिं प्रपेदिवान् ..37 ..
5.151.m: Then, standing with folded palms, he said to all of them: / 'I am Nara, born of a brahmin to Pāṇḍu, who has attained this earth;

5.151.s:
mānuṣeṇaiva rūpeṇa tyaktvā tāṃ badarīṃ śubhām ..
prasiddhyarthaṃ mayā cātra prāsādo'yaṃ vini rmitaḥ ..
mannāmnā narasaṃjñaśca śraddhāpūtena cetasā .. 38 ..
5.151.d:
मानुषेणैव रूपेण त्यक्त्वा तां बदरीं शुभाम् ..
प्रसिद्ध्यर्थं मया चात्र प्रासादोऽयं विनि र्मितः ..
मन्नाम्ना नरसंज्ञश्च श्रद्धापूतेन चेतसा .. 38 ..
5.151.m: leaving that auspicious Badarī in this human form, / this temple has been built by me here for fame, / named Nara after my own name, with a mind purified by faith.

5.151.s:
tasmādeṣa bhavadbhiśca cakrapāṇiriti dvijāḥ ..
kīrtanīyaḥ sadā yena mama nāma prakāśya tām.. 39 ..
5.151.d:
तस्मादेष भवद्भिश्च चक्रपाणिरिति द्विजाः ..
कीर्तनीयः सदा येन मम नाम प्रकाश्य ताम्.. 39 ..
5.151.m: Therefore, O twice-born, this [form of the Lord] must always be celebrated / by you as Cakrapāṇi, by which my name shall be illuminated,

5.151.s: viṣṇuloke dhvaniryāti yāvaccaṃdradivākarau .. 6.152.40 ..
5.151.d: विष्णुलोके ध्वनिर्याति यावच्चंद्रदिवाकरौ .. 6.152.40 ..
5.151.m: and the renown shall extend to the world of Viṣṇu as long as the moon and the sun endure.

5.151.s:
tathā mahotsavaḥ kāryaḥ śayane bodhane hareḥ ..
caitramāse viśeṣeṇa saṃprāpte viṣṇuvāsare .. 41 ..
5.151.d:
तथा महोत्सवः कार्यः शयने बोधने हरेः ..
चैत्रमासे विशेषेण संप्राप्ते विष्णुवासरे .. 41 ..
5.151.m: Likewise, a great festival should be celebrated at the sleeping and waking of Hari, / especially in the month of Caitra when the day of Viṣṇu arrives.

5.151.s:
eteṣu triṣu lokeṣu tyaktvemāṃ badarīmaham ..
pūjāmasya kariṣyāmi svayaṃ viṣṇordvijottamāḥ ..42..
5.151.d:
एतेषु त्रिषु लोकेषु त्यक्त्वेमां बदरीमहम् ..
पूजामस्य करिष्यामि स्वयं विष्णोर्द्विजोत्तमाः ..42..
5.151.m: Leaving this Badarī among these three worlds, / I myself will perform the worship of this Viṣṇu, O best of the twice-born.

5.151.s:
yastatra divase martyaḥ pūjāmasya vidhā syati ..
sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇulokaṃ sa yāsyati..43..
5.151.d:
यस्तत्र दिवसे मर्त्यः पूजामस्य विधा स्यति ..
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो विष्णुलोकं स यास्यति..43..
5.151.m: Whatever mortal performs worship of Him on that day / will be freed from all sins and will go to the world of Viṣṇu.

5.151.s:
tathā ye vāsudevasya kṣetre kecidvyavasthitāḥ ..
teṣāṃ pradarśanaṃ śreyo nityaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca lapsyate ..44..
5.151.d:
तथा ये वासुदेवस्य क्षेत्रे केचिद्व्यवस्थिताः ..
तेषां प्रदर्शनं श्रेयो नित्यं दृष्ट्वा च लप्स्यते ..44..
5.151.m: Likewise, for those who are stationed anywhere in the sacred field of Vāsudeva, / seeing them is auspicious; and having seen [the deity], one will always attain it.'

5.151.s:
sūta uvāca..
bāḍhamityeva tairukto dāśārhaḥ pāṃḍunaṃdanaḥ..
teṣāṃ tadbhāramāveśya praśāṃtenāṃtarātmanā..
yayau tīrthāni cānyāni kṛtakṛtyastataḥ param..45..
5.151.d:
सूत उवाच..
बाढमित्येव तैरुक्तो दाशार्हः पांडुनंदनः..
तेषां तद्भारमावेश्य प्रशांतेनांतरात्मना..
ययौ तीर्थानि चान्यानि कृतकृत्यस्ततः परम्..45..
5.151.m: Sūta said: / Addressed by them with 'So be it,' the son of Pāṇḍu, [kin to] the Dāśārhas, / entrusting that responsibility to them with a peaceful mind, / went on to other sacred fords, having achieved his purpose thereafter.

5.151.s:
evaṃ tatra sthito devaścakrapāṇivapurddharaḥ..
svayameva hṛṣīkeśo jaṃtūnāṃ pāpanāśanaḥ..46..
5.151.d:
एवं तत्र स्थितो देवश्चक्रपाणिवपुर्द्धरः..
स्वयमेव हृषीकेशो जंतूनां पापनाशनः..46..
5.151.m: Thus the god, bearing the form of the Discus-Armed Lord, stayed there, / Hṛṣīkeśa himself, the destroyer of sins of living beings.

5.151.s:
adyā'pi ca kalā viṣṇoḥ prāpte caikādaśītraye ..
pūrvoktena vidhānena tasmācchraddhāsamanvitaiḥ ..
sadaiva pūjanīyaśca vandanīyo viśeṣataḥ .. 47 ..
5.151.d:
अद्याऽपि च कला विष्णोः प्राप्ते चैकादशीत्रये ..
पूर्वोक्तेन विधानेन तस्माच्छ्रद्धासमन्वितैः ..
सदैव पूजनीयश्च वन्दनीयो विशेषतः .. 47 ..
5.151.m: Even today, a portion of Viṣṇu [is present there]; and when the triad of Ekādaśīs arrives, / He should always be worshipped and especially saluted / with the procedure spoken of earlier by those endowed with faith.
