5.151.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye cakrapāṇimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvipañcāśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 152 ..
5.151.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीति साहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये चक्रपाणिमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम द्विपञ्चाशदुत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 152 ..
5.151.m: Thus ends the hundred and fifty-second chapter, named 'The Description of the Māhātmya of Cakrapāṇi', in the Māhātmya of the Hāṭakeśvara Sacred Field, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [section], in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses.

5.152.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tathānyadapi tatrāsti rūpatīrthamanuttamam ..
yatra snāto naraḥ samyagvirūpo rūpavānbhavet .. 1 ..
5.152.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तथान्यदपि तत्रास्ति रूपतीर्थमनुत्तमम् ..
यत्र स्नातो नरः सम्यग्विरूपो रूपवान्भवेत् .. 1 ..
5.152.m: Sūta said: / Likewise, there is another unexcelled sacred ford there, Rūpatīrtha, / bathing in which a misshapen person properly becomes handsome.

5.152.s:
pūrvaṃ bhagavatā tena brahmaṇā loka kartṛṇā ..
sṛṣṭiṃ kṛtvā ca vistīrṇāṃ yathoktaṃ ca caturvidhām..2..
5.152.d:
पूर्वं भगवता तेन ब्रह्मणा लोक कर्तृणा ..
सृष्टिं कृत्वा च विस्तीर्णां यथोक्तं च चतुर्विधाम्..2..
5.152.m: Formerly, by that blessed Brahmā, the creator of the world, / after creating the vast, fourfold creation as described,

5.152.s:
tataḥ sa cintayāmāsa rūpasaṃcayasaṃyutām .]
ekāmapsarasaṃ divyāṃ devamāyāṃ sṛjāmyaham .. . ..3..
5.152.d:
ततः स चिन्तयामास रूपसंचयसंयुताम् .]
एकामप्सरसं दिव्यां देवमायां सृजाम्यहम् .. . ..3..
5.152.m: he then thought: 'I shall create a single divine apsaras, / possessed of an accumulation of beauty, a divine marvel.'

5.152.s:
tataśca sarvadevānāṃ samādāya tilaṃtilam..
rūpaṃ ca nirmame paścādatyāścaryamayīṃ ca tām ..4..
5.152.d:
ततश्च सर्वदेवानां समादाय तिलंतिलम्..
रूपं च निर्ममे पश्चादत्याश्चर्यमयीं च ताम् ..4..
5.152.m: And then, taking a sesame-seed's measure of beauty from each of all the gods, / he fashioned her afterwards, filled with extraordinary wonder.

5.152.s: yāṃ dṛṣṭvā kṣobhamāpannaḥ svayameva pitāmahaḥ ..5..
5.152.d: यां दृष्ट्वा क्षोभमापन्नः स्वयमेव पितामहः ..5..
5.152.m: Seeing her, the grandfather [Brahmā] himself became agitated.

5.152.s:
tatastāṃ preṣayāmāsa kailāsaṃ prati padmajaḥ ..
gaccha devi mahādevaṃ praṇamasva śucismite .. 6 ..
5.152.d:
ततस्तां प्रेषयामास कैलासं प्रति पद्मजः ..
गच्छ देवि महादेवं प्रणमस्व शुचिस्मिते .. 6 ..
5.152.m: Then the Lotus-Born sent her to Kailāsa: / 'Go, O goddess, and bow down to Mahādeva, O fair-smiling one!'

5.152.s:
tataḥ sā satvaraṃ gatvā kailāsaṃ parvatottamam ..
apaśyacchaṃkaraṃ tatra nirviṣṭaṃ pārvatīsamam .. 7 ..
5.152.d:
ततः सा सत्वरं गत्वा कैलासं पर्वतोत्तमम् ..
अपश्यच्छंकरं तत्र निर्विष्टं पार्वतीसमम् .. 7 ..
5.152.m: Then she went swiftly to Kailāsa, the excellent mountain, / and saw Śaṃkara seated there together with Pārvatī.

5.152.s:
śaṃkaro'pi ca tāṃ dṛṣṭvā vismayaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ ..
sudṛṣṭāṃ nākarodbhītyā pārśvasthāṃ vīkṣya pārvatīm.. ..
tataḥ pradakṣiṇāṃ cakre sā praṇamya maheśvaram .
śraddhayā parayā yuktā kṛtāṃjalipuṭā sthitā ..9..
5.152.d:
शंकरोऽपि च तां दृष्ट्वा विस्मयं परमं गतः ..
सुदृष्टां नाकरोद्भीत्या पार्श्वस्थां वीक्ष्य पार्वतीम्.. ..
ततः प्रदक्षिणां चक्रे सा प्रणम्य महेश्वरम् .
श्रद्धया परया युक्ता कृतांजलिपुटा स्थिता ..9..
5.152.m: Śaṃkara too, seeing her, was filled with supreme wonder. / Out of fear, beholding Pārvatī standing beside him, he did not look directly at her. / Then, bowing to Maheśvara, she circumambulated him, / filled with supreme faith, standing with palms joined in reverence.

5.152.s:
yāvaddakṣiṇapārśvasthā tāvadvaktraṃ sa dakṣiṇam..
pracakāra mahādevastadupākṛṣṭalocanaḥ .. 6.153.10 ..
5.152.d:
यावद्दक्षिणपार्श्वस्था तावद्वक्त्रं स दक्षिणम्..
प्रचकार महादेवस्तदुपाकृष्टलोचनः .. 6.153.10 ..
5.152.m: As far as she stood on his right side, so far Mahādeva, / his eyes drawn toward her, brought forth a right face.

5.152.s:
paścimāyāṃ yadā sā'bhūtpradakṣiṇavaśācchubhā ..
paścimaṃ vadanaṃ tena tadarthaṃ ca kṛtaṃ tataḥ ..11..
5.152.d:
पश्चिमायां यदा साऽभूत्प्रदक्षिणवशाच्छुभा ..
पश्चिमं वदनं तेन तदर्थं च कृतं ततः ..11..
5.152.m: When, by the course of circumambulation, the auspicious woman reached the west, / he then produced a western face for her sake.

5.152.s:
evamuttarasaṃsthāyāṃ tasyāṃ devena śaṃbhunā ..
uttaraṃ vadanaṃ klṛptaṃ gaurībhītena cetasā ..
na grīvāṃ cālayāmāsa kathaṃcidapi sa dvijāḥ ..12..
5.152.d:
एवमुत्तरसंस्थायां तस्यां देवेन शंभुना ..
उत्तरं वदनं क्लृप्तं गौरीभीतेन चेतसा ..
न ग्रीवां चालयामास कथंचिदपि स द्विजाः ..12..
5.152.m: In this way, when she stood on the north, a northern face was fashioned / by the god Śambhu, whose heart was fearful of Gaurī. / O twice-born ones, he did not turn his neck in any way!

5.152.s:
etasminnaṃtare tatra nārado munipuṃgavaḥ..
abravītpārvatīṃ paścātpraṇipatya maheśvaram .. 13 ..
5.152.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे तत्र नारदो मुनिपुंगवः..
अब्रवीत्पार्वतीं पश्चात्प्रणिपत्य महेश्वरम् .. 13 ..
5.152.m: Meanwhile, the eminent sage Nārada, / having bowed down to Maheśvara, then spoke to Pārvatī:

5.152.s:
.. nārada uvāca .. ..
paśya pārvati te patyuśceṣṭitaṃ garhitaṃ yathā ..
dṛṣṭvā rūpavatīṃ nārīṃ kṛtaṃ. mukhacatuṣṭayam .. 14 ..
5.152.d:
.. नारद उवाच .. ..
पश्य पार्वति ते पत्युश्चेष्टितं गर्हितं यथा ..
दृष्ट्वा रूपवतीं नारीं कृतं. मुखचतुष्टयम् .. 14 ..
5.152.m: Nārada said: / 'See, O Pārvatī, how contemptible is your husband's conduct! / Seeing a beautiful woman, he has made four faces!

5.152.s:
ahametadvijānāmi na tvayā sadṛśī kvacit ..
asti nārī tathā'nyopi vijānāti sureśvari .. 19 ..
hāsyasya padavīmadya tvaṃ gamiṣyasi pārvati ..
sarvāsāṃ devapatnīnāṃ jñātvānyāsaktamīśvaram .. 16 ..
etaddevi vijānāsi yādṛkcittaṃ śivodbhavam ..
asyā upari veśyāyā niṃditāyā vicakṣaṇaiḥ .. 17 ..
samādāya nije harmya etāṃ saṃsthāpayiṣyati ..
paraṃ lajjāsamopeto na bravīti vacaḥ śubhe .. 18 . ..
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā dṛṣṭvā kāṃtaṃ caturmukham ..
krodhena mahatāviṣṭā vikṛtaṃ vīkṣya taṃ haram .. 19 ..
5.152.d:
अहमेतद्विजानामि न त्वया सदृशी क्वचित् ..
अस्ति नारी तथाऽन्योपि विजानाति सुरेश्वरि .. 19 ..
हास्यस्य पदवीमद्य त्वं गमिष्यसि पार्वति ..
सर्वासां देवपत्नीनां ज्ञात्वान्यासक्तमीश्वरम् .. 16 ..
एतद्देवि विजानासि यादृक्चित्तं शिवोद्भवम् ..
अस्या उपरि वेश्याया निंदिताया विचक्षणैः .. 17 ..
समादाय निजे हर्म्य एतां संस्थापयिष्यति ..
परं लज्जासमोपेतो न ब्रवीति वचः शुभे .. 18 . ..
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
नारदस्य वचः श्रुत्वा दृष्ट्वा कांतं चतुर्मुखम् ..
क्रोधेन महताविष्टा विकृतं वीक्ष्य तं हरम् .. 19 ..
5.152.m:
I know this: nowhere is there / a woman equal to you; and everyone else knows it too, O mistress of the gods!
Today you will become an object of ridicule, O Pārvatī, / to all the wives of the gods, knowing Īśvara is attached to another woman!
O goddess, you know what kind of heart belongs to Śiva / toward this courtesan, who is censured by the wise!
Taking her, he will install her in his own palace; / but filled with shame, he utters no word, O auspicious one!' / Sūta said: / Hearing Nārada's words and seeing her husband with four faces, / beholding that altered Hara, she was seized with great wrath.

5.152.s:
tato nirodhayā māsa drutaṃ sā parvatātmajā ..
sarvanetrāṇi devasya mahiṣīdharmamāśritā .. 6.153.20 ..
5.152.d:
ततो निरोधया मास द्रुतं सा पर्वतात्मजा ..
सर्वनेत्राणि देवस्य महिषीधर्ममाश्रिता .. 6.153.20 ..
5.152.m: Then, relying on the duty of a chief queen, that daughter of the mountain / quickly covered all the eyes of the god.

5.152.s:
etasminnaṃtare śailā viśīryaṃti samaṃtataḥ ..
maryādāṃ saṃtyajaṃti sma sarve ca makarālayāḥ .. 21 ..
5.152.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे शैला विशीर्यंति समंततः ..
मर्यादां संत्यजंति स्म सर्वे च मकरालयाः .. 21 ..
5.152.m: At that moment, mountains crumbled on all sides, / and all the oceans transgressed their boundaries.

5.152.s:
pralayasya samutthānaṃ saṃjātaṃ dvijasattamāḥ ..
tāvadbrahmadinaṃ prāptaṃ paramaṃ sṛṣṭilakṣaṇam .. 22 ..
5.152.d:
प्रलयस्य समुत्थानं संजातं द्विजसत्तमाः ..
तावद्ब्रह्मदिनं प्राप्तं परमं सृष्टिलक्षणम् .. 22 ..
5.152.m: The onset of universal dissolution arose, O best of the twice-born! / Meanwhile, the day of Brahmā arrived, whose supreme mark is creation;

5.152.s:
nimeṣeṇa punastasya pralayasya prajāpateḥ ..
brahmaṇaḥ sā niśā proktā sarvaṃ toyamayaṃ bhavet .. 23 ..
5.152.d:
निमेषेण पुनस्तस्य प्रलयस्य प्रजापतेः ..
ब्रह्मणः सा निशा प्रोक्ता सर्वं तोयमयं भवेत् .. 23 ..
5.152.m: Yet, in a twinkling, the dissolution of that Prajāpati [came again]; / that is called the night of Brahmā, when everything becomes watery.

5.152.s:
atha tatra gaṇāḥ sarve bhṛginaṃdipuraḥsarāḥ ..
so'pi devamunirbhītastāmuvāca sureśvarīm .. 24 ..
5.152.d:
अथ तत्र गणाः सर्वे भृगिनंदिपुरःसराः ..
सोऽपि देवमुनिर्भीतस्तामुवाच सुरेश्वरीम् .. 24 ..
5.152.m: Then all the gaṇas there, headed by Bhṛgin and Nandin, / and even that divine sage, terrified, spoke to the mistress of the gods:

5.152.s:
muṃcamuṃca surajyeṣṭhe devanetrāṇi saṃprati ..
nocennāśaḥ samastasya lokasyāsya bhaviṣyati .. 25 ..
5.152.d:
मुंचमुंच सुरज्येष्ठे देवनेत्राणि संप्रति ..
नोचेन्नाशः समस्तस्य लोकस्यास्य भविष्यति .. 25 ..
5.152.m: 'Release, release right now the god's eyes, O eldest among the gods! / Otherwise, the destruction of this entire world will occur!'

5.152.s:
evaṃ proktā'pi sā devī yāvacca na mumoca tam ..
tāvaddevena lālāṭaṃ visṛṣṭaṃ locanaṃ param.. 26 ..
5.152.d:
एवं प्रोक्ताऽपि सा देवी यावच्च न मुमोच तम् ..
तावद्देवेन लालाटं विसृष्टं लोचनं परम्.. 26 ..
5.152.m: Even though addressed in this way, so long as that goddess did not release him, / the god sent forth a supreme eye on his forehead,

5.152.s:
kṛpāviṣṭena lokānāṃ yena rakṣā prajāyate ..
na śakto vārituṃ devīṃ prāṇebhyo'pi garīyasīm .. 27 ..
5.152.d:
कृपाविष्टेन लोकानां येन रक्षा प्रजायते ..
न शक्तो वारितुं देवीं प्राणेभ्योऽपि गरीयसीम् .. 27 ..
5.152.m: filled with compassion for the worlds, by which protection came to be. / He was unable to restrain the goddess, who was dearer to him than his own breaths.

5.152.s:
aṃbikāṃ vibudhāḥ prāhustryaṃbakāṇi yato dvijāḥ ..
tasmātsaṃkīrtyate loke tryaṃbakaśca sureśvaraḥ .. 28 ..
5.152.d:
अंबिकां विबुधाः प्राहुस्त्र्यंबकाणि यतो द्विजाः ..
तस्मात्संकीर्त्यते लोके त्र्यंबकश्च सुरेश्वरः .. 28 ..
5.152.m: The wise call the eyes "ambaka", O twice-born ones; / therefore, because he has three ambakas, the lord of the gods is celebrated in the world as Tryambaka.

5.152.s:
tataḥ saṃtyajya taṃ devaṃ devī parvataputrikā ..
provāca koparaktākṣī puraḥsthāṃ tāṃ tilottamām .. 29 ..
5.152.d:
ततः संत्यज्य तं देवं देवी पर्वतपुत्रिका ..
प्रोवाच कोपरक्ताक्षी पुरःस्थां तां तिलोत्तमाम् .. 29 ..
5.152.m: Then, releasing that god, the goddess, daughter of the mountain, / her eyes red with anger, spoke to Tilottamā standing before her:

5.152.s:
yasmānme dayitaḥ pāpe tvayā rūpādviḍaṃbitaḥ ..
caturvaktraḥ kṛtastasmāttvaṃ virūpā bhava drutam .. 6.153.30 ..
5.152.d:
यस्मान्मे दयितः पापे त्वया रूपाद्विडंबितः ..
चतुर्वक्त्रः कृतस्तस्मात्त्वं विरूपा भव द्रुतम् .. 6.153.30 ..
5.152.m: 'Since my beloved was captivated by your beauty, O wretched woman, / and made four-faced, therefore quickly become deformed!'

5.152.s:
tataḥ sā sahasā bhūtvā tatkṣaṇādbhagnanāsikā ..
śīrṇakeśā bṛhaddaṃtā cipiṭākṣī mahodarā .. 31 ..
5.152.d:
ततः सा सहसा भूत्वा तत्क्षणाद्भग्ननासिका ..
शीर्णकेशा बृहद्दंता चिपिटाक्षी महोदरा .. 31 ..
5.152.m: Then, instantly, she suddenly became broken-nosed, / with disheveled hair, large teeth, flat eyes, and a swollen belly.

5.152.s:
atha vīkṣya nijaṃ dehaṃ tathābhūtaṃ varāpsarāḥ ..
provāca vepamānā sā kṛtāṃjalipuṭā sthitā .. 32 ..
5.152.d:
अथ वीक्ष्य निजं देहं तथाभूतं वराप्सराः ..
प्रोवाच वेपमाना सा कृतांजलिपुटा स्थिता .. 32 ..
5.152.m: Then, seeing her own body turned into such a state, the excellent apsaras, / trembling, stood with palms joined in reverence and spoke:

5.152.s:
ahaṃ saṃpreṣitā devi praṇāmārthaṃ triśūlinaḥ ..
brahmaṇā tena cāyātā yuṣmākaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ .. 33 ..
5.152.d:
अहं संप्रेषिता देवि प्रणामार्थं त्रिशूलिनः ..
ब्रह्मणा तेन चायाता युष्माकं च विशेषतः .. 33 ..
5.152.m: 'I was sent by Brahmā, O goddess, to bow down to the trident-bearer, / and especially to you both, and so I came.

5.152.s:
nirdoṣāyā virāgāyāstasmādyuktaṃ na te bhavet ..
śāpaṃ dātuṃ prasādaṃ me tasmāttvaṃ kartumarhasi .. 34 ..
5.152.d:
निर्दोषाया विरागायास्तस्माद्युक्तं न ते भवेत् ..
शापं दातुं प्रसादं मे तस्मात्त्वं कर्तुमर्हसि .. 34 ..
5.152.m: Therefore, toward me who am faultless and free from passion, it is not proper for you / to give a curse; therefore, you ought to show me grace.'

5.152.s:
tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā dīnaṃ satyaṃ ca pārvatī ..
paścāttāpasamopetā tataḥ provāca supriyam .. 35 ..
5.152.d:
तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा दीनं सत्यं च पार्वती ..
पश्चात्तापसमोपेता ततः प्रोवाच सुप्रियम् .. 35 ..
5.152.m: Hearing her words, which were piteous and true, Pārvatī, / filled with repentance, then spoke very kindly:

5.152.s:
strīsvabhāvātsamāyātaḥ kopo'yaṃ tvāṃ prati drutam ..
tasmādāgaccha gacchāvo mayā sārdhaṃ dharātale .. 36 ..
5.152.d:
स्त्रीस्वभावात्समायातः कोपोऽयं त्वां प्रति द्रुतम् ..
तस्मादागच्छ गच्छावो मया सार्धं धरातले .. 36 ..
5.152.m: 'Out of a woman's nature, this anger suddenly came upon me toward you; / therefore come, let the two of us go together to the surface of the earth.

5.152.s:
tatrāsti rūpadaṃ tīrthaṃ mayā cotpāditaṃ svayam ..
māghaśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ snānārthaṃ vimalodakam .. 37 ..
5.152.d:
तत्रास्ति रूपदं तीर्थं मया चोत्पादितं स्वयम् ..
माघशुक्लतृतीयायां स्नानार्थं विमलोदकम् .. 37 ..
5.152.m: There is a beauty-giving sacred ford, created by me myself, / with clear water, for bathing on the third day of the bright half of Māgha.

5.152.s:
yā nārī prātarutthāya tatra snānaṃ samācaret ..
sā syādrūpavatī nūnamadṛṣṭe ravimaṃḍale .. 38 ..
5.152.d:
या नारी प्रातरुत्थाय तत्र स्नानं समाचरेत् ..
सा स्याद्रूपवती नूनमदृष्टे रविमंडले .. 38 ..
5.152.m: Whatever woman, rising at dawn before the sun's orb is seen, / performs a ritual ablution there, she will surely become beautiful.

5.152.s:
sadā māghe tṛtīyāyāṃ tatra snānaṃ karomyaham ..
adya sā tatra yāsyāmi snānāya kṛtaniścayā .. 39 .. ..
5.152.d:
सदा माघे तृतीयायां तत्र स्नानं करोम्यहम् ..
अद्य सा तत्र यास्यामि स्नानाय कृतनिश्चया .. 39 .. ..
5.152.m: I always perform a ritual ablution there on the third day of Māgha; / today, with resolved mind, I shall go there for a ritual ablution.'

5.152.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evamuktvā samādāya sā devī tāṃ tilottamām ..
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre rūpatīrthaṃ jagāma ca .. 6.153.40 ..
5.152.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवमुक्त्वा समादाय सा देवी तां तिलोत्तमाम् ..
हाटकेश्वरजे क्षेत्रे रूपतीर्थं जगाम च .. 6.153.40 ..
5.152.m: Sūta said: / Having spoken thus, that goddess, taking Tilottamā, / went to the Rūpatīrtha in the sacred field born of Hāṭakeśvara.

5.152.s:
tatra snānaṃ svayaṃ cakre vidhipūrvaṃ sureśvarī ..
tasyā hyanantaraṃ sāpi bhaktiyuktā tilottamā .. 41 ..
5.152.d:
तत्र स्नानं स्वयं चक्रे विधिपूर्वं सुरेश्वरी ..
तस्या ह्यनन्तरं सापि भक्तियुक्ता तिलोत्तमा .. 41 ..
5.152.m: There, the mistress of the gods herself performed the ritual ablution according to the rules; / and immediately after her, Tilottamā also, endowed with devotion, [did so].

5.152.s:
tataḥ kāṃtimatī jātā tatkṣaṇādeva bhāminī ..
pūrvamāsīyadthārūpā tathāsā'bhūdviśeṣataḥ .. 42 ..
5.152.d:
ततः कांतिमती जाता तत्क्षणादेव भामिनी ..
पूर्वमासीयद्थारूपा तथासाऽभूद्विशेषतः .. 42 ..
5.152.m: Then that beautiful woman instantly became radiant with beauty; / just as she was previously, so she became, and even more so.

5.152.s:
atha tuṣṭisamāyuktā tāṃ praṇamya sureśvarīm ..
provāca vismayāviṣṭā harṣagadgadayā girā.. 43 ..
5.152.d:
अथ तुष्टिसमायुक्ता तां प्रणम्य सुरेश्वरीम् ..
प्रोवाच विस्मयाविष्टा हर्षगद्गदया गिरा.. 43 ..
5.152.m: Then, filled with satisfaction, bowing to that mistress of the gods, / she spoke, seized with wonder, in a voice faltering with joy:

5.152.s:
prāptaṃ rūpaṃ mahādevi tvatprasādāccirantanam..
brahmalokaṃ gamiṣyāmi māmanujñātumarhasi .. 44 ..
5.152.d:
प्राप्तं रूपं महादेवि त्वत्प्रसादाच्चिरन्तनम्..
ब्रह्मलोकं गमिष्यामि मामनुज्ञातुमर्हसि .. 44 ..
5.152.m: 'My former beauty has been regained by your grace, O great goddess! / I shall go to the world of Brahmā; you should grant me permission.'

5.152.s:
.. gauryuvāca .. ..
varaṃ yacchāmi te putri yatkiṃciddhṛdi saṃsthitam..
tasmātprārthaya viśrabdhā na vṛthā mama darśanam .. 45 ..
5.152.d:
.. गौर्युवाच .. ..
वरं यच्छामि ते पुत्रि यत्किंचिद्धृदि संस्थितम्..
तस्मात्प्रार्थय विश्रब्धा न वृथा मम दर्शनम् .. 45 ..
5.152.m: Gaurī said: / 'I grant you a boon, O daughter, whatever rests in your heart; / therefore ask with confidence; darśana of me is never in vain.'

5.152.s:
.. tilottamovāca .. ..
ahamatra kariṣyāmi kṣetre tīrthaṃ nijaṃ śubhe ..
tvatprasādena taddevi yātu khyātiṃ dharātale .. 46 ..
5.152.d:
.. तिलोत्तमोवाच .. ..
अहमत्र करिष्यामि क्षेत्रे तीर्थं निजं शुभे ..
त्वत्प्रसादेन तद्देवि यातु ख्यातिं धरातले .. 46 ..
5.152.m: Tilottamā said: / 'I shall make my own sacred ford here in this sacred field, O auspicious one; / by your grace, O goddess, let it attain fame on the surface of the earth!

5.152.s:
tvayā tatrāpi kartavyaṃ varṣāṃte snānameva hi ..
hitārthaṃ sarvanārīṇāṃ rūpasaubhāgyadāyakam .. 47 .. ..
5.152.d:
त्वया तत्रापि कर्तव्यं वर्षांते स्नानमेव हि ..
हितार्थं सर्वनारीणां रूपसौभाग्यदायकम् .. 47 .. ..
5.152.m: You too must perform a ritual ablution there at the end of the year, / granting beauty and good fortune, for the benefit of all women.'

5.152.s:
.. gauryuvāca .. ..
caitraśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ sadāhaṃ tvatkṛte śubhe ..
snānaṃ tatra kariṣyāmi madhyāhne samupasthite .. 48 ..
5.152.d:
.. गौर्युवाच .. ..
चैत्रशुक्लतृतीयायां सदाहं त्वत्कृते शुभे ..
स्नानं तत्र करिष्यामि मध्याह्ने समुपस्थिते .. 48 ..
5.152.m: Gaurī said: / 'On the third day of the bright half of Caitra, for your sake, O auspicious one, / I will always perform a ritual ablution there when midday arrives,

5.152.s:
hitārthaṃ sarvanārīṇāṃ tava vākyādasaṃśayam ..
yā tatra divase nārī tasmiṃstīrthe kariṣyati .. 49 ..
5.152.d:
हितार्थं सर्वनारीणां तव वाक्यादसंशयम् ..
या तत्र दिवसे नारी तस्मिंस्तीर्थे करिष्यति .. 49 ..
5.152.m: undoubtedly for the benefit of all women, according to your word. / Whatever woman, on that day, performs [an ablution] in that sacred ford,'

5.152.s:
snānaṃ sā saukhyasaṃyuktā bhaviṣyati sukhānvitā ..
spṛhaṇīyā ca nārīṇāṃ sarvāsāṃ dharaṇītale .. 6.153.50 ..
5.152.d:
स्नानं सा सौख्यसंयुक्ता भविष्यति सुखान्विता ..
स्पृहणीया च नारीणां सर्वासां धरणीतले .. 6.153.50 ..
5.152.m: ritual ablution, she will be endowed with well-being and filled with happiness, / and will be an object of envy for all women on the face of the earth. // 6.153.50

5.152.s:
puruṣo'pi subhaktyā yastatra snānaṃ kariṣyati ..
saptajanmāni rūpāḍhyaḥ sasaubhāgyo bhaviṣyati .. 51 ..
5.152.d:
पुरुषोऽपि सुभक्त्या यस्तत्र स्नानं करिष्यति ..
सप्तजन्मानि रूपाढ्यः ससौभाग्यो भविष्यति .. 51 ..
5.152.m: Even a man who performs ritual ablution there with true devotion / will be endowed with beauty and good fortune for seven births. // 51

5.152.s:
sūta uvāca .. ..
evamuktā tadā devyā sāpsarā dvijasattamāḥ ..
cakre kuṇḍaṃ suvistīrṇaṃ vimalodaprapūritam.. 52 ..
5.152.d:
सूत उवाच .. ..
एवमुक्ता तदा देव्या साप्सरा द्विजसत्तमाः ..
चक्रे कुण्डं सुविस्तीर्णं विमलोदप्रपूरितम्.. 52 ..
5.152.m: Sūta said: / Thus addressed by the goddess then, O best of the twice-born, / that apsaras made a very extensive pool filled with pure water. // 52

5.152.s:
upakaṃṭhe tatastasya sthāpayāmāsa pārvatīm ..
tato jagāma saṃhṛṣṭā brahmalokaṃ tilottamā .. 53 ..
5.152.d:
उपकंठे ततस्तस्य स्थापयामास पार्वतीम् ..
ततो जगाम संहृष्टा ब्रह्मलोकं तिलोत्तमा .. 53 ..
5.152.m: Near its edge she then installed Pārvatī. / Thereupon Tilottamā, greatly delighted, went to the world of Brahmā. // 53

5.152.s:
tataḥ prabhṛti saṃjātaṃ kuṇḍamapsarasā kṛtam ..
snānamātrairnarairyatra saubhāgyaṃ labhyate dvijāḥ .. 54 ..
5.152.d:
ततः प्रभृति संजातं कुण्डमप्सरसा कृतम् ..
स्नानमात्रैर्नरैर्यत्र सौभाग्यं लभ्यते द्विजाः .. 54 ..
5.152.m: From that time forward, that pool made by the apsaras came into being, / where by mere ablutions men obtain good fortune, O twice-born. // 54

5.152.s:
nārībhiśca viśeṣeṇa putraprāptiranuttamā ..
tathānyadapi yatkiṃcidvāṃchitaṃ hṛdaye sthitam .. 55 ..
5.152.d:
नारीभिश्च विशेषेण पुत्रप्राप्तिरनुत्तमा ..
तथान्यदपि यत्किंचिद्वांछितं हृदये स्थितम् .. 55 ..
5.152.m: And women, in particular, obtain the supreme attainment of sons, / as well as whatever other desire is held in their hearts. // 55

5.152.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe śrīhāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye'psaraḥkuṇḍotpattimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma tripaṃcāśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 153 ..
5.152.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे श्रीहाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्येऽप्सरःकुण्डोत्पत्तिमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम त्रिपंचाशदुत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 153 ..
5.152.m: Thus ends the one hundred and fifty-third chapter, entitled 'Description of the Origin and Māhātmya of the Pool of the Apsaras' in the Māhātmya of the Sacred Field of Śrī Hāṭakeśvara, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [book] in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses. // 153

5.153.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
yā nārī tatra satkuṇḍe snātvā tāṃ pārvatīṃ punaḥ ..
dṛṣṭvā snāti tatastīrthe tasminrūpamaye śubhe ..1..
5.153.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
या नारी तत्र सत्कुण्डे स्नात्वा तां पार्वतीं पुनः ..
दृष्ट्वा स्नाति ततस्तीर्थे तस्मिन्रूपमये शुभे ..1..
5.153.m: Sūta said: / The woman who, having bathed there in that noble pool, then gazes upon Pārvatī, / and then bathes in that auspicious sacred ford endowed with beauty, // 1

5.153.s:
punaśca pārvatīṃ paśyecchraddhayā parayā yutā ..
sadyaḥ sā mucyate kṛtsnairājanmamaraṇāṃtikaiḥ .. 2 ..
5.153.d:
पुनश्च पार्वतीं पश्येच्छ्रद्धया परया युता ..
सद्यः सा मुच्यते कृत्स्नैराजन्ममरणांतिकैः .. 2 ..
5.153.m: and looks upon Pārvatī again endowed with supreme faith, / is immediately freed entirely from [sins] ending in birth and death. // 2

5.153.s:
tatraivāsti jayānāma pārvatyāḥ kiṃkarī dvijāḥ ..
tayā tatra kṛtaṃ kuṇḍaṃ gaurīkuṇḍasamīpataḥ .. 3 ..
5.153.d:
तत्रैवास्ति जयानाम पार्वत्याः किंकरी द्विजाः ..
तया तत्र कृतं कुण्डं गौरीकुण्डसमीपतः .. 3 ..
5.153.m: Right there, O twice-born, is a female attendant of Pārvatī named Jayā; / by her a pool was made there near Gaurī's pool. // 3

5.153.s:
yā tatra kurute snānaṃ tṛtīyādivase'balā ..
sutasaubhāgyasaṃpannā sā bhavetpativallabhā .. 4 ..
5.153.d:
या तत्र कुरुते स्नानं तृतीयादिवसेऽबला ..
सुतसौभाग्यसंपन्ना सा भवेत्पतिवल्लभा .. 4 ..
5.153.m: The woman who performs ritual ablution there on the third lunar day / becomes endowed with sons and good fortune, and beloved of her husband. // 4

5.153.s:
tathānyadapi tatrāsti vijayākuṇḍamuttamam ..
tatra snātā'pi vaṃdhyā strī jāyate putrasaṃyutā .. 5 ..
5.153.d:
तथान्यदपि तत्रास्ति विजयाकुण्डमुत्तमम् ..
तत्र स्नाताऽपि वंध्या स्त्री जायते पुत्रसंयुता .. 5 ..
5.153.m: Likewise, there is another excellent pool there [called] Vijayākuṇḍa; / even a barren woman who has bathed there becomes endowed with sons. // 5

5.153.s:
na ca paśyati putrāṇāṃ kadācidvyasanaṃ dvijāḥ ..
na viyogaṃ na duḥkhaṃ ca svapnāṃte ca kadācana ..6..
5.153.d:
न च पश्यति पुत्राणां कदाचिद्व्यसनं द्विजाः ..
न वियोगं न दुःखं च स्वप्नांते च कदाचन ..6..
5.153.m: And she never sees any calamity befall her sons, O twice-born, / neither separation nor sorrow, even in a dream. // 6

5.153.s:
kākavaṃdhyā'pi yā nārī tatra snānaṃ samācaret..
sā putrānvividhām̐llabdhvā svargaloke mahīyate ..7.. ..
5.153.d:
काकवंध्याऽपि या नारी तत्र स्नानं समाचरेत्..
सा पुत्रान्विविधाम्̐ल्लब्ध्वा स्वर्गलोके महीयते ..7.. ..
5.153.m: Even a woman who has borne only one child, if she performs ritual ablution there, / obtains various sons and is exalted in the heavenly world. // 7

5.153.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
eteṣāṃ sūta tīrthānāṃ tīrthamasti susiddhidam..
kvacitkiṃñcidbhavetsiddhiryatra snānāccharīrajā .. 8..
5.153.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
एतेषां सूत तीर्थानां तीर्थमस्ति सुसिद्धिदम्..
क्वचित्किंञ्चिद्भवेत्सिद्धिर्यत्र स्नानाच्छरीरजा .. 8..
5.153.m: The seers said: / Among these sacred fords, O Sūta, is there a sacred ford that grants complete siddhi, / where from ritual ablution some bodily siddhi might occur anywhere? // 8

5.153.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
saptaviṃśatiliṃgāni yāni saṃti dvijottamāḥ ..
teṣāṃ madhye'bhavatsiddhirekasminnikhilā dvijāḥ ..9..
5.153.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
सप्तविंशतिलिंगानि यानि संति द्विजोत्तमाः ..
तेषां मध्येऽभवत्सिद्धिरेकस्मिन्निखिला द्विजाः ..9..
5.153.m: Sūta said: / Among the twenty-seven liṅgas that exist, O best of the twice-born, / complete siddhi was attained by one person, O twice-born: // 9

5.153.s:
ekasya sattvayuktasya vīravratayutasya ca ..
āśvinasya caturdaśyāṃ kṛṣṇāyāṃ dvijasattamāḥ..6.154.10..
5.153.d:
एकस्य सत्त्वयुक्तस्य वीरव्रतयुतस्य च ..
आश्विनस्य चतुर्दश्यां कृष्णायां द्विजसत्तमाः..6.154.10..
5.153.m: by one who possessed sattva and was endowed with the hero's vow, / on the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight of Āśvina, O best of the twice-born. // 6.154.10

5.153.s:
ardharātre vidhānena teṣāṃ pūjāṃ karoti yaḥ ..
prāguktaṃ japanaṃ bhaktyā sa kramātsādhakottamaḥ..11..
5.153.d:
अर्धरात्रे विधानेन तेषां पूजां करोति यः ..
प्रागुक्तं जपनं भक्त्या स क्रमात्साधकोत्तमः..11..
5.153.m: He who properly performs worship of them at midnight, / and with devotion recites the aforesaid recitation, that excellent adept, in due order, // 11

5.153.s:
aṃganyāsaṃ vidhāyoccaiḥ kṣurikāsūktamuccarat ..
teṣāmagre punaḥ samyakpūjayitvā ca śaṃkaram .. 12 ..
5.153.d:
अंगन्यासं विधायोच्चैः क्षुरिकासूक्तमुच्चरत् ..
तेषामग्रे पुनः सम्यक्पूजयित्वा च शंकरम् .. 12 ..
5.153.m: having performed the placement of mantras on the body, should utter aloud the Kṣurikāsūkta. / Then, in front of them, having duly worshipped Śaṃkara, // 12

5.153.s: pṛthagekaikaśo bhaktyā pūjayeddikpatīṃśca vai .. 13 ..
5.153.d: पृथगेकैकशो भक्त्या पूजयेद्दिक्पतींश्च वै .. 13 ..
5.153.m: he should worship the guardians of the directions individually, one by one, with devotion. // 13

5.153.s:
athā''gatya gaṇeśo vai vikarālo bhayānakaḥ ..
laṃbodaro vai nagnaśca kṛṣṇadantasamudbhavaḥ .. 14 ..
5.153.d:
अथा'ऽगत्य गणेशो वै विकरालो भयानकः ..
लंबोदरो वै नग्नश्च कृष्णदन्तसमुद्भवः .. 14 ..
5.153.m: Then, having arrived, Gaṇeśa indeed, hideous and terrifying, / pot-bellied, naked, and having dark teeth, // 14

5.153.s:
khaḍgahasto'bravīdyuddhaṃ prakuruṣva mayā samam ..
muktvaitatkapaṭaṃ bhūmau yadi vīro'si sāttvikaḥ .. 15 ..
5.153.d:
खड्गहस्तोऽब्रवीद्युद्धं प्रकुरुष्व मया समम् ..
मुक्त्वैतत्कपटं भूमौ यदि वीरोऽसि सात्त्विकः .. 15 ..
5.153.m: sword in hand, said: 'Engage in battle with me! / Giving up this deceit on earth, if you are a hero endowed with sattva!' // 15

5.153.s:
tatastatkarṣaṇāccāpi yastenāśu pratāḍyate ..
sa tenaiva śarīreṇa nīyate tena tatpadam .. 16 ..
5.153.d:
ततस्तत्कर्षणाच्चापि यस्तेनाशु प्रताड्यते ..
स तेनैव शरीरेण नीयते तेन तत्पदम् .. 16 ..
5.153.m: Then, he who is quickly struck by him upon that provocation / is led by him with that very body to that realm // 16

5.153.s:
yatra sthāne jarāmṛtyurna śokaśca kadācana ..
tathā citreśvarīpīṭhe siddhirekasya kīrtitā .. 17 ..
5.153.d:
यत्र स्थाने जरामृत्युर्न शोकश्च कदाचन ..
तथा चित्रेश्वरीपीठे सिद्धिरेकस्य कीर्तिता .. 17 ..
5.153.m: where there is neither old age, nor death, nor sorrow at any time. / Likewise, at the seat of Citreśvarī, siddhi is proclaimed for one [adept]. // 17

5.153.s:
māghakṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ yaḥ pīṭhaṃ tatra pūjayet ..
āgamoktavidhānena samyakchraddhāsamanvitaḥ .. 19 ..
paścātkapālamādāya mahāmāṃsaprapūritam ..
ahamasya karomyadya mahāmāṃsasya vikrayam .. 19 ..
5.153.d:
माघकृष्णचतुर्दश्यां यः पीठं तत्र पूजयेत् ..
आगमोक्तविधानेन सम्यक्छ्रद्धासमन्वितः .. 19 ..
पश्चात्कपालमादाय महामांसप्रपूरितम् ..
अहमस्य करोम्यद्य महामांसस्य विक्रयम् .. 19 ..
5.153.m:
He who worships the seat there on the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight of Māgha, / according to the procedure taught in the āgamas, accompanied by full faith, // 18
and afterwards, taking a skull filled with human flesh, [declares:] / 'Today I offer this human flesh for sale! // 19

5.153.s:
siddhimūlye na gṛhṇātu kaściccedasti sāttvikaḥ ..
tataśca yācate yaśca pragṛhṇāti ca saddvijāḥ .. 6.154.20 ..
5.153.d:
सिद्धिमूल्ये न गृह्णातु कश्चिच्चेदस्ति सात्त्विकः ..
ततश्च याचते यश्च प्रगृह्णाति च सद्द्विजाः .. 6.154.20 ..
5.153.m: Let someone take it for the price of siddhi, if there is anyone endowed with sattva!' / And then, O noble twice-born, whoever begs and accepts it, // 6.154.20

5.153.s:
sa tamādāya niryāti yatra devo maheśvaraḥ ..
hāṭakeśvarajaṃ liṃgaṃ citraśarmapratiṣṭhitam .. 21 ..
5.153.d:
स तमादाय निर्याति यत्र देवो महेश्वरः ..
हाटकेश्वरजं लिंगं चित्रशर्मप्रतिष्ठितम् .. 21 ..
5.153.m: he, taking it, departs to where the lord Maheśvara is, / the liṅga born of Hāṭakeśvara, installed by Citraśarman. // 21

5.153.s:
tasya sthānasya madhyastho yastaṃ pūjayate naraḥ ..
śivarātrau niśīthe ca puṣpalakṣaṇabhaktitaḥ ..
susiddhimāpnuyāttūrṇaṃ sa śarīreṇa tatkṣaṇāt .. 22 ..
5.153.d:
तस्य स्थानस्य मध्यस्थो यस्तं पूजयते नरः ..
शिवरात्रौ निशीथे च पुष्पलक्षणभक्तितः ..
सुसिद्धिमाप्नुयात्तूर्णं स शरीरेण तत्क्षणात् .. 22 ..
5.153.m: Standing in the midst of that place, the man who worships it / on Śivarātri at midnight with devotion, using a hundred thousand flowers, / immediately attains complete siddhi along with his physical body at that very moment. // 22

5.153.s:
siddhisthānāni sarvāṇi tasminkṣetre sthitāni vai..
vīravrataprayuktānāṃ mānavānāṃ dvijottamāḥ .. 23 .. ..
5.153.d:
सिद्धिस्थानानि सर्वाणि तस्मिन्क्षेत्रे स्थितानि वै..
वीरव्रतप्रयुक्तानां मानवानां द्विजोत्तमाः .. 23 .. ..
5.153.m: All the abodes of perfections in that sacred field are situated, / O best of the twice-born, for men committed to the hero's vow. // 23

5.153.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
tāmaso yastvayā proktaḥ siddhimārgo mahāmate ..
anarho brāhmaṇendrāṇāṃ śrotriyāṇāṃ viśeṣataḥ .. 24 ..
5.153.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
तामसो यस्त्वया प्रोक्तः सिद्धिमार्गो महामते ..
अनर्हो ब्राह्मणेन्द्राणां श्रोत्रियाणां विशेषतः .. 24 ..
5.153.m: The seers said: / The path to siddhi which has been proclaimed by you, O highly intelligent one, is tāmasic, / unsuitable for the foremost of brahmins, especially those learned in the Vedas. // 24

5.153.s:
śuddhāntaḥ karaṇaiḥ sūta bhūtahiṃsāvivarjitaiḥ ..
yathā saṃprāpyate mokṣo brāhmaṇaiḥ sucirādapi .. 25 ..
5.153.d:
शुद्धान्तः करणैः सूत भूतहिंसाविवर्जितैः ..
यथा संप्राप्यते मोक्षो ब्राह्मणैः सुचिरादपि .. 25 ..
5.153.m: Tell, O Sūta, how liberation may be obtained, even after a long time, / by brahmins whose inner faculties are purified, who are free from injury to living beings. // 25

5.153.s: tattvaṃ brūhi mahābhāga mokṣopāyaṃ dvijanmanām .. 26 .. ..
5.153.d: तत्त्वं ब्रूहि महाभाग मोक्षोपायं द्विजन्मनाम् .. 26 .. ..
5.153.m: Speak the truth, O fortunate one, the means of liberation for the twice-born! // 26

5.153.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
rudrairdaśabhiḥ saṃyuktamānaṃdeśvarakaṃ tathā ..
snātvā tadagrataḥ kuṇḍe śāstradṛṣṭena karmaṇā .. 27 ..
5.153.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
रुद्रैर्दशभिः संयुक्तमानंदेश्वरकं तथा ..
स्नात्वा तदग्रतः कुण्डे शास्त्रदृष्टेन कर्मणा .. 27 ..
5.153.m: Sūta said: / Likewise, [there is the liṅga] Ānandeśvara associated with the ten Rudras; / having bathed in the pool before it according to the rite seen in scripture, // 27

5.153.s:
saṃsiddhimāpnuyānmartyo durlabhāṃ tridaśairapi ..
māghamāse naraḥ snātvā viśvāmitrahrade naraḥ .. 28 ..
5.153.d:
संसिद्धिमाप्नुयान्मर्त्यो दुर्लभां त्रिदशैरपि ..
माघमासे नरः स्नात्वा विश्वामित्रह्रदे नरः .. 28 ..
5.153.m: a mortal attains complete siddhi, difficult even for the gods to attain. / Having bathed in the month of Māgha in the pool of Viśvāmitra, a man, // 28

5.153.s:
pratyūṣe tilapātraṃ ca brāhmaṇāya nivedayet ..
sarvapāpavinirmukto brahma loke mahīyate .. 29 ..
5.153.d:
प्रत्यूषे तिलपात्रं च ब्राह्मणाय निवेदयेत् ..
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो ब्रह्म लोके महीयते .. 29 ..
5.153.m: and offering a vessel of sesame seeds to a brahmin at dawn, / is completely freed from all sins and is exalted in the world of Brahmā. // 29

5.153.s:
yadyapi syāddurācāraḥ sarvāśī sarvavikrayī ..
suparṇākhyasya devasya purataḥ śraddhayā'nvitaḥ .. 6.154.30 ..
5.153.d:
यद्यपि स्याद्दुराचारः सर्वाशी सर्वविक्रयी ..
सुपर्णाख्यस्य देवस्य पुरतः श्रद्धयाऽन्वितः .. 6.154.30 ..
5.153.m: Even if he were of wicked conduct, eating all things and selling all things, / if, endowed with faith before the god named Suparṇa, // 6.154.30

5.153.s:
prāyopaveśanaṃ kṛtvā hyupavāsaparo naraḥ ..
yastyajenmānavaḥ prāṇānna sa bhūyo'bhijāyate .. 31 ..
5.153.d:
प्रायोपवेशनं कृत्वा ह्युपवासपरो नरः ..
यस्त्यजेन्मानवः प्राणान्न स भूयोऽभिजायते .. 31 ..
5.153.m: a man undertakes fasting unto death, dedicated to fasting, / and gives up his life-breaths, that human is not born again. // 31

5.153.s:
evaṃ siddhitrayaṃ proktaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ hitāvaham ..
sāttvikaṃ brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhāḥ śaṃsitaṃ tridaśairapi .. 32 ..
5.153.d:
एवं सिद्धित्रयं प्रोक्तं ब्राह्मणानां हितावहम् ..
सात्त्विकं ब्राह्मणश्रेष्ठाः शंसितं त्रिदशैरपि .. 32 ..
5.153.m: Thus the triad of siddhis beneficial to brahmins has been proclaimed, / sāttvic, O best of brahmins, praised even by the thirty [gods]. // 32

5.153.s:
anyāni tatra tīrthāni devatāyatanāni ca ..
tāni svargapradānyāhurmunayaḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ .. 33 ..
5.153.d:
अन्यानि तत्र तीर्थानि देवतायतनानि च ..
तानि स्वर्गप्रदान्याहुर्मुनयः शंसितव्रताः .. 33 ..
5.153.m: The other sacred fords and temples of deities there, / sages of praised vows have declared them to be bestowal of heaven. // 33

5.153.s:
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ kṣetramāhātmyamuttamam ..
hāṭakeśvaradevasya sarvapātakanāśanam .. 34 ..
5.153.d:
एतद्वः सर्वमाख्यातं क्षेत्रमाहात्म्यमुत्तमम् ..
हाटकेश्वरदेवस्य सर्वपातकनाशनम् .. 34 ..
5.153.m: All this excellent māhātmya of the sacred field of the god Hāṭakeśvara, / destroying all wicked deeds, has been narrated to you. // 34

5.153.s:
yo'tra sarveṣu tīrtheṣu snātvā paśyati bhaktitaḥ ..
sarvāṇyāyatanānyeva sa pāpo'pi vimucyate .. 35 ..
5.153.d:
योऽत्र सर्वेषु तीर्थेषु स्नात्वा पश्यति भक्तितः ..
सर्वाण्यायतनान्येव स पापोऽपि विमुच्यते .. 35 ..
5.153.m: He who, having bathed in all the sacred fords here, looks with devotion / upon all the temples, is liberated, even if he is a sinner. // 35

5.153.s:
etatkhaṃḍaṃ purāṇasya prathamaṃ parikīrtitam ..
kārtikeyapraṇītasya sarvapāpaharaṃ śubham .. 36 ..
5.153.d:
एतत्खंडं पुराणस्य प्रथमं परिकीर्तितम् ..
कार्तिकेयप्रणीतस्य सर्वपापहरं शुभम् .. 36 ..
5.153.m: This is proclaimed as the first section of the Purāṇa / composed by Kārtikeya, auspicious and removing all sin. // 36

5.153.s:
yaścaitatkīrtayedbhaktyā śṛṇuyādvā samāhitaḥ ..
iha bhuktvā suvipulānbhogānyāti triviṣṭapam .. 37 ..
5.153.d:
यश्चैतत्कीर्तयेद्भक्त्या शृणुयाद्वा समाहितः ..
इह भुक्त्वा सुविपुलान्भोगान्याति त्रिविष्टपम् .. 37 ..
5.153.m:
And whoever proclaims this with devotion or listens attentively,
having enjoyed vast pleasures here, goes to heaven.

5.153.s:
sarvatīrtheṣu yatpuṇyaṃ sarvadānaiśca yatphalam ..
tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti śṛṇvañchraddhāsamanvitaḥ .. 38 ..
5.153.d:
सर्वतीर्थेषु यत्पुण्यं सर्वदानैश्च यत्फलम् ..
तत्फलं समवाप्नोति शृण्वञ्छ्रद्धासमन्वितः .. 38 ..
5.153.m:
Whatever merit is found in all sacred fords, and whatever fruit through all gifts,
he obtains that full fruit, listening endowed with faith.

5.153.s:
śrutvā purāṇametaddhi janmakoṭisamudbhavāt ..
pātakādvipramucyeta kulānāmuddharecchatam .. 39 ..
5.153.d:
श्रुत्वा पुराणमेतद्धि जन्मकोटिसमुद्भवात् ..
पातकाद्विप्रमुच्येत कुलानामुद्धरेच्छतम् .. 39 ..
5.153.m:
Indeed, having heard this Purāṇa, from sins arising in ten million births
he is freed, and he delivers a hundred families.

5.153.s:
tato vyāsaḥ pūjanīyo vastradānādibhūṣaṇaiḥ ..
gobhūhiraṇyanirvāpairdānaiśca vividhairapi ..6.154.40..
5.153.d:
ततो व्यासः पूजनीयो वस्त्रदानादिभूषणैः ..
गोभूहिरण्यनिर्वापैर्दानैश्च विविधैरपि ..6.154.40..
5.153.m:
Then Vyāsa should be worshipped with gifts of garments and ornaments,
with gifts of cows, land, gold, portions of food, and various other offerings.

5.153.s:
tena saṃpūjito vyāsaḥ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaḥ manuḥ ..
sākṣātsatyavatīputro yena vyāsaḥ supūjitaḥ..41..
5.153.d:
तेन संपूजितो व्यासः कृष्णद्वैपायनः मनुः ..
साक्षात्सत्यवतीपुत्रो येन व्यासः सुपूजितः..41..
5.153.m:
By him has Vyāsa Kṛṣṇa Dvaipāyana, the wise sage,
the son of Satyavatī in person, been thoroughly worshipped, by whom Vyāsa is well worshipped.

5.153.s:
ekamapyakṣaraṃ yastu guruḥ śiṣye nivedayet..
pṛthivyāṃ nāsti taddravyaṃ yaddattvā hyanṛṇī bhavet ..42..
5.153.d:
एकमप्यक्षरं यस्तु गुरुः शिष्ये निवेदयेत्..
पृथिव्यां नास्ति तद्द्रव्यं यद्दत्त्वा ह्यनृणी भवेत् ..42..
5.153.m:
Whatever single syllable a guru may impart to a disciple,
there is no object on earth by giving which he could become free of debt.

5.153.s:
etatpavitramāyuṣyaṃ dhanyaṃ sva styayanaṃ mahat..
yacchrutvā sarvaduḥkhebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ..43.
5.153.d:
एतत्पवित्रमायुष्यं धन्यं स्व स्त्ययनं महत्..
यच्छ्रुत्वा सर्वदुःखेभ्यो मुच्यते नात्र संशयः..43.
5.153.m:
This is purifying, longevity-granting, auspicious, and a great invocation of welfare,
hearing which one is freed from all sorrows; there is no doubt about this.

5.153.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvara kṣetramāhātmye citreśvarīpīṭhakṣetramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catuḥpaṃcāśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ..154..
5.153.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वर क्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये चित्रेश्वरीपीठक्षेत्रमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम चतुःपंचाशदुत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः..154..
5.153.m: Thus ends the one hundred fifty-fourth chapter, titled 'Description of the Māhātmya of the Seat and Sacred Field of Citreśvarī,' in the Hāṭakeśvara Sacred Field Māhātmya, in the sixth Nāgarakhaṇḍa, in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

5.154.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tathā'nye tatra tiṣṭhaṃti vasavo'ṣṭau dvijottamāḥ..
sthānamekaṃ samāśritya sarvadaiva prapūjitāḥ..1..
5.154.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तथाऽन्ये तत्र तिष्ठंति वसवोऽष्टौ द्विजोत्तमाः..
स्थानमेकं समाश्रित्य सर्वदैव प्रपूजिताः..1..
5.154.m:
Sūta said:
Likewise, others abide there: the eight Vasus, best of brahmins,
settled together in one place, constantly worshipped.

5.154.s:
ekādaśa tathā rudrā ādityā dvādaśaiva tu ..
devavaidyau tathā cānyāvaśvinau tatra saṃsthitau ..2..
5.154.d:
एकादश तथा रुद्रा आदित्या द्वादशैव तु ..
देववैद्यौ तथा चान्यावश्विनौ तत्र संस्थितौ ..2..
5.154.m:
Likewise, the eleven Rudras, the twelve Ādityas,
and the other two, the physicians of the gods, the Aśvins, are stationed there.

5.154.s:
devatāstatra tiṣṭhaṃti koṭikoṭipranāyakāḥ..
ekaikā brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhāḥ kalikālabhayākulāḥ..3..
5.154.d:
देवतास्तत्र तिष्ठंति कोटिकोटिप्रनायकाः..
एकैका ब्राह्मणश्रेष्ठाः कलिकालभयाकुलाः..3..
5.154.m:
Deities reside there, commanders of tens of millions,
each one, O best of brahmins, terrified by the fear of the Kali age,

5.154.s:
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre yajñabhāgāptaye sadā ..
aṣṭamyāṃ śuklapakṣe tu madhumāse vyavasthite .. 4 ..
5.154.d:
हाटकेश्वरजे क्षेत्रे यज्ञभागाप्तये सदा ..
अष्टम्यां शुक्लपक्षे तु मधुमासे व्यवस्थिते .. 4 ..
5.154.m:
in the sacred field born of Hāṭakeśvara, in order always to obtain a share of sacrifices.
When the eighth day in the bright fortnight has arrived in the spring month,

5.154.s:
yastānvasūñchucirbhūtvā snātvā dhautāṃbaro naraḥ ..
tarpayitvā dvijaśreṣṭhānpaścātsaṃpūjayennaraḥ .. 5 ..
5.154.d:
यस्तान्वसूञ्छुचिर्भूत्वा स्नात्वा धौतांबरो नरः ..
तर्पयित्वा द्विजश्रेष्ठान्पश्चात्संपूजयेन्नरः .. 5 ..
5.154.m:
the person who, having become pure, having bathed and worn washed garments,
having satisfied the best of brahmins, should then worship those Vasus,

5.154.s:
vasavastvā kṛṇvanniti mantreṇānena bhaktitaḥ ..
naivedyaṃ ca tato dadyādvasavaśchaṃdasāviti .. 6 ..
5.154.d:
वसवस्त्वा कृण्वन्निति मन्त्रेणानेन भक्तितः ..
नैवेद्यं च ततो दद्याद्वसवश्छंदसाविति .. 6 ..
5.154.m:
with devotion using the mantra, 'May the Vasus make you...',
and should then offer food-offering with [the mantra], 'May the Vasus with the metre...'

5.154.s:
tato dhūpaṃ sugandhaṃ ca yo yacchati samāhitaḥ ..
vasavastvāṃ jetu tathā mantrametamudīrayet .. 7 ..
5.154.d:
ततो धूपं सुगन्धं च यो यच्छति समाहितः ..
वसवस्त्वां जेतु तथा मन्त्रमेतमुदीरयेत् .. 7 ..
5.154.m:
Then, one who with focused mind offers fragrant incense
should recite this mantra: 'May the Vasus conquer you...'

5.154.s:
ārārtikaṃ tato bhūyo yaḥ karoti dvijottamāḥ ..
vasavastvāṃ jetu tathā śrūyatāṃ yatphalaṃ hi tat .. 8 ..
5.154.d:
आरार्तिकं ततो भूयो यः करोति द्विजोत्तमाः ..
वसवस्त्वां जेतु तथा श्रूयतां यत्फलं हि तत् .. 8 ..
5.154.m:
Thereafter, O best of brahmins, whoever performs the wave-offering of lamps
with 'May the Vasus conquer you...': hear what fruit that indeed yields.

5.154.s:
kanyābhiḥ koṭibhiryacca pūjitābhirbhavetphalam..
vasūnāṃ caiva tatsarvamaṣṭabhistaiḥ prapūjitaiḥ .. 9..
5.154.d:
कन्याभिः कोटिभिर्यच्च पूजिताभिर्भवेत्फलम्..
वसूनां चैव तत्सर्वमष्टभिस्तैः प्रपूजितैः .. 9..
5.154.m:
Whatever fruit there would be from ten million virgins being worshipped,
all that is attained through the eight Vasus being thoroughly worshipped.

5.154.s:
tathā ye dvādaśādityāstasminkṣetre vyavasthitāḥ ..
tānsthāpya pūjayitvā ca saptamyāmarkavāsare ..
samyakchraddhāsamopetaḥ puṣpagandhānulepanaiḥ .. 6.155.10 ..
5.154.d:
तथा ये द्वादशादित्यास्तस्मिन्क्षेत्रे व्यवस्थिताः ..
तान्स्थाप्य पूजयित्वा च सप्तम्यामर्कवासरे ..
सम्यक्छ्रद्धासमोपेतः पुष्पगन्धानुलेपनैः .. 6.155.10 ..
5.154.m:
Likewise, for the twelve Ādityas stationed in that sacred field,
having installed them and worshipped them on a Sunday that is the seventh lunar day,
endowed with perfect faith, with flowers, fragrances, and unguents,

5.154.s:
paścāttatpuratasteṣāṃ samastānyekaviṃśatiḥ ..
ādityavrata saṃjñāni tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu ..11..
5.154.d:
पश्चात्तत्पुरतस्तेषां समस्तान्येकविंशतिः ..
आदित्यव्रत संज्ञानि तस्य पुण्यफलं शृणु ..11..
5.154.m:
subsequently, before them, all twenty-one
rites known as the vow of the Ādityas—hear the meritorious fruit of that.

5.154.s:
koṭidvādaśakaṃ yastu sūryāṇāṃ pūjayennaraḥ ..
tatphalaṃ prāpnuyātkṛtsnaṃ pūjayannātra saṃśayaḥ .. 12 ..
5.154.d:
कोटिद्वादशकं यस्तु सूर्याणां पूजयेन्नरः ..
तत्फलं प्राप्नुयात्कृत्स्नं पूजयन्नात्र संशयः .. 12 ..
5.154.m:
A person who would worship twelve crores of suns,
he attains that entire fruit by worshipping [them]; there is no doubt about this.

5.154.s:
tathaikādaśarudrā ye tatra kṣetre dvijottamāḥ ..
ekasthāne sthitāsteṣāṃ pūjayā śrūyatāṃ phalam .. 13 ..
5.154.d:
तथैकादशरुद्रा ये तत्र क्षेत्रे द्विजोत्तमाः ..
एकस्थाने स्थितास्तेषां पूजया श्रूयतां फलम् .. 13 ..
5.154.m:
Likewise, regarding the eleven Rudras, O best of brahmins, who in that sacred field
are situated in one place: hear the fruit of their worship.

5.154.s:
yastānpūjayate bhaktyā sthāpayitvā sureśvarān..
caitraśuklacaturdaśyāṃ japecca śatarudriyam .. 14 ..
5.154.d:
यस्तान्पूजयते भक्त्या स्थापयित्वा सुरेश्वरान्..
चैत्रशुक्लचतुर्दश्यां जपेच्च शतरुद्रियम् .. 14 ..
5.154.m:
Whoever worships those lords of the gods with devotion after establishing them
on the fourteenth day of the bright fortnight of Caitra, and chants the Śatarudriya,

5.154.s:
ekādaśapramāṇena koṭayastena pūjitāḥ ..
bhavaṃti nātra saṃdehaḥ satyametanmayoditam .. 15 ..
5.154.d:
एकादशप्रमाणेन कोटयस्तेन पूजिताः ..
भवंति नात्र संदेहः सत्यमेतन्मयोदितम् .. 15 ..
5.154.m:
by him eleven crores [of deities] are worshipped in measurement;
there is no doubt about this, this truth has been spoken by me.

5.154.s:
yathā tāvaśvinau tatra devavaidyau vyavasthitau ..
āśvine māsi cāśvinyāṃ pūrṇimāyāṃ tathā tithau .. 16 ..
5.154.d:
यथा तावश्विनौ तत्र देववैद्यौ व्यवस्थितौ ..
आश्विने मासि चाश्विन्यां पूर्णिमायां तथा तिथौ .. 16 ..
5.154.m:
Likewise, the two Aśvins, the physicians of the gods, who are stationed there:
in the month of Āśvina, on the full moon day during the nakṣatra Aśvinī,

5.154.s:
yastau saṃpūjayitvā tu hyaśvinīsūktamuccaret .
dvikoṭi guṇitaṃ puṇyaṃ samyaktena samāpyate . 17 .
5.154.d:
यस्तौ संपूजयित्वा तु ह्यश्विनीसूक्तमुच्चरेत् .
द्विकोटि गुणितं पुण्यं सम्यक्तेन समाप्यते . 17 .
5.154.m:
whoever, having worshipped them, recites the hymn to the Aśvins,
by him merit multiplied two-crore-fold is fully attained.

5.154.s:
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ māhātmyaṃ vasusaṃbhavam ..
ādityānāṃ ca rudrāṇāmaśvinordvijasattamāḥ .. 198 .. ..
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tathā'nyo'pi ca tatrāsti yājñavalkyapratiṣṭhitaḥ ..
puṣpāditya iti khyātaḥ sarvakāmaprado nṛṇām .. 19 ..
yo yaṃ kāmamabhidhyāya taṃ pūjayati mānavaḥ ..
sa taṃ kṛtsnamavāpnoti yadyapi syātsudurlabham..6.155.20...
aputro labhate putrāndhanārthī dhanamāpnuyāt ..
bahuvairo'rināśaṃ ca vidyārthī śāstravidbhavet.. 21 ..
saptamyāmarkavāreṇa yastaṃ paśyati mānavaḥ ..
mucyeddinodbhavātpāpānmahato'pidvijottamāḥ .. 22 ..
pūjayā hi praṇaśyeta pāpaṃ varṣasamudbhavam..
nāśaṃ yāti na saṃdehastamaḥ sūryodaye yathā .. 23 ..
aṣṭottaraśataṃ caiva yaḥ karoti pradakṣiṇām ..
phalahastaḥ sa mucyeta hyājanmamaraṇādaghāt .. 24 ..
5.154.d:
एतद्वः सर्वमाख्यातं माहात्म्यं वसुसंभवम् ..
आदित्यानां च रुद्राणामश्विनोर्द्विजसत्तमाः .. 198 .. ..
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तथाऽन्योऽपि च तत्रास्ति याज्ञवल्क्यप्रतिष्ठितः ..
पुष्पादित्य इति ख्यातः सर्वकामप्रदो नृणाम् .. 19 ..
यो यं काममभिध्याय तं पूजयति मानवः ..
स तं कृत्स्नमवाप्नोति यद्यपि स्यात्सुदुर्लभम्..6.155.20...
अपुत्रो लभते पुत्रान्धनार्थी धनमाप्नुयात् ..
बहुवैरोऽरिनाशं च विद्यार्थी शास्त्रविद्भवेत्.. 21 ..
सप्तम्यामर्कवारेण यस्तं पश्यति मानवः ..
मुच्येद्दिनोद्भवात्पापान्महतोऽपिद्विजोत्तमाः .. 22 ..
पूजया हि प्रणश्येत पापं वर्षसमुद्भवम्..
नाशं याति न संदेहस्तमः सूर्योदये यथा .. 23 ..
अष्टोत्तरशतं चैव यः करोति प्रदक्षिणाम् ..
फलहस्तः स मुच्येत ह्याजन्ममरणादघात् .. 24 ..
5.154.m:
This entire māhātmya relating to the Vasus,
the Ādityas, the Rudras, and the Aśvins has been told to you, O best of brahmins.
Sūta said:
Likewise, there is another there, established by Yājñavalkya,
renowned as Puṣpāditya, who grants all desires to mortals.
Whatever desire a human being contemplates and worships him for,
he attains that in full, even if it should be exceedingly difficult to attain.
The childless obtains sons; the one who seeks wealth would obtain wealth;
one with many enemies [attains] destruction of enemies; one who seeks learning becomes a knower of scripture.
A person who beholds him on a Sunday on the seventh lunar day
is freed from the sin born of the day, even a great one, O best of brahmins.
Through worship, sin born of a year is destroyed;
it goes to destruction, there is no doubt, just as darkness does at sunrise.
And whoever performs one hundred and eight circumambulations
with fruit in hand is freed from sins committed from birth until death.

5.154.s:
pradakṣiṇāṃ prakuvāṇo yo yaṃ kāmamabhīpsati ..
sa tamāpnotyasaṃdigdhaṃ niṣkāmo mokṣamāpnuyāt .. 25 ..
saṃkrāṃtau sūryavāreṇa yaḥ kuryātsnāpanakriyām..
abhīṣṭaṃ sidhyate tasya meṣe vā yadi vā tule .. 26 ..
tasminsarvaprayatnena vāṃchadbhirīpsitaṃ phalam ..
sa devo vīkṣaṇīyaśca pūjanīyo viśeṣataḥ .. 27 ..
yaddevaiḥ sakalairdṛṣṭaiścamatkārapurodbhavaiḥ ..

5.154.m:
Whatever desire one performing circumambulation yearns for,
he undoubtedly attains that; one without desire would attain liberation.
Whoever performs the ceremonial bath on a solar transition on a Sunday,
either in Aries or in Libra, his desired goal is achieved.
Therefore, with every effort, by those desiring their cherished fruit,
that deity is to be viewed and especially worshipped.
Whatever fruit one attains through all the deities born in Camatkārapura being seen,
by seeing him one attains that fruit.
The sages said:
If that deity was indeed established by Yājñavalkya,
why is he called Puṣpāditya? You ought to tell us this.
Sūta said:
Here I shall relate to you an ancient narrative
of how Puṣpāditya, established by Yājñavalkya, came to be.
There is upon the surface of the earth here a great, excellent city called Vaidiśa,
crowded with various mansions, adorned with excellent ramparts,

5.154.s:
udyānaśatasaṃkīrṇaṃ taḍāgairupaśobhitam ..
tatrāsītpārthivaśreṣṭhaścitravarmeti viśrutaḥ .. 32 ..
na durbhikṣaṃ na ca vyādhirna ca caurakṛtaṃ bhayam ..
tasmiñchāsati dharmajñe satataṃ dharmavatsale .. 33 ..
tatpure kṣatriyo jātyā maṇibhadra iti smṛtaḥ ..
sa vai dhanena saṃyuktaḥ pitṛpaitāmahena ca .. 34 ..

kusīdāhṛtavittena vartate kārya utthite .. 35 ..

उद्यानशतसंकीर्णं तडागैरुपशोभितम् ..
तत्रासीत्पार्थिवश्रेष्ठश्चित्रवर्मेति विश्रुतः .. 32 ..
न दुर्भिक्षं न च व्याधिर्न च चौरकृतं भयम् ..
तस्मिञ्छासति धर्मज्ञे सततं धर्मवत्सले .. 33 ..
तत्पुरे क्षत्रियो जात्या मणिभद्र इति स्मृतः ..
स वै धनेन संयुक्तः पितृपैतामहेन च .. 34 ..
तत्पुरं सकलं चैव स राजा मंत्रिभिः सह ..
कुसीदाहृतवित्तेन वर्तते कार्य उत्थिते .. 35 ..
स च कायेन कुब्जः स्याज्जराव्याप्तस्तथैव च ..
वलीपलितगात्रश्च ह्यत्यंतं च विरूपधृक् ..36..
तथा चैव कुकीनाशः प्रभूतेऽपि धने सति ..
न ददाति स पापात्मा कस्यचित्किञ्चिदेव हि ..
न भक्षयति तृष्णार्तः स्वयमेव कथंचन .. 37 ..
एवंविधोऽपि सोऽतीवविरूपोऽपि सुदुर्मतिः ..
प्रार्थयामास वै कन्यां स्वजात्यां वीक्ष्य सुंदरीम्.. 38 ..
5.154.m:
thronged with hundreds of gardens, beautified with ponds.
There lived an excellent king renowned as Citravarman.
There was no famine, no disease, and no fear caused by thieves
while that knower of dharma, ever devoted to righteousness, ruled.
In that city was a kṣatriya by birth known as Maṇibhadra;
he was endowed with wealth inherited from his father and grandfathers.
The entire city, as well as the king together with his ministers, / depended on wealth acquired through usury whenever a need arose.
He was hunchbacked in body and overcome by old age, / his limbs covered with wrinkles and grey hair, and of an exceedingly ugly appearance.
And likewise, though possessing abundant wealth, he was a vile miser; / that evil-minded man gave nothing at all to anyone, / nor, tormented by craving, did he ever consume anything himself.
Even being such, exceedingly deformed and utterly wicked, / seeing a beautiful maiden of his own caste, he asked for her hand.

5.154.s:
biṃboṣṭhīṃ cārudehāṃ ca muṣṭigrāhyakṛśodarīm..

raktāṃ saptasu gātreṣu trigaṃbhīrāṃ tathā punaḥ ..
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpūrṇāṃ jātīyāṃ sumanoramām .. 6.155.40 ..
kṣatriyāddvijaśārdūlā daridreṇa ca pīḍitāt ..
tena tatsakalaṃ vṛttaṃ bhāryāyai saṃniveditam .. 41 ..
tacchrutvā sā ca duḥkhena mūrcchitā saṃbabhūva ha ..
saṃbodhitā tatastena vākyairdṛṣṭāṃtasaṃbhavaiḥ .. 42 ..
.. kṣatriya uvāca .. ..
na sā vidyā na tacchilpaṃ na tatkāryaṃ na sā kalā ..
arthārthibhirna tajjñānaṃ dhanināṃ yanna dīyate .. 43 ..
iha loke ca dhanināṃ paro'pi svajanāyate ..
svajano'pi daridrāṇāṃ kāryārthe durjanāyate .. 44 ..
arthebhyo hi vivṛddhebhyaḥ saṃbhṛtebhyastatastataḥ ..
pravartaṃte kriyāḥ sarvāḥ parvatebhyo yathāpagāḥ .. 45 ..
5.154.d:
बिंबोष्ठीं चारुदेहां च मुष्टिग्राह्यकृशोदरीम्..
पद्मपत्रविशालाक्षीं गूढगुल्फां सुकेशिकाम् .. 39 ..
रक्तां सप्तसु गात्रेषु त्रिगंभीरां तथा पुनः ..
सर्वलक्षणसंपूर्णां जातीयां सुमनोरमाम् .. 6.155.40 ..
क्षत्रियाद्द्विजशार्दूला दरिद्रेण च पीडितात् ..
तेन तत्सकलं वृत्तं भार्यायै संनिवेदितम् .. 41 ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा सा च दुःखेन मूर्च्छिता संबभूव ह ..
संबोधिता ततस्तेन वाक्यैर्दृष्टांतसंभवैः .. 42 ..
.. क्षत्रिय उवाच .. ..
न सा विद्या न तच्छिल्पं न तत्कार्यं न सा कला ..
अर्थार्थिभिर्न तज्ज्ञानं धनिनां यन्न दीयते .. 43 ..
इह लोके च धनिनां परोऽपि स्वजनायते ..
स्वजनोऽपि दरिद्राणां कार्यार्थे दुर्जनायते .. 44 ..
अर्थेभ्यो हि विवृद्धेभ्यः संभृतेभ्यस्ततस्ततः ..
प्रवर्तंते क्रियाः सर्वाः पर्वतेभ्यो यथापगाः .. 45 ..
5.154.m:
She had lips like the bimba fruit, a charming body, and a slender waist that could be grasped in a fist; / she had large eyes like lotus petals, hidden ankles, and beautiful hair;
she was red in seven parts of her body and deep in three, / endowed with all auspicious marks, born of good lineage, and exceedingly delightful,
[born] from an impoverished and afflicted kṣatriya, O best among the twice-born! / He reported that entire matter to his wife.
Hearing that, she swooned away in sorrow. / Then he comforted her with words containing examples:
The kṣatriya said: / 'There is no learning, no craft, no work, and no art, / there is no knowledge that is not offered by seekers of wealth to rich men.
In this world, even a stranger acts like kin to the wealthy, / while to the poor, even one's own kin acts like a villain when a need arises.
For from wealth increased and accumulated from here and there, / all undertakings proceed, just as rivers flow from mountains.

5.154.s:
pūjyate yadapūjyo'pi yadagamyo'pi gamyate ..
vaṃdyate yadavandyo'pi hyanubaṃdho dhanasya saḥ .. 46 ..
aśanādiṃdriyā ṇīva syuḥ kāryāṇyakhilāniha ..
sarvasmātkāraṇādvittaṃ sarvasādhanamucyate .. 47 ..
arthārthī jīvaloko'yaṃ śmaśānamapi sevate ..
janitāramapi tyaktvā niḥsvaḥ saṃyāti dūrataḥ .. 48 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye puṣpādi tyamāhālaye maṇibhadravṛttāṃte maṇibhadrāya kanyāpradānārthaṃ kṣatriyakṛtanijabhāryāsaṃbodhanavarṇanaṃnāma pañcapañcāśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..155.. ..
5.154.d:
पूज्यते यदपूज्योऽपि यदगम्योऽपि गम्यते ..
वंद्यते यदवन्द्योऽपि ह्यनुबंधो धनस्य सः .. 46 ..
अशनादिंद्रिया णीव स्युः कार्याण्यखिलानिह ..
सर्वस्मात्कारणाद्वित्तं सर्वसाधनमुच्यते .. 47 ..
अर्थार्थी जीवलोकोऽयं श्मशानमपि सेवते ..
जनितारमपि त्यक्त्वा निःस्वः संयाति दूरतः .. 48 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये पुष्पादि त्यमाहालये मणिभद्रवृत्तांते मणिभद्राय कन्याप्रदानार्थं क्षत्रियकृतनिजभार्यासंबोधनवर्णनंनाम पञ्चपञ्चाशदुत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ..155.. ..
5.154.m:
That even the unworthy of worship is worshipped, that even the unapproachable is approached, / that even the unpraiseworthy is praised—that is the consequence of wealth.
All activities in this world are like the sense organs, such as eating. / For all reasons, wealth is declared to be the means of accomplishing everything.
Desirous of wealth, this mortal world frequents even a cremation ground; / one without wealth goes far away, having abandoned even his father.'
Thus ends the one hundred and fifty-fifth chapter, named 'Description of the Kṣatriya's Consoling of His Wife for Giving the Maiden to Maṇibhadra in the Account of Maṇibhadra at the Puṣpāditya Temple' in the Māhātmya of Hāṭakeśvara Kṣetra, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] of the eighty-one-thousand-verse collection of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa.

5.155.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evaṃ sambodhitā tena sā bhāryā vijane gatā ..
kanyāpradānasya ruciḥ saṃjātā tadanantaram .. 1 ..

कन्याप्रदानस्य रुचिः संजाता तदनन्तरम् .. 1 ..
5.155.m: Sūta said: / Thus consoled by him, that wife went to a solitary place. / Thereafter, an inclination arose [in her] to give the daughter in marriage.

5.155.s:
tataḥ sa pādau prakṣālya maṇibhadrasya satvaram..
udakaṃ sākṣataṃ haste kanyādānakṛte dadau .. 2 ..

ततः स पादौ प्रक्षाल्य मणिभद्रस्य सत्वरम्..
उदकं साक्षतं हस्ते कन्यादानकृते ददौ .. 2 ..
5.155.m: Then, having quickly washed the feet of Maṇibhadra, / he gave water with unbroken grains of rice into [his] hand for the gifting of the maiden.

5.155.s:
so'pi hastakṛte toye taṃ kṣatriyamuvāca ha ..
adyaiva kuru me śīghraṃ vivāhaṃ kanyayā saha .. 3 ..
5.155.d:
सोऽपि हस्तकृते तोये तं क्षत्रियमुवाच ह ..
अद्यैव कुरु मे शीघ्रं विवाहं कन्यया सह .. 3 ..
5.155.m: When the water was placed in his hand, he said to that kṣatriya: / 'Perform my marriage with the maiden quickly, this very day.

5.155.s:
yasmādicchāmi saṃsthātuṃ tena te gṛhamāgataḥ ..
.. kṣatriya uvāca .. ..
nātra nakṣatramarhaṃ tu na kiṃcidbhagadaivatam .. .. 4 ..

यस्मादिच्छामि संस्थातुं तेन ते गृहमागतः ..
.. क्षत्रिय उवाच .. ..
नात्र नक्षत्रमर्हं तु न किंचिद्भगदैवतम् .. .. 4 ..
5.155.m: Because I desire to dwell [with her], for that reason I have come to your house.' / The kṣatriya said: / 'Neither is the lunar mansion suitable here, nor is the presiding deity of fortune favorable;

5.155.s:
vivāhasya na vārastu prasupte madhusūdane ..
asminkāle tu saṃprāpte yā kanyā pariṇīyate ..5..

अस्मिन्काले तु संप्राप्ते या कन्या परिणीयते ..5..
5.155.m: nor is the day auspicious for marriage while Madhusūdana is asleep. / When this period has arrived, the maiden who is married

5.155.s:
sā ca saṃvatsarānmadhye dhruvaṃ vaidhavyamāpnuyāt..
evaṃ daivajñamukhyānāṃ śrutaṃ pravadatāṃ mayā .. 6 ..

सा च संवत्सरान्मध्ये ध्रुवं वैधव्यमाप्नुयात्..
एवं दैवज्ञमुख्यानां श्रुतं प्रवदतां मया .. 6 ..

tasmācchubhe tu saṃprāpte nakṣatre bhagadaivate ..

yena kṣemaṃkarī te syāttathā putraprapautriṇī .. 7 ..

तस्माच्छुभे तु संप्राप्ते नक्षत्रे भगदैवते ..
त्वं विवाहय मे कन्यां प्रोत्थिते मधुसूदने ..
येन क्षेमंकरी ते स्यात्तथा पुत्रप्रपौत्रिणी .. 7 ..
5.155.m: Therefore, when an auspicious lunar mansion presided over by the deity of fortune has arrived, / marry my maiden [to you] when Madhusūdana has awakened, / so that she may bring welfare to you and be blessed with sons and great-grandsons.'

5.155.s:
.. maṇibhadra uvāca .. ..
nakṣatraṃ vahnidaivatyaṃ prasupto madhusūdanaḥ .. 8 ..

नक्षत्रं वह्निदैवत्यं प्रसुप्तो मधुसूदनः .. 8 ..
5.155.m: Maṇibhadra said: / 'The lunar mansion has Agni as its deity, and Madhusūdana is asleep;

5.155.s:
sāṃprataṃ vatsarāṃto'yaṃ vivāhe vihite sati ..
kāmāgnirutthitaḥ kāye sāṃprataṃ māṃ prabādhate .. 9 ..

कामाग्निरुत्थितः काये सांप्रतं मां प्रबाधते .. 9 ..

tasmātkuru prasādaṃ me kanyāvivahitena tu ..

तव वित्तं प्रदास्यामि सुखी येन भविष्यसि .. 6.156.10 ..
5.155.m: Therefore, show me favor by having the maiden married [to me]; / I shall give you wealth by which you will become happy.'

5.155.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tasmācca vittalobhena kṣatriyo dvijasattamāḥ ..
vivāhaṃ kārayāmāsa tatkṣaṇādeva sa dvijāḥ .. 11 ..

.. सूत उवाच .. ..

विवाहं कारयामास तत्क्षणादेव स द्विजाः .. 11 ..
5.155.m: Sūta said: / Therefore, out of greed for wealth, O best of the twice-born, / that kṣatriya caused the marriage to be performed that very moment, O twice-born!

5.155.s:
dadau kanyāṃ suduḥkhārtāmaśrupūrṇekṣaṇāṃ sthitām ..
sannidhau vahniviprāṇāṃ tadā tena vivāhitā .. 12 ..

5.155.m: He gave away the daughter, who was deeply afflicted by sorrow, standing with eyes full of tears; / in the presence of the fire and the brahmins, she was married by him then.

anicchaṃtīmapi satīṃ tāmatīva nirargalaḥ .. 13 ..

अनिच्छंतीमपि सतीं तामतीव निरर्गलः .. 13 ..
5.155.m: Having taken her to his own home afterward, he employed her in the duties of desire; / completely unrestrained, [he forced] her though she was unwilling and virtuous.

5.155.s:
so'pi niṣkāmatāṃ prāpya nirbhartsya ca muhurmuhuḥ ..
bhāṣikābhiranekābhistāpayitvā ca bhāminīm.. 14 ..
5.155.d:
सोऽपि निष्कामतां प्राप्य निर्भर्त्स्य च मुहुर्मुहुः ..
भाषिकाभिरनेकाभिस्तापयित्वा च भामिनीम्.. 14 ..
5.155.m: Having satisfied his lust and repeatedly reproaching [her], / and distressing the passionate woman with many abusive words,

5.155.s:
śāṃtiṃ nītā tatastena pratyūṣe samupasthite ..
bhṛtyavargaḥ samasto'pi tato niḥsārito gṛhāt .. 15 ..
5.155.d:
शांतिं नीता ततस्तेन प्रत्यूषे समुपस्थिते ..
भृत्यवर्गः समस्तोऽपि ततो निःसारितो गृहात् .. 15 ..
5.155.m: she was then reduced to calmness by him when dawn arrived. / Then the entire crowd of servants was driven out of the house.

5.155.s:
irṣyādharmaṃ samāsthāya paramaṃ dvijasattamāḥ ..
eka eva kṛtastena dvārapālo napuṃsakaḥ .. 16 ..
5.155.d:
इर्ष्याधर्मं समास्थाय परमं द्विजसत्तमाः ..
एक एव कृतस्तेन द्वारपालो नपुंसकः .. 16 ..
5.155.m: Having adopted supreme jealousy as his rule, O best of the twice-born, / he appointed a single eunuch as door-keeper.

5.155.s:
proktaṃ na ca tvayā deyaḥ praveśo'tra gṛhe mama ..
bhṛtyasya bhikṣukasyaiva vṛddhasya vratinastathā ..17..
5.155.d:
प्रोक्तं न च त्वया देयः प्रवेशोऽत्र गृहे मम ..
भृत्यस्य भिक्षुकस्यैव वृद्धस्य व्रतिनस्तथा ..17..
5.155.m: [The door-keeper] was told: 'Entrance into my house must not be given by you / to a servant, a beggar, an old man, or an ascetic.'

5.155.s:
evaṃ kṛtvā vidhānaṃ tu tataścakre janaiḥ samam ..
vyavahārakriyāḥ sarvā dravyalakṣaiḥ sahasraśaḥ.. 18 ..
5.155.d:
एवं कृत्वा विधानं तु ततश्चक्रे जनैः समम् ..
व्यवहारक्रियाः सर्वा द्रव्यलक्षैः सहस्रशः.. 18 ..
5.155.m: Having made such an arrangement, he then conducted with people / all business transactions involving hundreds of thousands and thousands of riches.

5.155.s:
śvaśurasyāpi no dattaṃ kiṃcittena durātmanā ..
bhāryāyāḥ śvetavastrāṇi muktvā'nyannaiva kiṃcana .. 19 ..
5.155.d:
श्वशुरस्यापि नो दत्तं किंचित्तेन दुरात्मना ..
भार्यायाः श्वेतवस्त्राणि मुक्त्वाऽन्यन्नैव किंचन .. 19 ..
5.155.m: Nothing was given by that evil-minded man even to his father-in-law, / nor anything at all to his wife except white garments.

5.155.s:
yāmadvaye'pi saṃprāpte dinasya gṛhamāgataḥ ..
mitamannaṃ tata stasyā bhojanārthaṃ prayacchati .. 6.156.20 ..
5.155.d:
यामद्वयेऽपि संप्राप्ते दिनस्य गृहमागतः ..
मितमन्नं तत स्तस्या भोजनार्थं प्रयच्छति .. 6.156.20 ..
5.155.m: When two watches of the day had passed, he came home; / then he gives her a measured portion of food for eating.

5.155.s:
yāvanmātraṃ ca sā bhuṃkta ekaviprānvitaḥ svayam ..
bhuktvā caiva tato yāti vyavahārakṛte bahiḥ .. 21 .. 8.
5.155.d:
यावन्मात्रं च सा भुंक्त एकविप्रान्वितः स्वयम् ..
भुक्त्वा चैव ततो याति व्यवहारकृते बहिः .. 21 .. 8.
5.155.m: And while she eats, he himself, accompanied by a single brahmin, / eats and then goes outside for business.

5.155.s:
āgacchati punarharmyaṃ saṃdhyākāla upasthite ..
sā'pi tiṣṭhati harmyasthā patnī tasya durātmanaḥ .. 22 ..
5.155.d:
आगच्छति पुनर्हर्म्यं संध्याकाल उपस्थिते ..
साऽपि तिष्ठति हर्म्यस्था पत्नी तस्य दुरात्मनः .. 22 ..
5.155.m: He returns to the mansion again when twilight has arrived; / she too, the wife of that evil-minded man, stays in the mansion,

5.155.s:
vairāgyaṃ paramaṃ prāptā duḥkhaśokasamanvitā .. .
matsīva patitā toyādanyasmiṃstu sthalāṃtike .. 23 ..
5.155.d:
वैराग्यं परमं प्राप्ता दुःखशोकसमन्विता .. .
मत्सीव पतिता तोयादन्यस्मिंस्तु स्थलांतिके .. 23 ..
5.155.m: having reached extreme detachment, filled with misery and sorrow, / like a fish fallen from the water onto dry land,

5.155.s:
cakravākī vimukteva saṃprāpte divasakṣaye ..
haṃsī haṃsaviyukteva mṛgīva mṛgavarjitā .. 24 .. .
5.155.d:
चक्रवाकी विमुक्तेव संप्राप्ते दिवसक्षये ..
हंसी हंसवियुक्तेव मृगीव मृगवर्जिता .. 24 .. .
5.155.m: like a female cakravāka separated when the end of the day arrives, / like a female swan separated from her swan, like a doe separated from a deer.

5.155.s:
so'pi nityaṃ dadau bhojyaṃ viprasyaikasya ca dvijāḥ ..
procya taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ pūrvaṃ sāmapūrvamidaṃ vacaḥ .. 25 ..
5.155.d:
सोऽपि नित्यं ददौ भोज्यं विप्रस्यैकस्य च द्विजाः ..
प्रोच्य तं ब्राह्मणं पूर्वं सामपूर्वमिदं वचः .. 25 ..
5.155.m: He also gave food daily to a single brahmin, O twice-born, / having previously addressed that brahmin gently with these words:

5.155.s:
adhovaktreṇa bhoktavyaṃ sadā vipra gṛhe mama .. .
yadi paśyasi me bhāryāṃ saṃprāpsyasi viḍaṃbanām ..26..
5.155.d:
अधोवक्त्रेण भोक्तव्यं सदा विप्र गृहे मम .. .
यदि पश्यसि मे भार्यां संप्राप्स्यसि विडंबनाम् ..26..
5.155.m: 'You must always eat with your face downcast in my house, O brahmin; / if you look at my wife, you will suffer humiliation.'

5.155.s:
evaṃ viḍaṃbitāstena hyūrdhvavaktrāvalokinaḥ ..
ye cānye bhayasaṃtrastā na yāṃti ca tadālayam .. . .. 27 ..
5.155.d:
एवं विडंबितास्तेन ह्यूर्ध्ववक्त्रावलोकिनः ..
ये चान्ये भयसंत्रस्ता न यांति च तदालयम् .. . .. 27 ..
5.155.m: In this way, those who looked up with face raised were humiliated by him; / and others, terrified with fear, would not go to his house.

5.155.s:
kasyacittvatha kālasya puṣponāma dvijottamaḥ ..
tīrthayātrāprasaṃgena saṃprāptastatpuraṃ prati ..28..
5.155.d:
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य पुष्पोनाम द्विजोत्तमः ..
तीर्थयात्राप्रसंगेन संप्राप्तस्तत्पुरं प्रति ..28..
5.155.m: Then, after some time, an excellent brahmin named Puṣpa, / while undertaking a pilgrimage to sacred fords, reached that city.

5.155.s:
pūrve vayasi saṃsthaśca darśanīyatamākṛtiḥ .. ..
kṣutkṣāmaḥ supariśrāṃto madhyāhne samupasthite .. 29 ..
paribhramati vai nṛṇāṃ sa gṛhāṇi samaṃtataḥ ..
maṇibhadraḥ samādiṣṭastasya kenāpi bhojyadaḥ ..6.156.3... ..
5.155.d:
पूर्वे वयसि संस्थश्च दर्शनीयतमाकृतिः .. ..
क्षुत्क्षामः सुपरिश्रांतो मध्याह्ने समुपस्थिते .. 29 ..
परिभ्रमति वै नृणां स गृहाणि समंततः ..
मणिभद्रः समादिष्टस्तस्य केनापि भोज्यदः ..6.156.3... ..
5.155.m:
He was in the prime of youth and endowed with a most handsome appearance; / emaciated by hunger and exceedingly exhausted when midday arrived,
he wandered all around among the houses of men. / Then someone pointed out Maṇibhadra to him as a giver of food.

5.155.s:
tatastaṃ prārthayāmāsa gatvā bhojyaṃ ca sa dvijāḥ ..
tenāpi sa dvijaḥ proktastadāsau dvijasattamāḥ .. 31 ..
5.155.d:
ततस्तं प्रार्थयामास गत्वा भोज्यं च स द्विजाः ..
तेनापि स द्विजः प्रोक्तस्तदासौ द्विजसत्तमाः .. 31 ..
5.155.m: Then, O brahmins, he went and requested food from him. / And he too, O best of brahmins, then spoke to that brahmin:

5.155.s:
adhovaktreṇa bhoktavyaṃ tvayā vīkṣyā na me priyā ..
no cedviḍaṃbanāṃ vipra saṃprāpsyasi na saṃśayaḥ .. 32 ..
5.155.d:
अधोवक्त्रेण भोक्तव्यं त्वया वीक्ष्या न मे प्रिया ..
नो चेद्विडंबनां विप्र संप्राप्स्यसि न संशयः .. 32 ..
5.155.m: "You must eat with your face turned downward; my beloved must not be looked upon by you. / Otherwise, O brahmin, you will suffer humiliation, there is no doubt.

5.155.s: evaṃ jñātvā mahābhāga yatkṣemaṃ tatsamācara .. 33 ..
5.155.d: एवं ज्ञात्वा महाभाग यत्क्षेमं तत्समाचर .. 33 ..
5.155.m: Knowing this, O fortunate one, do that which is safe."

5.155.s:
.. puṣpa uvāca .. ..
kṣutkṣāmasya na me kāryaṃ paradāravilokanaiḥ ..
vedādhyayanayuktasya tīrthayātrāratasya ca .. 34 ..
5.155.d:
.. पुष्प उवाच .. ..
क्षुत्क्षामस्य न मे कार्यं परदारविलोकनैः ..
वेदाध्ययनयुक्तस्य तीर्थयात्रारतस्य च .. 34 ..
5.155.m: Puṣpa said: / "Emaciated with hunger, I have no concern with looking at another man’s wife, / engaged [as I am] in the study of the Veda and devoted to pilgrimage to sacred fords."

5.155.s:
.. maṇibhadra uvāca .. ..
tadāgaccha mayā sārdhaṃ sāṃprataṃ mama maṃdiram ..
viśeṣāttava dāsyāmi bhojanaṃ dakṣiṇānvitam .. 35 ..
5.155.d:
.. मणिभद्र उवाच .. ..
तदागच्छ मया सार्धं सांप्रतं मम मंदिरम् ..
विशेषात्तव दास्यामि भोजनं दक्षिणान्वितम् .. 35 ..
5.155.m: Maṇibhadra said: / "Then come with me right now to my house. / Especially for you, I shall give a meal accompanied by a fee."

5.155.s:
evaṃ tau saṃvidaṃ kṛtvā yayaturbrāhmaṇottamāḥ ..
haṭṭamārge gatau tatra yatra ṣaṃḍho vyava sthitaḥ .. 36 ..
5.155.d:
एवं तौ संविदं कृत्वा ययतुर्ब्राह्मणोत्तमाः ..
हट्टमार्गे गतौ तत्र यत्र षंढो व्यव स्थितः .. 36 ..
5.155.m: Having thus made an agreement, O best of brahmins, the two went along; / they went along the marketplace path to where the eunuch was stationed.

5.155.s:
tatpārśve brāhmaṇaṃ dhṛtvā praviṣṭo gṛhamadhyataḥ ..
bhāryayā śrapayāmāsa dhānyaṃ mānamitaṃ tadā .. 37 ..
5.155.d:
तत्पार्श्वे ब्राह्मणं धृत्वा प्रविष्टो गृहमध्यतः ..
भार्यया श्रपयामास धान्यं मानमितं तदा .. 37 ..
5.155.m: Keeping the brahmin beside him, he entered the inside of the house; / then he had a measured quantity of grain cooked by his wife.

5.155.s:
tato devārcanaṃ kṛtvā vaiśvadevāṃta āgatam ..
puṣpamāhūya tatpādau prakṣālya ca niveśya ca .. 38 ..
5.155.d:
ततो देवार्चनं कृत्वा वैश्वदेवांत आगतम् ..
पुष्पमाहूय तत्पादौ प्रक्षाल्य च निवेश्य च .. 38 ..
5.155.m: Then, having performed the worship of the gods, when the Vaiśvadeva [offering] had ended, / he called Puṣpa, washed his feet, seated him,

5.155.s:
kṛtvārcanavidhiṃ tasya dattvānnaṃ ca susaṃskṛtam ..
upaviśya tataḥ paścādbhojanārthaṃ tato dvijāḥ.
puṣpo'pi vīkṣate tasyāḥ pādau paṃkajasaṃnibhau..39..
5.155.d:
कृत्वार्चनविधिं तस्य दत्त्वान्नं च सुसंस्कृतम् ..
उपविश्य ततः पश्चाद्भोजनार्थं ततो द्विजाः.
पुष्पोऽपि वीक्षते तस्याः पादौ पंकजसंनिभौ..39..
5.155.m: performed the rites of hospitality for him, and gave him well-prepared food. / Afterwards, O brahmins, as he sat down to eat, / Puṣpa also gazed upon her lotus-like feet.

5.155.s:
yathāyathā sa kautukyādvīkṣate yauvanāśritaḥ..
kautukyāttena ca tatastasyā vaktraṃ nirīkṣitam ..6.156.40..
5.155.d:
यथायथा स कौतुक्याद्वीक्षते यौवनाश्रितः..
कौतुक्यात्तेन च ततस्तस्या वक्त्रं निरीक्षितम् ..6.156.40..
5.155.m: As he looked out of curiosity, overcome by youthfulness, / out of curiosity he then looked at her face.

5.155.s:
tataścākārayāmāsa maṇibhadraḥ prakopataḥ..
taṃ ṣaṇḍhamuktavāñjāraṃ tvamenaṃ ca viḍaṃbaya..41..
5.155.d:
ततश्चाकारयामास मणिभद्रः प्रकोपतः..
तं षण्ढमुक्तवाञ्जारं त्वमेनं च विडंबय..41..
5.155.m: Then, in a fury, Maṇibhadra summoned / that eunuch and said: "Humiliate this paramour!"

5.155.s: tatastena dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ sa puṣpo mūrdhni tāḍitaḥ .. 42 ..
5.155.d: ततस्तेन द्विजश्रेष्ठाः स पुष्पो मूर्ध्नि ताडितः .. 42 ..
5.155.m: Then by him, O best of brahmins, that Puṣpa was struck on the head.

5.155.s:
adho nipatitaṃ bhūmau rudhireṇa pariplutam ..
caraṇābhyāṃ samākṛṣya dūto mārgaṃ samāśritaḥ .. 43 ..
5.155.d:
अधो निपतितं भूमौ रुधिरेण परिप्लुतम् ..
चरणाभ्यां समाकृष्य दूतो मार्गं समाश्रितः .. 43 ..
5.155.m: Fallen down onto the earth, drenched with blood, / dragging him by both feet, the servant took to the road.

5.155.s:
yāvaccatuṣpathaṃ nīto yatra saṃcarate janaḥ ..
hāhākāro mahānāsīttasminpuravare tadā .. 44 ..
5.155.d:
यावच्चतुष्पथं नीतो यत्र संचरते जनः ..
हाहाकारो महानासीत्तस्मिन्पुरवरे तदा .. 44 ..
5.155.m: As soon as he was brought to the crossroads where people walked, / a great lamentation arose then in that excellent city

5.155.s:
sarveṣāmeva paurāṇāṃ tadavasthaṃ vilokya tam ..
tato'nyaiḥ śītatoyena sobhiṣikto dayānvitaiḥ .. 45 ..
5.155.d:
सर्वेषामेव पौराणां तदवस्थं विलोक्य तम् ..
ततोऽन्यैः शीततोयेन सोभिषिक्तो दयान्वितैः .. 45 ..
5.155.m: among all the citizens upon seeing him in that condition. / Then he was sprinkled with cold water by others filled with compassion,

5.155.s:
kṛtvā vāyupradānaṃ ca gamitaścetanāṃ prati ..
sa prāpya cetanāṃ kṛcchrāttattoyāttānathābravīt .. 46 ..
5.155.d:
कृत्वा वायुप्रदानं च गमितश्चेतनां प्रति ..
स प्राप्य चेतनां कृच्छ्रात्तत्तोयात्तानथाब्रवीत् .. 46 ..
5.155.m: and, by fanning him, he was brought back to consciousness. / Having regained consciousness with difficulty through that water, he then said to them:

5.155.s:
na mayā vihitaṃ cauryaṃ paradārā na sevitāḥ ..
paśyadhvaṃ maṇibhadreṇa yathāhaṃ kleśito janāḥ .. 47 ..
5.155.d:
न मया विहितं चौर्यं परदारा न सेविताः ..
पश्यध्वं मणिभद्रेण यथाहं क्लेशितो जनाः .. 47 ..
5.155.m: "Theft was not committed by me, nor was another man's wife approached. / Behold, O people, how I have been tormented by Maṇibhadra!

5.155.s:
tīrthayātrāparo vipro brahmacaryaparāyaṇaḥ ..
bhojanārthaṃ samāmantrya nīto'vasthāmimāṃ tataḥ .. 48 ..
5.155.d:
तीर्थयात्रापरो विप्रो ब्रह्मचर्यपरायणः ..
भोजनार्थं समामन्त्र्य नीतोऽवस्थामिमां ततः .. 48 ..
5.155.m: A brahmin devoted to pilgrimage to sacred fords, dedicated to celibacy, / I was invited for food and then brought to this state!

5.155.s:
kiṃ nāsti vātra bhūpālo yenaitadasamaṃjasam ..
brāhmaṇasya viśeṣeṇa nirdoṣasya mahājanāḥ .. 49 ..
5.155.d:
किं नास्ति वात्र भूपालो येनैतदसमंजसम् ..
ब्राह्मणस्य विशेषेण निर्दोषस्य महाजनाः .. 49 ..
5.155.m: Is there no king here, seeing that this injustice [is done] / particularly to a faultless brahmin, O citizens?"

5.155.s:
.. janā ūcuḥ .. ..
bahavastena pāpena viprāḥ pūrvaṃ viḍaṃbitāḥ ..
rājaprasādayuktena cerṣyāṃ prāpya śarīriṇā .. 6.156.50 ..
5.155.d:
.. जना ऊचुः .. ..
बहवस्तेन पापेन विप्राः पूर्वं विडंबिताः ..
राजप्रसादयुक्तेन चेर्ष्यां प्राप्य शरीरिणा .. 6.156.50 ..
5.155.m: The people said: / "Many brahmins have been humiliated before by that sinful mortal / who enjoys the king's favor, having succumbed to jealousy.

5.155.s:
ko'pi rājaprasādānna kiṃcidbrūte'sya sammukham ..
tasmāduttiṣṭha gacchāmo dāsyāmaste'śanaṃ vayam .. 51 ..
5.155.d:
कोऽपि राजप्रसादान्न किंचिद्ब्रूतेऽस्य सम्मुखम् ..
तस्मादुत्तिष्ठ गच्छामो दास्यामस्तेऽशनं वयम् .. 51 ..
5.155.m: Because of the king's favor, nobody says anything to his face. / Therefore, get up, let us go; we will give you food."

5.155.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgara khaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye puṣpādityamāhātmye maṇibhadrakṛtapuṣpabrāhmaṇaviḍaṃbanavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭpañcāśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 156 ..
5.155.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागर खण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये पुष्पादित्यमाहात्म्ये मणिभद्रकृतपुष्पब्राह्मणविडंबनवर्णनंनाम षट्पञ्चाशदुत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 156 ..
5.155.m: Thus ends the one hundred and fifty-sixth chapter, named "Description of the Humiliation of the Brahmin Puṣpa by Maṇibhadra," in the Māhātmya of Puṣpāditya, in the Māhātmya of Hāṭakeśvara Kṣetra, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] of the auspicious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, in the collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].

5.156.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evaṃ saṃbodhitastaistu lokaiḥ puṣpastadā dvijāḥ ..
tānabravīttataḥ kuddho na kariṣyāmi bhojanam .. 1 ..
5.156.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवं संबोधितस्तैस्तु लोकैः पुष्पस्तदा द्विजाः ..
तानब्रवीत्ततः कुद्धो न करिष्यामि भोजनम् .. 1 ..
5.156.m: Sūta said: / Thus addressed by those people then, O brahmins, / Puṣpa, enraged, then said to them: "I will not take food

5.156.s:
yāvanna cāsya pāpasya kariṣyāmi pratikriyām ..
tadvadadhvaṃ mahābhāgā devo vā devatā'thavā .. 2 ..
5.156.d:
यावन्न चास्य पापस्य करिष्यामि प्रतिक्रियाम् ..
तद्वदध्वं महाभागा देवो वा देवताऽथवा .. 2 ..
5.156.m: as long as I do not exact retribution against this sinner. / Therefore tell me, O fortunate ones, is there a god or goddess,

5.156.s:
tathānye siddhamantrā vā sadyaḥ pratyayakārakāḥ ..
ārādhitā yathā sadyo mānuṣāṇāṃ varapradāḥ .. 3 ..
5.156.d:
तथान्ये सिद्धमन्त्रा वा सद्यः प्रत्ययकारकाः ..
आराधिता यथा सद्यो मानुषाणां वरप्रदाः .. 3 ..
5.156.m: or likewise other perfected mantras, which produce immediate proof, / which, when propitiated, immediately bestow boons upon mortals?"

5.156.s:
.. janā ūcuḥ .. ..
eko devaḥ sthitaścātra sadyaḥpratyayakārakaḥ ..
tathaikā devatā cātra śrūyate jagatī tale .. 4 ..
5.156.d:
.. जना ऊचुः .. ..
एको देवः स्थितश्चात्र सद्यःप्रत्ययकारकः ..
तथैका देवता चात्र श्रूयते जगती तले .. 4 ..
5.156.m: The people said: / "One god resides here who produces immediate proof; / likewise one goddess on the surface of the earth is renowned here."

5.156.s:
.. puṣpa uvāca .. ..
ko'sau devaḥ kiyaddūre kasminsthāne vyavasthitaḥ ..
tathā ca devatā brūta dayāṃ kṛtvā mamopari .. 5 .. ..
5.156.d:
.. पुष्प उवाच .. ..
कोऽसौ देवः कियद्दूरे कस्मिन्स्थाने व्यवस्थितः ..
तथा च देवता ब्रूत दयां कृत्वा ममोपरि .. 5 .. ..
5.156.m: Puṣpa said: / "Who is that god? How far away and in what place is he situated? / And tell me of that goddess, taking compassion upon me."

5.156.s:
.. janā ūcuḥ .. ..
camatkārapure sūryo yājñavalkyapratiṣṭhitaḥ ..
asti vipra śruto'smābhiḥ sadyaḥ pratyayakārakaḥ .. 6 ..
5.156.d:
.. जना ऊचुः .. ..
चमत्कारपुरे सूर्यो याज्ञवल्क्यप्रतिष्ठितः ..
अस्ति विप्र श्रुतोऽस्माभिः सद्यः प्रत्ययकारकः .. 6 ..
5.156.m: The people said: / "In Camatkārapura, there is the Sun consecrated by Yājñavalkya. / He has been heard of by us, O brahmin, as one who produces immediate proof.

5.156.s:
sūryavāreṇa saptamyāṃ phalahastaḥ pradakṣiṇām ..
yaḥ karoti narastasya hyaṣṭottaraśataṃ dvija .. 7 ..
5.156.d:
सूर्यवारेण सप्तम्यां फलहस्तः प्रदक्षिणाम् ..
यः करोति नरस्तस्य ह्यष्टोत्तरशतं द्विज .. 7 ..
5.156.m: A man who performs circumambulation of him on a Sunday on the seventh [tithi], / holding fruit in hand, one hundred and eight times, O brahmin,

5.156.s:
tasya siddhipradaḥ samyaṅmanasā vāṃchitaṃ dadet ..
tathānyā śāradā nāma devī kāśmīrasaṃsthitā .. 8 ..
5.156.d:
तस्य सिद्धिप्रदः सम्यङ्मनसा वांछितं ददेत् ..
तथान्या शारदा नाम देवी काश्मीरसंस्थिता .. 8 ..
5.156.m: to him he bestows perfection and grants fully what is desired in the mind. / Likewise, another is the goddess named Śāradā, dwelling in Kashmir;

5.156.s:
upavāsakṛtereva sāpi siddhipradāyinī ..
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ teṣāṃ janānāṃ sa dvijottamāḥ .. 9 ..
5.156.d:
उपवासकृतेरेव सापि सिद्धिप्रदायिनी ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तेषां जनानां स द्विजोत्तमाः .. 9 ..
5.156.m: merely through the observance of fasting, she too is a granter of success." / Having heard that statement of those people, O best of brahmins,

5.156.s:
samuddiśya camatkāraṃ tasmātsthānāttataḥ param ..
camatkārapuraṃ prāpya saptamyāṃ sūryavāsare .. 6.157.10 ..
5.156.d:
समुद्दिश्य चमत्कारं तस्मात्स्थानात्ततः परम् ..
चमत्कारपुरं प्राप्य सप्तम्यां सूर्यवासरे .. 6.157.10 ..
5.156.m: directing his course towards Camatkāra from that place thereafter, / having reached Camatkārapura on a Sunday on the seventh [tithi],

5.156.s:
tatrāgatya tataḥ snātvā śucirbhūtvā samāhitaḥ ..
gataḥ saṃti ṣṭhate yatra yājñavalkyakṛto raviḥ .. 11 ..
5.156.d:
तत्रागत्य ततः स्नात्वा शुचिर्भूत्वा समाहितः ..
गतः संति ष्ठते यत्र याज्ञवल्क्यकृतो रविः .. 11 ..
5.156.m: having arrived there, then having bathed, pure and collected in mind, / he went to where the Sun established by Yājñavalkya stands.

5.156.s:
tataḥ pradakṣiṇāḥ kṛtvā aṣṭottaraśataṃ mitāḥ ..
nālikerāṇi cādāya śraddhayā parayāḥ yutaḥ .. 12 ..
5.156.d:
ततः प्रदक्षिणाः कृत्वा अष्टोत्तरशतं मिताः ..
नालिकेराणि चादाय श्रद्धया परयाः युतः .. 12 ..
5.156.m: Then, having performed circumambulations measuring one hundred and eight, / and having taken coconuts, endowed with supreme faith,

5.156.s:
tataḥ kṣutkṣāmakaṃṭhaḥ sa pariśrāṃtastadagrataḥ ..
upaviṣṭo japaṃ kurvansūryeṣṭaiḥ stavanaistadā .. 13 ..
5.156.d:
ततः क्षुत्क्षामकंठः स परिश्रांतस्तदग्रतः ..
उपविष्टो जपं कुर्वन्सूर्येष्टैः स्तवनैस्तदा .. 13 ..
5.156.m: his throat emaciated by hunger, exhausted, he then sat in front of him, / reciting japa with hymns beloved by the Sun,

5.156.s:
maṃḍalabrāhmaṇādyaiśca tāraṃ svaramupāśritaḥ ..
saptayuṃjara vādyaiśca agnireveti bhaktitaḥ .. 14 ..
5.156.d:
मंडलब्राह्मणाद्यैश्च तारं स्वरमुपाश्रितः ..
सप्तयुंजर वाद्यैश्च अग्निरेवेति भक्तितः .. 14 ..
5.156.m: employing a high pitch with texts beginning with the Maṇḍalabrāhmaṇa, / with hymns beginning with 'Saptayuñjanti' and 'Agnireva' with devotion,

5.156.s:
ādityavratasaṃjñādyaiḥ sāmabhirdṛḍhabhaktibhāk ..
kṣurikāmaṃtrapūrvaiśca tathaivātharvaṇodbhavaiḥ .. 15 ..
5.156.d:
आदित्यव्रतसंज्ञाद्यैः सामभिर्दृढभक्तिभाक् ..
क्षुरिकामंत्रपूर्वैश्च तथैवाथर्वणोद्भवैः .. 15 ..
5.156.m: possessing firm devotion, with Sāmans such as the one named Ādityavrata, / and with hymns preceded by the Kṣurikāmantra, as well as those arising from the Atharvaveda.

5.156.s:
yāvadanyorkavārastu naiva tuṣṭo divākaraḥ ..
paurṇamāsīdine prāpte vairāgyaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ .. 16 ..
5.156.d:
यावदन्योर्कवारस्तु नैव तुष्टो दिवाकरः ..
पौर्णमासीदिने प्राप्ते वैराग्यं परमं गतः .. 16 ..
5.156.m: Until another Sunday came, the Maker of Day was not at all pleased; / when the full moon day arrived, he fell into the utmost dejection.

5.156.s:
tataḥ puṣpo vidhāyātha snānaṃ dhautāṃbaraḥ śuciḥ ..
bhūnāmnā sādhya bhūmiṃ ca sthaṃḍilārthaṃ dvijottamāḥ .. 17 ..
5.156.d:
ततः पुष्पो विधायाथ स्नानं धौतांबरः शुचिः ..
भूनाम्ना साध्य भूमिं च स्थंडिलार्थं द्विजोत्तमाः .. 17 ..
5.156.m: Then Puṣpa, having performed his snāna, clad in clean clothes and purified, / having consecrated the ground by the name of the Earth for the sacrificial mound, O best of brahmins,

5.156.s:
sthaṃḍilaṃ hastamātraṃ ca sthaṃḍile pratyakalpayat ..
agnimīḻetimaṃtreṇa tato'gniṃ sa nidhāya ca .. 18 ..
5.156.d:
स्थंडिलं हस्तमात्रं च स्थंडिले प्रत्यकल्पयत् ..
अग्निमीḻएतिमंत्रेण ततोऽग्निं स निधाय च .. 18 ..
5.156.m: prepared a sacrificial mound measuring one cubit upon the ground; / and having then placed the fire [there] with the mantra 'agnim īḷe',

5.156.s:
tṛṇaiḥ paristṛṇāmītikṛtvopastaraṇaṃ tataḥ ..
ābrahmanniti mantreṇa dattvā brahmāsanaṃ tataḥ .. 19 ..
5.156.d:
तृणैः परिस्तृणामीतिकृत्वोपस्तरणं ततः ..
आब्रह्मन्निति मन्त्रेण दत्त्वा ब्रह्मासनं ततः .. 19 ..
5.156.m: and then having scattered grass with 'I strew grass all around', / having then provided the seat for the Brahman priest with the mantra 'ā brahman',

5.156.s:
sutrāmāṇamiti procya samidhaḥsthāpanaṃ ca yat ..
prokṣaṇīpātramāsādya prokṣaṇaṃ kṛtavāṃstataḥ .. 6.157.20 ..
5.156.d:
सुत्रामाणमिति प्रोच्य समिधःस्थापनं च यत् ..
प्रोक्षणीपात्रमासाद्य प्रोक्षणं कृतवांस्ततः .. 6.157.20 ..
5.156.m: having placed the kindling sticks reciting 'sutrāmāṇam', / having fetched the vessel of sprinkling water, he then performed the sprinkling.

5.156.s:
pātrāṇāmatha sarveṣāṃ sruvādīnāṃ yathākramam ..
tataḥ prakalpayāmāsa haviḥsthāne nijāṃ tanum .. .. 21 ..
5.156.d:
पात्राणामथ सर्वेषां स्रुवादीनां यथाक्रमम् ..
ततः प्रकल्पयामास हविःस्थाने निजां तनुम् .. .. 21 ..
